chapters.title: Chapter 301 - 241: Speedrunning the Abyss
paragraphs: This monster has already reached the verge of First Transformation, its strength is indeed formidable.
However, as Zhang Lianmeng launched a Large Fireball.
This Skeleton General didn’t even lift its weapon, directly blasted into a pile of black ashes...
And above this pile of black ash, a faintly glowing Ghost Fire floated.
Han Xing walked over and collected the materials it dropped.
[Obtained Glowing Spirit*1, Rare Earth*270, Mithril*12, obtained...]
Compared to the dim Spirit, the Glowing Spirit contains a richer soul aura, which can summon a Level 10 Elite Monster to assist in battle.
However, for now, it is of no help to Han Xing.
Then, everyone began to advance to the next level again.
Upon reaching the 11th level.
The monsters’ levels also rose to Level 11, not only did their numbers increase, but some new types of soldiers appeared.
Besides Skeleton Soldiers, there were also many hidden Skeleton Dogs, Skeleton Horses, and so on.
In the mist, some monsters with fully transparent bodies, like ghosts, would occasionally drift over.
These monsters are called Abyssal Ghosts.
They are a type of Magic Series monsters, capable of exerting Mental Attacks.
On the 11th level, the monsters combined Physical Attacks and Magic Attacks.
If it were an average First Transformation team, they would probably encounter quite some trouble here.
Of course, Zhang Lianmeng’s Large Fireball resolved it.
Boom.
As the flames dispersed, the system prompt appeared.
[Successfully cleared the 11th layer of Abyssal Rift, this battle took 3.27 seconds...]
The group began to speed through and quickly reached the 16th layer.
The strength of the monsters here jumped up a notch, with levels reaching basically Level 16 and above.
Elite Monsters frequently appeared, and sometimes a Leader would be encountered.
Zhang Lianmeng’s Large Fireball, due to attack range limitation, could not clear the field in one wave.
However, at this time, Han Xing would supplement with a Blast Flame Arrow to basically resolve the battle.
With the cooperation of the two, the subsequent layers were unobstructed.
17th layer, took 4.1 seconds...
18th layer, took 4.23 seconds...
19th layer...
All the way to the 25th layer, their speed still showed no signs of slowing.
They generally resolved battles within ten seconds.
Then, they directly stormed to the 30th level!
The final Boss here is a Level 30 Leader Monster.
[Angry Ghost (Leader Level): Abyssal Monster]
[Level]: 30
[Attributes]: Power 293, agility 304, Spirit 354, Constitution 273
[Skills]: Resentful Spirit’s Wail, Undead’s Rain, Angry Scream.
This Angry Ghost floated in midair, its whole body radiating red light.
Its appearance seemed to resemble a human female.
With disheveled hair, she wore thin clothes with holes all over.
Through these holes, you could see the pale skin underneath the clothes and her exceptionally slender figure.
Cheng Jianyong couldn’t help but exclaim, "Tsk tsk, this female ghost... has quite a nice figure!"
Shen Yun gave him a sidelong glance, speechless, "Bro, you seem kind of perverted."
"Preferences can be down-to-earth, but not down-to-the-underworld."
Cheng Jianyong hurriedly explained, "What are you thinking, I was just casually remarking."
However, the Ghost seemed unable to hear their conversation.
It looked at them with vicious eyes and suddenly lunged.
Buzz!
The red light on the Angry Ghost surged, carrying a breath of death.
The next moment, Han Xing directly used a Weakness Strike, hitting the center of the ghost’s eyebrows.
"Ah!"
With a piercing shriek.
The red light on this ghost flickered continuously.
It gave Han Xing a resentful glare, then gracefully flew into the air, seemingly intending to release some skill.
However, at this moment, Han Xing said, "Finish it off!"
Receiving the command, the group’s attacks descended simultaneously.
Holy Light Ball!
Sudden Burst of Killing Intent!
Large Fireball!
Multi-Shot!
With crackling sounds, various attacks landed on the Angry Ghost.
After a wave of concentrated fire.
The red light on the ghost was extinguished as if doused with a bucket of cold water.
Then, with a scream, it dissipated in midair.
[Successfully cleared Abyssal Rift: Level 30, took 1 minute and 12 seconds...]
After the female ghost’s death, a Ghost Fire emitting red light floated in the original place.
[Strong Spirit]: A spirit containing powerful soul energy, capable of summoning a Level 30 leader-level Ghost to assist in battle.
"Another type of spirit." Han Xing’s eyes also lit up.
Because this indicated that as long as they continued to advance, there was surely a chance to drop even higher-level spirits!
After collecting all the spirits and Mithril dropped from the ghost’s body.
In front of them, a Mist Passage appeared again.
At this moment, the system prompt appeared.
"The challenge of Level 30 is over, this battle took: 1 minute 17 seconds..."
"Please Survivor decide whether to continue exploring deeper levels of the Abyssal Rift."
"If you choose no, the system will automatically record the team’s cleared layers and transport Survivor out."
"On your next entry, you can choose to restart the challenge from any layer between 1-30."
Upon hearing the prompt, Cheng Jianyong exclaimed in surprise, "Oh? Is this our save point?"
Han Xing nodded, "It seems so."
Han Xing didn’t hesitate, immediately choosing to continue the exploration.
The monsters on the 30th layer didn’t pose any threat to them.
Even Boundless had now pushed to the 39th layer, Han Xing and the others had even less reason to worry.
Then, the group together stepped into the Mist Passage.
As they continued deeper, the surrounding scene underwent some subtle changes.
It was no longer like before, a scene of chaos.
Now the Mist Passage seemed more like a treacherous den, full of danger.
Screeching sounds pierced everyone’s eardrums.

chapters.title: Chapter 302 - 241: In the Abyss, Speedrunning Begins_2
paragraphs: The intermittent sounds of knocking were like someone was crushing bones one by one, causing people to feel a chill down their spine.
The group had just stepped into the mist passage.
Suddenly, they saw a massive shadow rushing towards them from behind.
The figure emanated an overwhelming evil aura, even surpassing Zefer, whom they met in the Witch Race Main City!
And Zefer had the strength of a Four-star Lord Level!
This figure even faintly touched that level of power!
At this moment, everyone, including Han Xing, felt the hairs on the back of their necks stand up!
The crisis of death instantly hit!
"Be careful!" Cheng Jianyong exclaimed!
At that moment, as Han Xing sensed the aura rushing towards them, he immediately released Coal Ball from the pet space.
He also drew his bowstring, ready for a desperate fight!
However, just as the terrifying aura was about to burst out of the mist’s edge, it was as if it hit an invisible wall.
Bang!
A sound of an invisible impact echoed.
The monster let out a furious low growl, continuously charging forward.
But no matter how angry it got, it could not break through the mist, nor could even a hint of its aura seep out.
It was as if that piece of mist was another world.
The terrifying aura, after attempting in vain for a while, turned around and left.
Han Xing and the others collectively let out a sigh of relief.
They were all startled.
The two girls tightly gripped their weapons, their bodies trembling slightly.
Cheng Jianyong, with pale lips, said in a scared tone, "What the hell was that thing just now?"
Shen Yun also shook his head and then looked at Han Xing.
Han Xing said, "Not sure, but the introduction on the Strong Fragment mentioned that this was once a battlefield between two worlds."
"Although it’s closed now, there must still be many unimaginable existences inside."
"However, we have system protection, so even those existences can’t harm us through the mist."
Hearing this, everyone showed an enlightened expression.
Cheng Jianyong, after hearing this, angrily said, "Damn it, these guys know they can’t come over, yet they specially come to scare us!"
"Really not a good thing!"
Cheng Jianyong wanted to continue griping.
Han Xing quickly stopped him.
Cheng Jianyong was still a bit puzzled.
But when he followed Han Xing’s gaze to look forward, he instantly felt his scalp tingle!
Deep in the mist, one or two pairs of blood-red eyes were staring at them with intense killing intent.
Cheng Jianyong quickly shut his mouth.
He shivered, turning pale, and dared not say a word.
Everyone maintained a quiet pace, slowly moving towards the area of the 31st layer.
The gazes from behind lingered.
It was as if they would always hide in the mist, fixating on them.
Until everyone passed through the mist passage.
The scene changed again, and those prying gazes gradually disappeared.
Everyone let out a collective sigh of relief.
A vast area appeared before them once more.
This was the 31st layer of the Abyssal Rift.
Compared to the previous 30 layers, the space here seemed more expansive.
And this also conveyed a signal.
The number of monsters they encountered next would be greater and more powerful.
At this moment, Han Xing, looking at the mist space ahead, said, "It seems they’re upping the intensity for us."
"Everyone, get ready and see how strong the monsters on the 31st floor are?"
Seemingly responding to their sentiments.
In the next moment, the entire ground seemed to awaken, continuously sprouting all sorts of pale skeleton arms and bodies.
From the mist, a horde of ghosts surged towards them.
It was still the combination of skeletons and ghosts.
Only this time, there were many Skeleton Knights and Evil Thought Ghosts among the elite monsters.
Moreover, these monsters were all Level 31.
Compared to previous layers, not only did the monster quantity skyrocket, but their attributes reached a qualitative change.
At this stage, 80% of humanity’s teams would probably be halted here.
Even Han Xing and the others became slightly more serious.
Rumble!
With wave after wave of Blast Flame Arrows and Large Fireballs.
Flame series damage appeared to have a special bonus against these abyssal demons.
Like mowing down grass, wave after wave of monsters was slaughtered by them.
The attacks from Han Xing and Zhang Lianmeng worked perfectly together; these ordinary monsters didn’t last a single round.
Even if the elite monsters hidden among them weren’t killed in one wave, they would be immediately targeted by Su Xiaoyang and Cheng Jianyong.
The kill notifications kept popping up, and the system interface started going crazy.
[Successfully killed Skeleton Dog, gained 64,800 Experience Value...]
[Successfully killed Evil Thought Ghost (Elite Level), gained 148,000 Experience Value...]
[Successfully killed...]
Three minutes later.
When the last Skeleton Knight was sliced into two by Cheng Jianyong, its bones scattered all over the ground.
The battle was declared over.
This was when Han Xing noticed that many clusters of ghost fire of various colors appeared on the battlefield.
Compared to the previous layers, the ghost fire here was noticeably more formidable.
These appeared to be the souls of those abyssal monsters, capable of summoning monsters of corresponding levels to assist in battle.
Han Xing also walked over and collected all the messy materials on the ground.
[Obtained Glowing Spirit *721, Obtained Elite Spirit *5, Obtained Abyssal Magic Stone *563, Obtained Permanent Gold Ingot *27, Obtained Mithril...]

Looking at the pockets of ghost fire in his backpack, Han Xing thought, "Interesting, reaching the 23rd layer, the materials appearing are more advanced, even Constant Gold Ingots and Elite Spirits, such high-level materials have already appeared."
"And the Abyssal Magic Stone, there’s quite a quantity..."
A gleam of joy appeared in Han Xing’s eyes.
Due to the mechanism of the Abyssal Rift.
The layers you clear are recorded.
Next time you enter, you can choose to start from layer 1 or from the last cleared layer to re-challenge.
By removing the low-yield layers before the 20th.
They can directly speed run from the 20th to the 30th floor, and it takes only half an hour per trip, including travel time.
Calculating this way, they can do at least 40 runs a day!
Relying solely on this fast-paced abyssal rift, their daily earnings are quite astounding!
This is when the system notification appeared.
[Successfully cleared the 31st layer of the Abyssal Rift, this battle took 3 minutes and 13 seconds...]
The mist passage appeared again.
Han Xing said with a smile on his face, "Let’s go, keep sprinting!"
Everyone stepped into the mist passage, heading to the next area.
"Abyssal Rift 32nd layer challenge is about to begin..."
Monsters appeared.
Han Xing and Zhang Lianmeng simultaneously raised their weapons with a tacit understanding, instantly launching attacks.
At the same time, Shen Yun and Cheng Jianyong also launched their attacks.
Rumble!
Flames surged.
Holy Light was intense.
Wave after wave of monsters was obliterated by them.
This time, even Coal Ball joined the battle, accelerating everyone’s clearance speed.
Forty minutes later.
The group sprinted all the way, overwhelming everything with firepower.
They directly reached the 40th layer!
Here, the space felt even more extensive.
Before the battle commenced, Han Xing felt waves of chilling aura penetrating his body.
Cheng Jianyong shivered and said, "Damn, it always feels like it’s really cold here..."
Hearing Cheng Jianyong’s remark, everyone shared the same feeling.
For a moment, their expressions also turned a bit more serious.
It’s important to know that they are now Fourth Transformation powerhouses.
Although just newly Fourth Transformed, even Han Xing only recently reached Level 41.
Yet, this aura can affect them.
It signifies that the monsters here are unquestionably strong.
Han Xing reminded, "This is the layer where Boundless had their stride ended; we need to be careful."
Though with their strength, dealing with monsters on the 40th floor shouldn’t be an issue.
But being cautious never hurts.
Upon hearing this, they all straightened up.
As the challenge officially commenced.
Suddenly, they felt the ground beneath their feet violently tremble.
Stomp! Stomp! Stomp!
From the distance, within the mist, came a series of terrifying stomping sounds, as if something monstrous was forcefully descending upon them from within the mist.

chapters.title: Chapter 303 - 242: Powerful Enhancement, Storm Chaos Dance!
paragraphs: In the depths of the mist, a series of dull stomping sounds emerged and gradually approached.
Han Xing and the group of team members vigilantly stared in the direction from which the sounds came.
However, before they could see the monster appear,
many skeleton monsters had already risen from the ground.
Compared to the skeleton monsters encountered before,
these skeleton monsters were equipped more exquisitely, all wearing uniform silver armor, wielding silver machetes, and carrying silver shields.
A dazzling array, making it hard to keep one’s eyes open.
Han Xing felt a flutter in his heart, and a greedy expression instantly appeared in his eyes.
He rubbed his hands together, thinking excitedly, "Wow, so much silver equipment!"
"If I could strip all the equipment off these monsters, that would be a huge income!"
At this moment, his hoarding nature burst forth once again!
Eager to rush up and strip these monsters bare immediately.
However, he was overthinking it.
The team’s previous battles had already confirmed that these monsters’ equipment would disappear upon death.
So, thinking about stripping the equipment from these monsters to resell was naturally impossible.
Gazing at the dazzling expanse of silver equipment, Han Xing felt a deep sense of regret.
Meanwhile,
in the mist, groups of pale ghost creatures surged like a tide.
The number of monsters on the 40th floor had increased more than tenfold compared to the 30th floor.
Absolutely not something an ordinary Third Transformation Survivor team could contend with.
Not to mention, this was just the beginning.
More terrifying monsters were poised to arrive from within the mist at any moment.
No wonder the Boundless team stopped here.
They also knew that the strength of the 40th-floor monsters exceeded imagination.
To avoid taking risks, Boundless chose to exit after clearing the 39th floor.
Indeed, their decision proved to be wise.
The monsters here, whether in quantity or quality, were far beyond the previous floors.
Although compared to the scale of the Blood Tide, it’s like a minor issue.
At that time, the Blood Tide monsters were only between Level 20 and Level 30.
However, the Abyssal Monster army they faced now was at least Level 35 and above as Three-star monsters!
Their attributes crushed the Blood Tide monsters by countless magnitudes.
Even Han Xing and his team, facing this terrifying monster horde, felt some pressure.
Yet, as they gradually entered combat mode, they quickly held back the Abyssal monsters.
Shen Yun summoned an avatar of an Archangel, radiating a holy light all around.
Leading the charge, he rushed into the monster horde.
Then, Shen Yun raised the Holy Hammer high and slammed it onto the ground.
A powerful holy light enveloped everyone.
At this moment, including Cheng Jianyong and Su Xiaoyang, everyone heard the notification that they’d been granted the ’Blessing of Courage’ and ’Blessing of Honor’.
Indeed, after completing the Fourth Transformation, Shen Yun also learned two new skills.
One was a passive skill called Archangel’s Will.
[Archangel’s Will]: Transforms all individual amplification skills into group amplification, maximum amplification units: 10.
This skill directly transformed his existing two individual blessing skills into group amplification skills.
Moreover, it could simultaneously affect 10 allied units.
In other words,
besides Han Xing’s group of five, even Coal Ball on the side, received the amplification.
Immediately, everyone’s All Attributes surged significantly!
Cheng Jianyong, watching his Sword Qi double in size, exclaimed in shock, "Whoa, amazing!"
"My attributes have increased by at least 40%, and my Attack Power has nearly doubled!"
"Such terrifying amplification!"
"This healer is just too awesome!"
Hearing Cheng Jianyong’s exaggerated cries,
everyone hurriedly checked their attributes.
Indeed, as he said, everyone’s four-dimensional attributes increased by at least 40%!
Combined with the Attack Power boost from the Blessing of Courage, it was as if a qualitative transformation had occurred!
The Fourth Transformation is an important stage for all Survivors.
Of course, the reason for such a powerful amplification effect was also because Shen Yun had switched to a hidden class, the Radiant Knight.
Ordinary Holy Profession roles, like Priests and Knights, didn’t have such exaggerated attribute bonuses.
At this moment, everyone truly felt the benefit of having a healer class in the team.
Along with their terrifying equipment levels,
for a while, the four transformed into monster harvesting machines.
With overwhelming levels, attributes, and equipment,
these monsters at the peak of the Third Transformation, nearing the Fourth Transformation in level, were instantly slaughtered!
Rumble!
Resentful spirits wailed, bones shattered.
Bone fragments scattered everywhere, then were bombarded to ashes by the incoming second wave of attacks.
As waves of Abyssal monsters were cleared away by everyone,
the dull stomping in the fog also drew closer and closer.
"Clomp... clomp... clomp..."
In the mist, a pair of bright red eyes suddenly appeared.
While clearing the ordinary monsters, Han Xing spared a bit of his mind to look into the mist.
Right at the onset of the 40th-floor challenge, everyone had noticed the activity in the mist.
Before this, they already knew that the mist might be hiding many creatures whose terror exceeded their imagination!
However, this particular monster didn’t give them that intense sense of crisis.
Besides, they also knew these monsters couldn’t easily breach the mist.
So, they hadn’t taken it too seriously.
But in the next moment,
that figure charged toward everyone at a swift speed!
Moreover, it didn’t seem to be impeded by the mist, carrying a terrifying presence as it instantly broke into the battlefield area.
"Damn, this monster just rushed out of the mist!" Cheng Jianyong exclaimed!
Everyone was caught by surprise.
Han Xing’s expression didn’t change, and he quickly reminded, "It’s coming!"
Upon hearing the reminder, everyone turned their eyes and watched the movement in the fog warily.
When the fog dissipated, they finally saw the appearance of that figure clearly.
It was a humanoid creature clad in golden armor, holding a golden spear.
Riding under it was a Skeleton Warhorse emanating Undead Fire, appearing awe-inspiring!
This humanoid creature was fully armed, revealing only a pair of blood-red eyes, staring intently at everyone.
In front of Han Xing, the attributes of this monster also appeared.
[Skeleton General: Buxa (Lord-level creature)]
[Level]: Level 40.
[Attributes]: Power 2043, agility 2154, spirit 1743, Constitution 1864.
[Skills]: Skeleton Domain, Golden Spiral Charge, Abyssal Assault, Dark Annihilation.
Although this Level 40 lord creature hasn’t officially completed the Fourth Transformation yet.
Its strength is already equivalent to a Fourth Transformation Leader-level monster.
Possibly, even stronger.
The next moment.
This formidable and radiant Skeleton General raised the golden war spear in its hand!
Instantly charging towards everyone.
Beneath it, the Skeleton Warhorse, flames of Undead Fire erupted from its four hooves.
Under the rapid charge, it rushed towards them like a cannonball.
All the Skeleton Soldiers along the way were dispersed at the moment they came into contact with its aura.
However.
Han Xing and the others, although feeling some pressure.
It wasn’t as severe as imagined.
After all, they possessed the strength to slay lords head-on during their Third Transformation.
At this time, after the Fourth Transformation.
They didn’t take this Skeleton General seriously.
The Golden Skeleton General charged fiercely.
The next moment.
A figure shining with Holy Radiance.
Suddenly stood in front of it with a shield.
This person was Shen Yun.
The scarlet eyes of the Skeleton Lord showed a hint of disdain.
Mere humans!
The next moment, it swung the golden spear in its hand, fiercely stabbing at Shen Yun’s shield, seemingly wanting to fling him away.
Clang!
The spear contacted the shield.
The Skeleton Lord’s expression changed instantly!
It felt a tremendous force transmitting from its palm to its shoulder in an instant.
As if it was attacking not a shield, but an unmovable Mountain Range!
The Skeleton Lord, in its burst state, was like a high-speed train hitting an invisible wall at that moment.
The charge came to an abrupt halt.
The next moment.
Shen Yun’s mouth curled into a smile, then he slammed the shield down.
"Get down!"
[Shield Strike!]
Bang!
The Skeleton Warhorse’s belly suffered a heavy blow, the sounds of bones cracking echoed continuously.
"Hiss!!" The Skeleton Warhorse let out a painful cry.
The Skeleton Lord sitting on its back suddenly felt a dizzying spin in its vision.
The whole body spun dozens of times in the air before crashing to the ground.
On the side, those mindless Skeleton Soldiers watched, jaws nearly dropping to the ground.
Because that figure sent flying was their boss.
The invincible Lord Buxa!
Now, he was effortlessly blocked by a human Survivor, even taking a faceplant.
Cheng Jianyong killed seven or eight Skeleton monsters with a swing of his sword, then praised, "Not bad, Xiaoyunzi, even a Level 40 lord is handled by you."
"Piece of cake."
Shen Yun also gave a disdainful smile, "I’m leaving this Skeleton Warhorse to you, no problem, right?"
The Skeleton General’s Skeleton Warhorse is also a Level 40 Leader monster, extremely formidable.
Cheng Jianyong wielded the Great Sword confidently, "Of course no problem, watch this!"
The next moment.
He immediately performed a Charge with a Mid-air Slash.
The [Flumeg’s Longsword] in his hand struck fiercely on the back of the Skeleton Warhorse.
"Hiss!!!"
The Skeleton Warhorse let out yet another cry of pain.
The Undead Fire in its pupils flickered intermittently.
At this moment, the pained Skeleton Warhorse just wanted to get back up from its sprawled position.
But saw Cheng Jianyong suddenly grip the deep blue Longsword with both hands, assuming a knightly strike posture, and shouted.
"Secret Skill—Storm Chaos Dance!"
The next moment.
Cheng Jianyong’s figure changed from one to eight!
These eight figures also held Flumeg’s Longsword.
And charged towards the Skeleton Warhorse simultaneously.
Swish swish swish!
The eight figures began continuously shifting positions, delivering over a hundred attacks in mere two seconds!
Sword lights flashed continuously, the attack movements were so fast, a terrifying whirlwind gradually formed on the spot.
This whirlwind contained deadly Sword Qi as well.
When Cheng Jianyong’s figure reappeared.
The eight figures merged back into one.
Cheng Jianyong remained in his stance of withdrawing the sword, taking a heavy breath.
"Phew..."

chapters.title: Chapter 304 - 243: Golden Armor - Basak War Spear
paragraphs: The skeleton warhorse that had endured a wave of Cheng Jianyong’s burst looked as if it had just eaten garlic, extremely unsightly.
In Cheng Jianyong’s recent combat technique, it endured unimaginable damage.
At this moment, all its injuries erupted simultaneously.
The next moment, the skeleton warhorse’s body began to show dense cracks, then exploded into fragments!
With one move.
A level 40 leader was instantly killed!
The remaining skeleton minions were dumbfounded, even the vengeful spirits felt a trace of fear towards this man.
The secret technique that Cheng Jianyong just released.
Was precisely the new burst skill, Storm Chaos Dance, learned by the swordsman after completing the fourth transformation.
This skill’s damage coefficient is determined by power.
The agility attribute decides the number of slashes.
With two blessings from Shen Yun.
Cheng Jianyong’s attributes were significantly enhanced, resulting in a qualitative increase in this burst skill’s lethality!
At this time.
The Skeleton Lord, seeing its beloved warhorse instantly killed, its eyes flashed a red glow.
It seemed extremely angry.
The Skeleton Lord was about to charge at Cheng Jianyong.
However, it found itself already surrounded by the four humans.
A sense of danger emerged in the Skeleton Lord’s heart.
From these humans, it sensed a strength not inferior to that of the swordsman.
Then, the Skeleton General raised the golden war spear in its hand, with terrifying power of the undead converging within.
It uttered a series of strange syllables.
"Let the world... feel pain!"
"Dark Annihilation!"
The golden war spear in the Skeleton Lord’s hand grew ever brighter, and everyone felt a hint of danger from it.
Shen Yun reminded: "Be careful, this leader is about to unleash a big move."
Zhang Lianmeng and Su Xiaoyang also became serious.
Yet at this moment.
An arrow imbued with the breath of a hurricane shot through the air at lightning speed.
The target was precisely the open mouth of the Skeleton Lord.
At this moment, the Skeleton Lord had just finished screaming its lines and had not had time to close its mouth.
It could already feel the wind approaching.
But the speed of the arrow was simply too fast!
The next moment.
With a cracking sound.
The Skeleton Lord’s entire head was pierced through.
The brewing big move came to an abrupt halt.
This arrow was the skill unleashed by Han Xing.
’Surprise Attack·Break’
Its unparalleled penetrative power and speed were nearly unstoppable.
The Skeleton Lord let out a wretched howl, seemingly suffering severe backlash.
Everyone’s eyes lit up.
Influenced by Han Xing, they had all learned the fine tradition of beating a drowning man.
The next moment.
Shen Yun’s Holy Light Ball, Su Xiaoyang’s Elf’s Eye, and Zhang Lianmeng’s Meteor Technique.
All targeted the Skeleton Lord.
Rumble!
Amid the Skeleton Lord’s wails.
After being tormented by everyone, its skeletal frame couldn’t withstand it and became a pile of bone fragments.
The battle was declared over.
An in-game notification appeared.
[Successfully killed Skeleton General: Buxsa, gained experience points: 12,430,000...]
The floor’s biggest boss was easily dealt with by everyone.
On the battlefield, only scattered skeleton monsters and vengeful spirits remained.
Next came the cleanup phase of the battle.
When the last vengeful spirit was taken down by everyone.
The entire ground of the mist space was covered with various monster corpses and bone fragments...
From this scene, one could imagine how many monsters they had just slain.
Although they gained a vast amount of experience, it only raised their experience bars by less than 3%.
Han Xing didn’t even reach a 2% increase.
Shen Yun also shook his head helplessly, saying: "After the fourth transformation, the experience required to level up is truly terrifying."
"At this rate, it will take us at least four or five days to level up."
Han Xing thought for a moment and replied: "It might take longer; the experience required for each level later increases exponentially."
"Moreover, the experience we gain from killing lower-level monsters will also be reduced, so our leveling speed will slow down."
Everyone listened and shook their heads in resignation.
Han Xing then reassured them: "But there’s no need to rush; we should take it slow."
"At least we are maintaining our advantage now."
Everyone nodded in agreement.
Then they began their routine battlefield cleanup work.
Above the monster corpses, there were thousands of ghost fires of varying sizes, flickering off and on.
However, Han Xing noticed.
Beside them, there was another ghost fire, dark red in color, over a meter high.
That seemed to be the place where the Skeleton Lord had died.
Could it be... that ghost fire belonged to it?
Curiously, Han Xing approached the ghost fire.
And then stored it in his backpack.
[Obtained Heroic Spirit*1.]
"It really is a Heroic Spirit!"
Han Xing felt a surge of joy in his heart.
This time, one of his main goals for going to the Abyssal Rift was to collect Heroic Spirits.
As the main material for crafting ancient weapons, Han Xing needed them in large quantities!
Although only one Heroic Spirit was dropped from this Lord Monster,
at least it gave Han Xing hope!
Because this indicated that the monsters on the 40th floor could drop this material!
Next, he just needed to clear the 40th floor of the Abyssal Rift quickly to acquire a large amount of Heroic Spirits!
Then he could mass-produce the Demon Elephant War Chariots!
Of course, Han Xing felt he could challenge higher floors and wouldn’t stop here.
After the initial excitement.
Han Xing suddenly noticed a golden light under his feet.
He noticed.
Originally, a pile of bone debris appeared where the Skeleton Lord had died.
And on top of the bone debris, a Golden Spear was quietly placed.
Apparently, it was the one the Skeleton Lord had just used.
"Huh?"
"Is this... a drop of equipment?"
A hint of surprise flashed in Han Xing’s eyes.
Han Xing had known before.
That after these monsters died, the equipment behind them would also disappear.
But now, this Skeleton Lord actually left a piece behind.
A look of delight emerged in Han Xing’s eyes again, and he immediately picked it up.
[Obtained [Buxa’s Golden Spear]*1, obtained Permanent Gold Ingot*17...]
[Buxa’s Golden Spear (Gold) lv40, Quality - Legend, Attack Power: 574~613, Power +200, Agility +150, Hit Rate +20.]
[Attached Effect]: Golden Spiral, Golden Piercing, Golden Wind (Legendary Effect)
[Note: Buxa’s Golden Set has eight parts, can form set effects with Buxa’s other equipment, three-piece set increases all attributes by 15%, five-piece set increases attack power by 20%.]
[Upon collecting all eight pieces, Buxa’s set function can be activated, causing 20% extra damage to enemies when attacking, and temporarily opening the set effect: Golden Sanctuary!]
"Huh? It’s a set!" Han Xing’s face lit up with a smile of surprise.
Cheng Jianyong listened and curiously leaned over to ask, "Brother Xing, what set is it?"
Han Xing directly posted the weapon attributes of the spear.
After reading the attribute introduction, Cheng Jianyong exclaimed in amazement, "Wow! A Golden Set!"
"All attributes increase by 15%, at least 40 damage increase, and even a set effect!"
"This is even stronger than the attributes of the equipment we have!"
"Isn’t this extremely powerful?"
Cheng Jianyong’s eyes filled with disbelief.
Because the Battle Merit Store was always open.
After Han Xing completed the Fourth Transformation.
He exchanged a large number of Golden Treasure Chests, equipping everyone with almost a full set of level 40 Golden Equipment.
Plus, they each had a piece or two of Orange Armor.
However, compared to these stand-alone pieces, the set’s attributes were clearly much stronger.
Shen Yun nodded after hearing this, "Indeed, although this set is only level 40, if we can complete it, it would greatly enhance our current strength."
Cheng Jianyong asked, "But we only have this one piece of the Buxa Set, where do we get the other parts?"
Shen Yun scornfully said, "Once we get out, just use the Stronger’s Mark to clear the 40th floor again."
"I think the monsters here, like those in the Cloud Secret Realm, will keep respawning."
"If we clear it several times, we can definitely complete the Buxsa Set."
Cheng Jianyong was enlightened, "Really? That’s possible?"
Shen Yun laughed, "Of course, why else would Brother Xing collect so many Strong Fragments?"
Cheng Jianyong was stunned, then looked at Han Xing in confusion.
Han Xing also smiled and nodded, "Yes."
Everyone, upon hearing this, felt a surge of joy in their hearts.

At this time, Cheng Jianyong looked at the Golden War Spear in his hand and regretfully said, "It’s a pity that if this set’s equipment level was a bit higher, we wouldn’t need to change equipment for a long time once we completed it."
Han Xing patted his shoulder and said, "Don’t worry, since there’s a Golden Set in the Abyssal Rift."
"It suggests that later floors will have other sets, and their levels might be higher."
Everyone’s eyes lit up upon hearing this.
That’s right!
They weren’t stopping at the 40th floor.
With everyone’s strength, they could explore a few more floors!
The monsters inside had higher levels, perhaps higher-level sets would appear!
Thinking of this, everyone’s hearts stirred with even more excitement.
Han Xing also smiled and collected all the loot from the ground.
[Obtained Dim Spirit*1475, obtained Strong Spirit*106, obtained Elite Spirit*23, obtained...]
After collecting all the loot.
The system prompt appeared.
[Successfully cleared the Abyssal Rift, 40th floor, battle duration 7 minutes 32 seconds...]
"As the first Brave Squad to clear the 40th floor, you have received the first-clear reward: Abyssal Magic Stone*50000, Heroic Spirit*20, Abyss Technology: Spiritual Energy Shock Tower Blueprint*1."
Upon hearing the system prompt, Han Xing’s eyes gleamed with joy.
"It’s here!"
On the first floor, everyone saw the introduction of that ’Brave Monument.’
Every 10 floors, the first team to clear it would receive a first-clear reward.
The rewards for the 10th, 20th, and 30th floors had already been claimed by Zhou Huang and Boundless.
This 40th-floor reward was naturally not to be missed by Han Xing.
His eyes were filled with excitement as he opened his backpack.
Looking at the large number of Abyssal Magic Stones and over 20 red spirits inside, his heart throbbed with excitement!

Shen Yun’s Holy Light Ball, Su Xiaoyang’s Elf’s Eye, and Zhang Lianmeng’s Meteor Technique.
All targeted the Skeleton Lord.
Rumble!
Amid the Skeleton Lord’s wails.
After being tormented by everyone, its skeletal frame couldn’t withstand it and became a pile of bone fragments.
The battle was declared over.
An in-game notification appeared.
[Successfully killed Skeleton General: Buxsa, gained experience points: 12,430,000...]
The floor’s biggest boss was easily dealt with by everyone.
On the battlefield, only scattered skeleton monsters and vengeful spirits remained.
Next came the cleanup phase of the battle.
When the last vengeful spirit was taken down by everyone.
The entire ground of the mist space was covered with various monster corpses and bone fragments...
From this scene, one could imagine how many monsters they had just slain.
Although they gained a vast amount of experience, it only raised their experience bars by less than 3%.
Han Xing didn’t even reach a 2% increase.
Shen Yun also shook his head helplessly, saying: "After the fourth transformation, the experience required to level up is truly terrifying."
"At this rate, it will take us at least four or five days to level up."
Han Xing thought for a moment and replied: "It might take longer; the experience required for each level later increases exponentially."
"Moreover, the experience we gain from killing lower-level monsters will also be reduced, so our leveling speed will slow down."
Everyone listened and shook their heads in resignation.
Han Xing then reassured them: "But there’s no need to rush; we should take it slow."
"At least we are maintaining our advantage now."
Everyone nodded in agreement.
Then they began their routine battlefield cleanup work.
Above the monster corpses, there were thousands of ghost fires of varying sizes, flickering off and on.
However, Han Xing noticed.
Beside them, there was another ghost fire, dark red in color, over a meter high.
That seemed to be the place where the Skeleton Lord had died.
Could it be... that ghost fire belonged to it?
Curiously, Han Xing approached the ghost fire.
And then stored it in his backpack.
[Obtained Heroic Spirit*1.]
"It really is a Heroic Spirit!"
Han Xing felt a surge of joy in his heart.
This time, one of his main goals for going to the Abyssal Rift was to collect Heroic Spirits.
As the main material for crafting ancient weapons, Han Xing needed them in large quantities!
Although only one Heroic Spirit was dropped from this Lord Monster,
at least it gave Han Xing hope!
Because this indicated that the monsters on the 40th floor could drop this material!
Next, he just needed to clear the 40th floor of the Abyssal Rift quickly to acquire a large amount of Heroic Spirits!
Then he could mass-produce the Demon Elephant War Chariots!
Of course, Han Xing felt he could challenge higher floors and wouldn’t stop here.
After the initial excitement.
Han Xing suddenly noticed a golden light under his feet.
He noticed.
Originally, a pile of bone debris appeared where the Skeleton Lord had died.
And on top of the bone debris, a Golden Spear was quietly placed.
Apparently, it was the one the Skeleton Lord had just used.
"Huh?"
"Is this... a drop of equipment?"
A hint of surprise flashed in Han Xing’s eyes.
Han Xing had known before.
That after these monsters died, the equipment behind them would also disappear.
But now, this Skeleton Lord actually left a piece behind.
A look of delight emerged in Han Xing’s eyes again, and he immediately picked it up.
[Obtained [Buxa’s Golden Spear]*1, obtained Permanent Gold Ingot*17...]
[Buxa’s Golden Spear (Gold) lv40, Quality - Legend, Attack Power: 574~613, Power +200, Agility +150, Hit Rate +20.]
[Attached Effect]: Golden Spiral, Golden Piercing, Golden Wind (Legendary Effect)
[Note: Buxa’s Golden Set has eight parts, can form set effects with Buxa’s other equipment, three-piece set increases all attributes by 15%, five-piece set increases attack power by 20%.]
[Upon collecting all eight pieces, Buxa’s set function can be activated, causing 20% extra damage to enemies when attacking, and temporarily opening the set effect: Golden Sanctuary!]
"Huh?
It’s a set!" Han Xing’s face lit up with a smile of surprise.
Cheng Jianyong listened and curiously leaned over to ask, "Brother Xing, what set is it?"
Han Xing directly posted the weapon attributes of the spear.
After reading the attribute introduction, Cheng Jianyong exclaimed in amazement, "Wow!
A Golden Set!"
"All attributes increase by 15%, at least 40 damage increase, and even a set effect!"
"This is even stronger than the attributes of the equipment we have!"
"Isn’t this extremely powerful?"
Cheng Jianyong’s eyes filled with disbelief.
Because the Battle Merit Store was always open.
After Han Xing completed the Fourth Transformation.
He exchanged a large number of Golden Treasure Chests, equipping everyone with almost a full set of level 40 Golden Equipment.
Plus, they each had a piece or two of Orange Armor.
However, compared to these stand-alone pieces, the set’s attributes were clearly much stronger.
Shen Yun nodded after hearing this, "Indeed, although this set is only level 40, if we can complete it, it would greatly enhance our current strength."
Cheng Jianyong asked, "But we only have this one piece of the Buxa Set, where do we get the other parts?"
Shen Yun scornfully said, "Once we get out, just use the Stronger’s Mark to clear the 40th floor again."
"I think the monsters here, like those in the Cloud Secret Realm, will keep respawning."
"If we clear it several times, we can definitely complete the Buxsa Set."
Cheng Jianyong was enlightened, "Really?
That’s possible?"
Shen Yun laughed, "Of course, why else would Brother Xing collect so many Strong Fragments?"
Cheng Jianyong was stunned, then looked at Han Xing in confusion.
Han Xing also smiled and nodded, "Yes."
Everyone, upon hearing this, felt a surge of joy in their hearts.

At this time, Cheng Jianyong looked at the Golden War Spear in his hand and regretfully said, "It’s a pity that if this set’s equipment level was a bit higher, we wouldn’t need to change equipment for a long time once we completed it."
Han Xing patted his shoulder and said, "Don’t worry, since there’s a Golden Set in the Abyssal Rift."
"It suggests that later floors will have other sets, and their levels might be higher."
Everyone’s eyes lit up upon hearing this.
That’s right!
They weren’t stopping at the 40th floor.
With everyone’s strength, they could explore a few more floors!
The monsters inside had higher levels, perhaps higher-level sets would appear!
Thinking of this, everyone’s hearts stirred with even more excitement.
Han Xing also smiled and collected all the loot from the ground.
[Obtained Dim Spirit*1475, obtained Strong Spirit*106, obtained Elite Spirit*23, obtained...]
After collecting all the loot.
The system prompt appeared.
[Successfully cleared the Abyssal Rift, 40th floor, battle duration 7 minutes 32 seconds...]
"As the first Brave Squad to clear the 40th floor, you have received the first-clear reward: Abyssal Magic Stone*50000, Heroic Spirit*20, Abyss Technology: Spiritual Energy Shock Tower Blueprint*1."
Upon hearing the system prompt, Han Xing’s eyes gleamed with joy.
"It’s here!"
On the first floor, everyone saw the introduction of that ’Brave Monument.’
Every 10 floors, the first team to clear it would receive a first-clear reward.
The rewards for the 10th, 20th, and 30th floors had already been claimed by Zhou Huang and Boundless.
This 40th-floor reward was naturally not to be missed by Han Xing.
His eyes were filled with excitement as he opened his backpack.
Looking at the large number of Abyssal Magic Stones and over 20 red spirits inside, his heart throbbed with excitement!

chapters.title: Chapter 305 - 244: First Clear Reward, Spiritual Shock Tower
paragraphs: Han Xing looked at the spoils in his backpack, a smile on his lips.
"This first-clear reward is really generous..."
"50,000 Abyssal Magic Stones, enough for me to create 5 Hellfire Missile Silos."
"Plus 20 Heroic Spirits, I can also directly create 2 Demon Elephant War Chariots!"
"This way, I can considerably expand my territory again!"
However, the first two materials aren’t even the main part of the first-clear reward.
At this point, he took out another reward from his backpack, the ’Spiritual Shock Tower’ blueprint.
Previously, Han Xing had already acquired an Abyss Technology; it was the ’Hellfire Missile Silo.’
Its powerful destructive power dominated during the Blood Tide disaster!
And to this day, it remains the strongest attack method in Han Xing’s territory.
Although, compared to the ’Hellfire Missile Silo,’ this ’Spiritual Shock Tower’ doesn’t sound as powerful.
But as an Abyss Technology and a 40th-floor first-clear reward, it shouldn’t be weak at all.
Han Xing, with an expectant look, checked the blueprint’s attributes.
[Abyss Technology: Spiritual Shock Tower]

[Building Effect]: Every 20 seconds, the shock tower can emit a burst of spiritual energy, dealing 5000 points of psychic damage to enemies and causing them to fall into a two-second confusion effect.
[Maximum Range]: 30 kilometers.
Han Xing cheerfully exclaimed, "Interesting, a defense tower with psychic damage?"
"The same 20-second cooldown, but the damage is significantly higher than the Thunderbolt Tower, and the range is greater too."
"However, compared to the Thunderbolt Tower’s linear range attack, this Spiritual Shock Tower is more like a catapult with targeted blast strikes."
"Both have their pros and cons, should be considered buildings of the same level."
"If they can be used together, the effect would be even better!"
Han Xing was also eager to check the materials required.
[Materials Required to Construct the Spiritual Shock Tower]: Permanent Gold Ingot *2000, Mithril *50k, Refined Iron *500k, Rare Earth *1M, Abyssal Magic Stone *1000.
Han Xing nodded and said, "It’s alright, the required materials are much less than those for the Hellfire Missile Silo."
Except for the Abyssal Magic Stones.
The materials to build one Hellfire Missile Silo could be used to set up 5 Spiritual Shock Towers.
The cost-performance ratio is still quite high.
At this point, Cheng Jianyong, Shen Yun, and others heard the system notification as well.
However, since Han Xing is the captain, the first-clear reward went directly into his backpack.
Judging by Han Xing’s expression, everyone knew that the rewards should be pretty good.
Cheng Jianyong asked, "Brother Xing, what’s the good stuff in there?"
Han Xing smiled and said, "Not bad, a blueprint for building a defense tower."
Everyone, upon hearing this, suddenly seemed a bit uninterested.
They knew that such defense towers were usually built by Han Xing.
Everyone also felt it was convenient, not needing to worry about so many things, and not needing to fret over gathering various materials!
Compared to defense towers, they preferred powerful equipment.
Han Xing seemed to understand everyone’s thoughts and also shook his head with a smile.
"Alright, we’ve received the rewards; now we need to continue to challenge the 41st floor!"
Cheng Jianyong exclaimed excitedly, "Let’s go, let’s go!"
Encouraged, everyone stepped into the Mist Passage together.
Meanwhile.
The text on the ’Brave Monument’ on the first floor of the Abyssal Rift subtly changed.
The team with the highest cleared floor was originally Kunlun, but it has now been erased.
[Abyssal Rift Highest Floor]: Star River Squad.
[Cleared Floors]: 40.
Below, there was another line.
[40th Floor First Clear Team]: Star River Squad.
Lately, with no major events or other battles.
Survivors are either exploring the Sky Island or entering the Cloud Secret Realm and Abyssal Rift.
Moreover, as more and more survivors bring various treasures out from the Abyssal Rift.
Since the difficulty is based on floor level, survivors of any level can go and challenge it.
Therefore, the Abyssal Rift is becoming increasingly popular.
Although many survivors can now challenge over twenty floors, even 30 floors.
To avoid wasting fragments though.
They still prefer starting from floor 1, slowly challenging upward.
Also, there’s a legend among the survivors.
In the Abyssal Rift, hidden monsters occasionally appear.
These monsters don’t look like Abyssal Monsters.
More like monstrous beasts.
They resemble rats from the Blue Star, just much larger.
And when these rats appear, they carry a giant sack on their backs.
It’s said that if you intercept these rats.
Or snatch the big sack from their backs, you’ll find unexpected treasures inside!
A few times, survivors have even found several Philosopher’s Stones in the sack!
Hence, this is why survivors are willing to start over from floor 1 to challenge the Abyssal Rift again.
The more floors they challenge, the greater the chance of encountering these Treasure Rats.
At this moment, more survivors were flooding into the Abyssal Rift.
Then, they noticed the changes on the ’Brave Monument.’
"Hey? Brothers, come over quickly, the monument seems to have changed."
"Boundless, who got stuck on the 40th floor for half a month, has been completed by someone!"
This team of survivors heard this and were all surprised, "Cleared? Who’s so awesome?"
The person glanced at it and said in a shocked tone, "Holy, it’s Star River!"
"What?"
Hearing this name, the other survivors were full of disbelief.
"Star River... is it that Star River? Could it be a team with the same name?"

chapters.title: Chapter 306 - 244: First Clear Reward, Spiritual Shock Tower_2
paragraphs: The survivor once again confirmed the team and the names of the other team members.
After a moment, he took a deep breath and said, "It must be accurate. Besides the Star God, I saw several familiar names up there."
"Lone Brave and Yun Tianming are all present."
"This team must be the Star God without a doubt!"
Upon hearing this, everyone’s pupils constricted sharply.
"I didn’t expect that the Star God would also come to the Abyssal Rift, and make such a big move immediately!"
"Truly a figure admired by all of humanity."
"Brothers, take pictures of the steles and post them on the forum!"
"Let’s ride on the Star God’s popularity and hope to go viral!"
The team members’ eyes lit up upon hearing this.
Then, they immediately took pictures of the contents on the stele and posted them on the forum.
Seconds later, a post appeared.
"Star River God sighted in Abyssal Rift! Breaking records, currently sprinting to higher levels!"
The post included the pictures they had just taken.
So far, any post about Star River would get a lot of attention.
In an instant, the clicks on this post began to soar.
Then, they saw the records on the ’Brave Monument’.
A large number of survivors knew that Han Xing was challenging the Abyssal Rift.
Including Boundless, who was on the 38th level of the Abyssal Rift.
After defeating the last Leader Monster, Boundless quickly received reports from subordinates.
After hearing the report, Boundless furrowed his brow slightly.
Beside him, a beautiful woman said worriedly, "Young Master Wu, Star River seems to have cleared the 40th level. Did he take the first-clear reward too?"
Boundless glanced at her, "What do you think? He definitely took it."
The beautiful woman was taken aback and then gave an awkward chuckle.
Boundless didn’t mind but showed a pondering look in his eyes.
Previously, upon clearing the 20th and 30th levels, the system gave him two Abyssal Technology Blueprints.
They were the Dark Arrow Tower and the Skeleton Catapult.
The former was quite ordinary, just a tower with a dark aura that could turn slain enemies into skeletons.
The unique one was the 30th level’s first-clear reward, the Skeleton Catapult.
It could launch Skeleton Bombs, dealing widespread undead damage to enemies.
After the bones scattered, they could turn into Skeleton Soldiers, with a very powerful effect.
In many battles, the Skeleton Catapult shone brightly.
This let Boundless taste its sweetness.
So, during this time, he was also massively purchasing ’Strong Fragments’ for the Abyssal Rift challenge.
Then continually challenged the Abyssal Rift, enhancing the team members’ strength, preparing for the 40th level.
However, despite so much time passing.
Boundless’s personal level also increased to Level 35, and other team members all completed the Third Transformation, becoming powerful.
But even so, Boundless still had no assurance of clearing the 40th level.
What he didn’t expect was.
After developing for so many days, he still couldn’t achieve it.
Star River came and easily accomplished what he couldn’t.
At this moment, Boundless said helplessly, "This Star River, disappearing for over a month."
"As soon as he shows up, he makes consecutive big moves."
"Opening Xingyu City and clearing the Abyssal Rift."
"I thought after Blood Tide I could catch up with Star River’s strength."
"Now it seems, the gap is only widening."
The beautiful woman, hearing this, looked worriedly at Boundless.
In her impression.
Boundless has always been a very confident person, even considering Zhou Huang merely a neck-and-neck rival.
Boundless believed he was not weaker than Zhou Huang.
But now, Boundless frankly admitted that he is not as good as Star River.
This surprised the beautiful woman and also made her worry for this man.
At this moment, Han Xing.
Was unaware that another wave of discussion about him had risen outside.
Because they had already reached the 41st layer of the Abyssal Rift.
In this level, the monsters’ level had also risen to a minimum of Level 41.
Compared to the monsters below, attributes had greatly increased, making the difficulty skyrocket.
At this time, a system prompt appeared.
[Abyssal Rift, Level 41 challenge starts...]
The next moment.
The entire space seemed to go mad, the ground constantly trembling.
Rumble!
Countless Skeleton Knights, Skeleton Demon Wolves, Skeleton Giant Elephants emerged from the ground.
Apart from these.
More monsters also surged from the mist.
Abyssal Demon Eye, Soul Reaper, Inferior Demon, etc...
They all charged towards Han Xing and others.
Everyone instantly entered a battle state.
Shen Yun raised the Holy Hammer, smashing it fiercely on the ground.
"May the will of the Radiant Divine King illuminate you!"
Bang! Bang!
Two muffled collision sounds came.
Everyone was endowed with two Blessed States.
The next moment.
Shen Yun and Cheng Jianyong charged into the monster horde first.
"Angel’s Shelter!"
"Iaijutsu Slash!"
The monster horde was instantly blocked!
The next moment, a blue Sword Qi cut across with unmatched force.
Ka-ka-ka!
Countless monsters were cut in half at the waist by this wave of Sword Qi.
In front of Cheng Jianyong, a large area was instantly cleared.
The corners of his mouth also showed a hint of joy, holding a rather cool sword sheathing pose, he said in a pretentious manner: "Did you see that? This is the power of the Great Sword Master!"
At this moment.
Zhang Lianmeng’s various Elemental Attacks also started pouring out frantically.
"Wind, Fire, Ice, Thunder!"
"The elements of the world, all under my control!"
Rumble!
Lightning and thunder, ice and fire rampaged!
Various large-scale attacks poured down in waves!
The horde was cleared wave after wave.
Beside her, Su Xiaoyang was incessantly unleashing Arrow Rain.
Over time, the Abyssal Monsters were turned into hedgehogs.
After several minutes, everyone let out a sigh of relief as they looked at the mutilated monster bodies and the cleared battlefield.
Compared to Level 40, the monsters here had indeed increased in strength, by quite a bit.
But with everyone’s formidable combined attributes, a single wave of attack could still easily deal a quick resolution.
After dealing with the elite and Leader Monsters inside,
they successfully completed the battle without any danger.
They quickly collected all the loot, stored it in Han Xing’s backpack.
[Acquired Glowing Spirit*4723, Elite Spirit*74, Heroic Spirit*1]
Han Xing felt a burst of joy at the system notification.
"Oh? There’s a Heroic Spirit here?"
Previously, Han Xing didn’t even expect to find a Heroic Spirit here.
This is good news for Han Xing.
Because this means there is no need to go back and forth pressing refresh on the 40th level, as the monsters above drop Heroic Spirits too.
The payoff for the next round will be even greater.
After dealing with the monsters there.
They immediately prepared to head for the next area.
At the next level, numerous Fourth Transformation monsters appeared.
However, it wasn’t like before.
With each level passed, the monster level increased by 1 level.
The monsters on the 42nd level started appearing between Level 41 and 42, though mixed in.
Though, for Han Xing and others, this didn’t make much of a difference.
The monsters were wiped out in waves.
After the first couple of levels’ challenges, they had already used their large area group attack Skills, which hadn’t cooled down yet, slowing them down now.

At this moment, Zhang Lianmeng was throwing out Large Fireballs while saying, "Brother Xing, my large area group attack Magics are all on cooldown, I have a new Elf Secret Technique that I haven’t used yet, and it can be used as a Clearing Skill."
"Do you need it now?"
Su Xiaoyang chimed in, "Do you need it now?"
Both women looked at Brother Xing, seeking his decision.

In this level, the monsters’ level had also risen to a minimum of Level 41.
Compared to the monsters below, attributes had greatly increased, making the difficulty skyrocket.
At this time, a system prompt appeared.
[Abyssal Rift, Level 41 challenge starts...]
The next moment.
The entire space seemed to go mad, the ground constantly trembling.
Rumble!
Countless Skeleton Knights, Skeleton Demon Wolves, Skeleton Giant Elephants emerged from the ground.
Apart from these.
More monsters also surged from the mist.
Abyssal Demon Eye, Soul Reaper, Inferior Demon, etc...
They all charged towards Han Xing and others.
Everyone instantly entered a battle state.
Shen Yun raised the Holy Hammer, smashing it fiercely on the ground.
"May the will of the Radiant Divine King illuminate you!"
Bang!
Bang!
Two muffled collision sounds came.
Everyone was endowed with two Blessed States.
The next moment.
Shen Yun and Cheng Jianyong charged into the monster horde first.
"Angel’s Shelter!"
"Iaijutsu Slash!"
The monster horde was instantly blocked!
The next moment, a blue Sword Qi cut across with unmatched force.
Ka-ka-ka!
Countless monsters were cut in half at the waist by this wave of Sword Qi.
In front of Cheng Jianyong, a large area was instantly cleared.
The corners of his mouth also showed a hint of joy, holding a rather cool sword sheathing pose, he said in a pretentious manner: "Did you see that?
This is the power of the Great Sword Master!"
At this moment.
Zhang Lianmeng’s various Elemental Attacks also started pouring out frantically.
"Wind, Fire, Ice, Thunder!"
"The elements of the world, all under my control!"
Rumble!
Lightning and thunder, ice and fire rampaged!
Various large-scale attacks poured down in waves!
The horde was cleared wave after wave.
Beside her, Su Xiaoyang was incessantly unleashing Arrow Rain.
Over time, the Abyssal Monsters were turned into hedgehogs.
After several minutes, everyone let out a sigh of relief as they looked at the mutilated monster bodies and the cleared battlefield.
Compared to Level 40, the monsters here had indeed increased in strength, by quite a bit.
But with everyone’s formidable combined attributes, a single wave of attack could still easily deal a quick resolution.
After dealing with the elite and Leader Monsters inside,
they successfully completed the battle without any danger.
They quickly collected all the loot, stored it in Han Xing’s backpack.
[Acquired Glowing Spirit*4723, Elite Spirit*74, Heroic Spirit*1]
Han Xing felt a burst of joy at the system notification.
"Oh?
There’s a Heroic Spirit here?"
Previously, Han Xing didn’t even expect to find a Heroic Spirit here.
This is good news for Han Xing.
Because this means there is no need to go back and forth pressing refresh on the 40th level, as the monsters above drop Heroic Spirits too.
The payoff for the next round will be even greater.
After dealing with the monsters there.
They immediately prepared to head for the next area.
At the next level, numerous Fourth Transformation monsters appeared.
However, it wasn’t like before.
With each level passed, the monster level increased by 1 level.
The monsters on the 42nd level started appearing between Level 41 and 42, though mixed in.
Though, for Han Xing and others, this didn’t make much of a difference.
The monsters were wiped out in waves.
After the first couple of levels’ challenges, they had already used their large area group attack Skills, which hadn’t cooled down yet, slowing them down now.

At this moment, Zhang Lianmeng was throwing out Large Fireballs while saying, "Brother Xing, my large area group attack Magics are all on cooldown, I have a new Elf Secret Technique that I haven’t used yet, and it can be used as a Clearing Skill."
"Do you need it now?"
Su Xiaoyang chimed in, "Do you need it now?"
Both women looked at Brother Xing, seeking his decision.

chapters.title: Chapter 307 - 245: Old Friends, Great Demon Monarch
paragraphs: Su Xiaoyang and Zhang Lianmeng were both waiting for Han Xing’s opinion.
After thinking for a moment, Han Xing shook his head and said.
"Not for now. I still have a clearing skill. Let’s save yours for the later levels."
Zhang Lianmeng’s forbidden curse hadn’t been used yet, but simply from the skill’s description, everyone could infer its devastating power.
This is their ultimate weapon, to be used only at critical moments.
As for Su Xiaoyang’s Elf Secret Technique, it’s also a rather special skill. If used well, its effect might even rival the forbidden curse.
Han Xing was also reluctant to use it now.
So, for now, they could only use the clearing skill Han Xing had.
The next moment.
He directly shot an arrow into the sky.
This arrow, carrying brilliant starlight, pierced straight into the mist.
The next moment, everyone suddenly felt the mist above their heads trembling incessantly.
Rumble!
Strange sounds echoed.
Everyone looked up, and it was still shrouded in mist.
But they knew.
As long as Han Xing had fired that arrow.
The meteor would surely fall!
Just as they anticipated.
Even in the lightless abyssal rift.
These brilliant meteors still pierced through layers of mist, descending upon this place.
When the first meteor pierced through the mist, falling among the hordes of monsters.
It immediately triggered a massive explosion.
Bang!
Starlight sparkled, energy rampaged.
At least dozens of abyssal monsters were blasted to pieces by this meteor.
However, this was just the beginning.
The next moment.
Hundreds, even thousands of meteors, rained down in waves.
Meanwhile.
In the dim misty region.
A terrifying creature as large as a mountain, with a hundred-meter horn on its forehead, exuding a monstrous evil aura, was roaming the mist.
In its muscular arms, it held a great sword emanating hellish flames.
If Han Xing were here, he would certainly recognize it.
This great sword was the one he had seen in the Dark Elf Camp.
The identity of this terrifying creature was naturally self-evident.
Great Demon Monarch: Julius!
It glanced in the direction of the meteor’s descent, "The abyssal rift has been showing more and more anomalies recently."
"A few days ago, I sensed that Golden Dragon’s aura."
"And that woman also entered the abyssal rift."
"Now, such phenomena are appearing again."
"What exactly are these guys trying to do?"
However, Julius merely glanced and then disinterestedly withdrew his gaze.
"Forget it, it doesn’t concern me unless they approach the edge of the Abyss Realm."
"My current goal is still to oversee that group of Dark Elves, ensuring the construction of a Teleportation Array for my passage."
"Let’s not have a repeat of last time’s unexpected incident!"
Thinking of this, a trace of embarrassment appeared on Julius’s sinister demonic face.
Then, he coughed twice, seemingly trying to cover his awkwardness, quickly regaining composure.
Julius slung the great sword over his shoulder, then glanced upward, "Recently, the summoning array’s frequency has been slowing down."
"Those Dark Elves are useless, given so much help from our Abyss Race, and can only open summoning arrays below the legendary level, still begging us for reinforcements every day."
"What should I send a batch of low-level demons below the legendary level for? To be slaughtered by those Elves?"
Thinking of this, Julius felt more indignant.
"If it weren’t useful to keep you now, I would’ve thrown this group of Dark Dwarves into the Demon Furnace, reduced them to ashes!
Julius snorted coldly.
Then turned to walk deeper into the mist.
However, as he was about to leave, a hint of unease seemed to rise in his heart.
"This aura... why does it feel familiar?"
He looked again towards the area where the meteors fell, shaking his head, "Hopefully, I’m just overthinking it..."
Besides the Great Demon Monarch, Julius.
There were more eyes in this misty world, drawn towards that area.
They also possessed formidable strength, though slightly inferior to Julius, they had subtly touched that tier of power.
All of them moved towards that area.
However, due to the system’s barriers.
These abyssal monsters couldn’t breach the barriers, only glaring at Han Xing and others with furious eyes from within the mist.
Han Xing and the others naturally noticed the numerous pairs of crimson eyes emerging in the mist.
However, they paid no mind.
After all, these creatures couldn’t get in.
Through the exploration of these few layers, he had come to understand the mist’s mechanisms.
Previously, the reason the Skeleton Lord could enter the battle area from the mist to confront Han Xing and others.
Was because it was intentional by the system.
As the strongest boss at the end of the level, the Skeleton Lord appeared every time they entered, representing a power of rules that could be repeatedly engaged.
Thus, it could charge right up to Han Xing and the others.
Monsters not within this mechanism couldn’t enter the combat area.
In other words, the system decides who can enter.
At this moment.
Meteors continued to rain from the sky.
After completing his fourth transformation.
Han Xing’s agility attribute had already surpassed 2500 points.
With Shen Yun’s blessing boost.
It directly reached 3200 points!
This means, he can summon a total of over 3200 explosive meteors!
The monsters on the 43rd floor had already been cleared by him.
However, the Fallen Star Arrow Rain continued to bomb incessantly, scouring the ground over and over.
Until the last meteor fell.
Only then did the commotion gradually subside.
At this moment.
Everyone was gazing at the scene before them with a look of shock.
Cheng Jianyong swallowed his saliva, "Brother Xing’s skill is becoming increasingly terrifying..."
"It feels like even Sister Lian Meng’s Forbidden Curse could only create such an effect, maybe?"
Everyone nodded in strong agreement.
Han Xing’s Fallen Star Arrow Rain, whether in terms of damage coefficient or explosion range, is affected by his own agility.
And his Wild Ranger profession is inherently a high agility growth profession.
Thus, it resulted in an effect comparable to a Forbidden Curse.
At this time, Han Xing shook his head and said, "Compared to the Forbidden Curse, its lethality should still be slightly less."
"But not by much either."
"Alright, let’s not dwell on this, let’s clean up the battlefield and move on to the next floor."
Upon hearing this, everyone began to pick up the scattered materials from the ground.
[Obtained Glowing Spirit *2863, Elite Spirit 354, Heroic Spirit *2, Permanent Gold Ingot...]
Two more Heroic Spirits!
Reaching the 43rd floor, the probability of Heroic Spirit appearance has increased significantly.
So far, apart from the 20 awarded by the system, he has already acquired 4 Heroic Spirits.
This yield can be considered quite impressive.
After all, the amount of materials needed to create an Ancient War Chariot is not much.
Heroic Spirits can build one.
At this moment, the Mist Passage reappeared.
Han Xing directly led the group to the 44th floor.
Now, his Fallen Star Arrow Rain entered a 30-minute cooldown.
But it’s okay, other team members’ group attack skills had already recovered.
Under a reasonable allocation of skills.
They maintained a clearing speed of one floor every ten minutes and started to climb continuously.
Every two floors, basically everyone’s large area skills entered cooldown.
At this time, Han Xing’s Fallen Star Arrow Rain cooldown also ended.
Three floors down, just forming a perfect cycle.
Fighting all the way down.
Everyone progressed without much risk, reaching the 49th floor.
The monster levels here had reached between level 43 and 44.
Exceeding everyone’s levels by 3 to 4.
Although the overage seems not much.
But it’s important to know.
After the Fourth Transformation, each level can greatly increase attributes.
Take Han Xing, this Survivor, for instance.
From level 40 to 41, his four-dimensional attributes could increase by more than 150 points.
Those ordinary monsters also had an increase of more than 200 points.
As for those elites and leaders, the increase would only be more exaggerated.
Not to mention, the more terrifying lords above!
Therefore, no one slacked off.
Rumble!
The ground began to tremble.
At this time, besides Skeleton Soldiers, Vengeful Spirits, Abyssal Demon Eyes, and Inferior Demons.
Some new monsters appeared.
Skeleton Flying Dragons, Two-winged Demon Dragons.
Flying units appeared.
The 49th floor battlefield expanded to over a hundred square kilometers, almost a tenth the size of Xingyu City.
Wider space meant more monsters!
A sky filled with monster tides descended.
By now, everyone gave their all.
Wave after wave of attacks fell.
However, as the last hurdle before the 50th floor.
The difficulty of the 49th floor exceeded everyone’s expectations.
In addition to the number of monsters, the number of elite monsters and leader monsters also multiplied!
It should be noted that leaders and elite monsters cannot be one-shot by group attack skills.
Moreover, these monsters have attack power that poses a threat to everyone.
Even Han Xing, if surrounded by so many Fourth Transformation elite and leader monsters, must take care to face them.
As a large number of ordinary monsters were wiped out, the hidden elites and leaders began to reveal themselves.
Cheng Jianyong and Shen Yun, as melee professions, bore the brunt of the monster assault upfront.
And quickly, they were targeted by those elite and leader monsters.
In no time, dozens of elite monsters and five or six leader monsters surrounded them.
This scenario, even if Zhou Huang and Boundless came, they would be powerless to cope.
Shen Yun was alright.
As a tank profession, he had a host of survival skills and effects, coupled with his formidable defense, he remained unfazed.
Cheng Jianyong was different.
As a Swordsman profession, his armor was Light Armor, far inferior to Heavy Armor in defense.
Moreover, to boost combat power, his equipment effects leaned towards offense.
Once embroiled in a tough battle, the situation could become increasingly unfavorable.
At this moment, Cheng Jianyong was encircled by several Frost Vengeful Spirits and Skeleton Executioners.
In the sky, Skeleton Flying Dragons and Double-winged Demon Dragons, aflame with Undead Flames, descended upon him.
At this moment, Cheng Jianyong gritted his teeth and said, "Damn, ganging up on me?"
"Take this Iaijutsu Slash of mine!"
Clang!
[Flumeg’s Longsword] slashed horizontally, bursting out astonishing Sword Qi!
