chapters.title: Chapter 308 - 246: Divine Skill for Turning the Tables!
paragraphs: Puff puff puff!
The elite monsters charging nearby suffered heavy damage,
at least five or six elite monsters were instantly killed by this wave of Iaijutsu Slash!
Cheng Jianyong’s lips curved into a smug smile.
However, before his smile lasted long, he heard a warning from behind.
"Watch out above!"
As soon as the voice fell, Cheng Jianyong suddenly felt a rush of wind above his head.
A Double-winged Demon Dragon suddenly spat out a black energy ball from its mouth, blasting toward Cheng Jianyong.
Alongside, a Skeleton Winged Dragon flapped its wings, shooting several bone spikes!
Facing an assault from both sides, Cheng Jianyong felt his scalp tingle.
In this critical moment, Cheng Jianyong shouted, "Brother Yun, save me!"
Shen Yun threw a Holy Light Shield at him, along with Angel’s Shelter.
Puff! Puff!
The Holy Light Shield and angelic apparition shattered simultaneously.
Given Shen Yun’s current Spirit Attribute, casting two defense skills back to back barely blocked the attack.
After all, the monsters’ attributes exceeded theirs by far.
Fortunately, Cheng Jianyong narrowly escaped this crisis unscathed.
He decided not to engage in direct confrontation with the elite monsters and opted for caution.
Cheng Jianyong rolled to the ground, hiding behind Shen Yun, both maintaining a back-to-back combat stance.
At this moment, Han Xing commanded, "Focus fire, take down the aerial units first!"
Upon hearing this, Zhang Lianmeng and Su Xiaoyang immediately adjusted the direction of their firepower onslaught.
The next moment, waves of attacks surged into the air.
Puff! Puff!
The airborne Skeleton Winged Dragon and Double-winged Demon Dragon were blasted one by one, falling to the ground.
Seven to eight minutes later, as the monsters were annihilated one after the other, the visible number of enemies before them noticeably dwindled.
The battle was nearing its end.
And then.
In the distant fog, a massive shadow suddenly appeared.
Judging from its size alone, the shadow was at least a hundred meters tall.
It presented as a spherical outline, with its exact form unclear.
Even before it got close, Han Xing felt a surge of overwhelming evil aura.
"It’s coming, the boss at the end of the 49th floor, get ready!" Han Xing warned.
Upon hearing this, everyone hastened their attack motions.
Rumble!
Elite and leader monsters were killed one by one in quick succession.
Meanwhile.
The massive shadow drew closer to the edge of the fog.
The next moment.
It burst out of the fog, appearing before the group!
Now, Han Xing and the others could clearly see the appearance of this monster.
It was a creature towering a hundred meters, resembling a gigantic floating eyeball.
It was a mutated version of the Abyssal Demon Eye, with the entire eyeball veined with blood vessels.
Below the eyeball lay hundreds of dense tendrils that penetrated the ground, supporting its main body.
A display appeared before Han Xing, showing the monster’s attributes.
[Fear Wanderer: Lord-level Creature]
[Level]: 45.
[Attributes]: Power 4324, Agility 4187, Spirit 4854, Constitution 3963.
[Skills]: Domain of Fear, Direct Death Demon Eye, Dark Death Light, Shield of Fear, Abyssal Secret Art - World of Sorrow.
Also a lord-level creature,
this giant single-eyed Fear Wanderer had attributes more than double that of the Skeleton General from the 40th floor!
This as well brought immense pressure on everyone.
As the enormous eyeball approached, a deathly, decaying aura swept over them.
They all simultaneously heard a system prompt.
"You are affected by the skill ’Domain of Fear’ from the Fear Wanderer, reducing magic resistance by 35% and decreasing caused magic damage by 35%."
"Damn it!" Cheng Jianyong couldn’t help but curse.
The others also showed grim expressions.
Just judging from this lord-level creature’s formidable 4800 Spirit Attribute, one could tell.
This was a powerful magic damage-type monster with absurdly high innate magic resistance and magic damage.
When this domain skill activated, it nearly slashed the group’s magic damage output.
Compounded by this, an average Fourth Transformation team would find themselves completely at a disadvantage.
However, it wasn’t too bad for Han Xing’s team.
Because among them, only Zhang Lianmeng belonged to a Magic Series profession.
The others, they could perform physical outputs.
The next moment!
The group’s attacks frantically bombarded forth.
The monstrous eyeball’s enormous size was now serving as a perfect target.
Swish! Swish swish swish!
Arrows imbued with Piercing Power hit the eyeball monster.
However, Han Xing noticed.
When these arrows struck the monster’s body, it was like hitting a pile of sludge, abruptly slowing their momentum.
Then, the flesh on the monster’s body began to squirm as if it sprouted countless mouths, swallowing up these arrows entirely.
Gulp—Gulp—
Even Cheng Jianyong’s attack, when it landed on the monster, only created ripples.
This eerie spectacle left everyone frozen.
Because this phenomenon indicated their attacks failed to break the defense.
With everyone’s top-grade equipment, plus Shen Yun’s group blessing bonus, their Attack Power had been stacked to an extremely terrifying level.
In theory, it was impossible for there to be a situation where they couldn’t break through the defense.
At this time, Han Xing glanced at the skills of this monster, with a look of realization in his eyes.
[Shield of Fear]: Born from the fear of living beings, the Fear Wanderer can cover its body with a layer of fear shield.
Shield Defense Value: 20,000. During the shield’s duration, physical damage is reduced by 40%.
Han Xing said, "It’s this leader’s skill. Our physical damage has been greatly reduced."
Everyone looked toward the skills of this leader, and couldn’t help but twitch at the corners of their mouths.
Cheng Jianyong remarked, "Damn, not only is the magic resistance so high, but the reduction in physical damage is also terrifying. This leader is kind of abnormal, isn’t it?"
Han Xing then said, "No need to worry. The Shield of Fear only has 20,000 Defense Value. As long as we break it, it can’t reduce our physical damage anymore."
Just as he finished speaking, the attack from the leader had already arrived.
Buzz!
A blood-red energy beam shot out from the monster’s eyeball.
Shen Yun directly held up a shield, steadfastly blocking the monster’s impact.
Seeing this, everyone launched various attacks on the monster’s body.
The defense value of the Shield of Fear began to decrease continuously.
But at this rate, it would still take a long time to break the shield’s 20,000 Defense Value.
At this moment, Han Xing glanced to the side.
There was a majestic figure there.
Void Ghost Wolf.
In the 30th layer, Han Xing had released Coal Ball.
However, in the previous layers, they had been dealing with group monsters, so Coal Ball’s advantage hadn’t been revealed.
As a Void Ghost Wolf.
It excels at dealing with single targets.
The stronger the opponent, the more the Void Ghost Wolf’s advantage can be displayed.
At this moment, Han Xing suddenly said.
"Coal Ball, go!"
At this moment, Coal Ball, hearing the command, had the Power of the Void emanating from its body.
In the next instant, its figure flashed.
Instantly appearing above the head of the demon eye monster.
Its wolf claws slashed down!
The demon eye monster’s bloodshot eyeball suddenly widened!
Because it felt its Defense drop significantly!
This is the fear of the Void Ghost Wolf.
No matter the level or power, as long as it gets scratched a few times by it, the defense is weakened by percentage, completely unreasonable.
Everyone’s eyes lit up.
Han Xing shouted loudly, "Full power output!"
Whoosh! Whoosh whoosh whoosh!
The sound of air being cleaved came continuously.
The attacks of Han Xing and the others continuously fell on the leader monster,
The ’Shield of Fear’s’ defense value began to pour out like water.
As a cloud of black smoke rose from the demon eye monster’s body.
The Shield of Fear declared shattered.
In the next moment, Han Xing directly pulled his bowstring and shot an arrow imbued with the aura of a gale.
’Gale·Break.’
Whoosh!
The arrow instantly hit the eyeball, its terrifying piercing power penetrating the entire body, bringing out a trail of blood before disappearing into the mist.
The Demon Eye Lord howled in pain.
The effects of other people’s attacks became much more pronounced.
However, Zhang Lianmeng still couldn’t inflict any significant damage on it.
There was no way; the leader’s magic resistance was simply too high.
The demon eye monster wailed under the attacks of Han Xing and others.
Yet, as a leader-level creature, the Fear Wanderer wasn’t to be underestimated.
It had thousands of tendrils drilling into the ground simultaneously.
The entire battlefield’s surface seemed to come alive, showing various blood-colored veins.
At this time, everyone received a prompt again.
"You are affected by the Fear Wanderer’s skill, World of Sorrow; Movement Speed reduced by 50%, losing 5% Life Value per second."
The ground was covered in dense blood threads, which instantly began to writhe madly.
Everyone simultaneously felt as if something was grabbing their feet.
Every step required tremendous effort.
Walking was incredibly difficult!
Meanwhile, they also felt their Life Force continuously waning.
In contrast, the Demon Eye Lord, after being bombarded by everyone’s attacks, was starting to recover from its wounds at this moment.
This was still because Coal Ball’s skill inherently suppressed healing effects.
Otherwise, the leader monster’s recovery speed would be even more terrifying.
At this moment, seeing everyone trapped, the leader seemed to be preparing another round of attack.
Feeling the situation turning bad, Shen Yun turned his head to ask, "Brother Xing, should we throw out the Sun now?"
Han Xing understood his meaning. The Sun Shen Yun mentioned was a new secret skill he learned after completing the Fourth Transformation.
[Church Secret Technique—Holy Light Shines]: Condenses the Power of Holy Light within and casts it into the air; within the range of the Holy Light, all friendly units cleanse all debuffs.
Moreover, boosts the Spirit*0.5 attributes of the current Radiant Bishop, increases Attack Speed by 100%, restores 10% Life Value per second, all friendly attacks carry the effect of Divine Judgment.
The effect of Holy Light Shines lasts 60 seconds, with a cooldown time of 2 hours.
Friends who have played Holy Knights all know.
The importance of this Sun skill.
It can be said that no matter how dire the situation, as long as the Sun is thrown out, the entire team will feel invigorated, outputting like crazy.
For any team, it’s considered a divine skill that can flip any desperate situation!

this giant single-eyed Fear Wanderer had attributes more than double that of the Skeleton General from the 40th floor!

chapters.title: Chapter 309 - 247: Orange Set and Astonishing Gains!
paragraphs: At this moment.
Trapped in the ’World of Sorrow’ of the Demon Eye Lord, Shen Yun was also preparing to use this skill.
Han Xing thought for a moment and said, "Use it."
Upon hearing this, Shen Yun did not hesitate.
He began to chant.
"May the Radiance of the Saint Master shine upon the world..."
"In the name of the God of Radiance..."
"Church Secret Technique — Holy Light Shines!"
A sacred light emerged from Shen Yun’s Holy Hammer and then abruptly rose above everyone’s heads.
The next moment.
All the fleshy tendrils, dark fog, and cold aura.
At this moment, it all melted away like snow meeting the blazing sun, instantly vanishing!
The Demon Eye Lord sensed something amiss.
However, it was now impossible to interrupt.
Under the illumination of the Holy Light, the fleshy tendrils beneath their feet all emitted hissing smoke.
These tendrils could no longer absorb their life value.
Furthermore, everyone’s attributes saw a significant surge!
Cheng Jianyong casually wielded a sword, inflicting massive wounds on the Demon Eye Lord’s body.
Han Xing and Su Xiaoyang’s arrow attacks also pierced into the monster one by one, with skyrocketing damage.
It can be said that with just Shen Yun alone, a burst of power had elevated their team’s strength by at least two tiers!
With the Demon Eye Lord’s ’World of Sorrow’ broken.
And with its attributes suppressed.
There was no suspense left in the battle.
As the large, fleshy magic eye appeared filled with countless cracks, then with a ’pop’, it shattered into pieces in the air.
The system prompt appeared.
[Successfully killed ’Fear Wanderer’, a Lord-level creature, gained Experience Value: 28.74 million...]
This journey to the Abyssal Rift has so far yielded a large amount of experience for everyone.
Han Xing’s experience bar has already risen by 30%, and the experience bars of the other team members have also increased by 50%.
However, this is not the biggest reward yet.
With an excited look, Han Xing approached the place where the Demon Eye Lord perished.
On the spot, five large red ghost fires were floating.
This means at least five Heroic Spirits.
Han Xing collected them all.
In his backpack, the number of Heroic Spirits had now reached 36,
Han Xing said excitedly, "Great, from layers 40 to 49, we amassed a total of 16 Heroic Spirits."
"Even if we stop here, the harvest from subsequent trips to the Abyssal Rift will at least allow me to build a Demon Elephant War Chariot!"
When Han Xing looked at the pile of loot dropped by the Demon Eye Lord, his eyes lit up even more.
Because among them, he noticed an item made of special material.
Its strange shape seemed to resemble a helmet...
"Helmet?"
Han Xing pondered for a moment: "Could it be..."
He quickly collected the pile of loot on the ground, including the helmet, suddenly hearing the system prompt.
[Obtained Helmet of Fear (Orange) *1, obtained Abyssal Magic Stone *872, obtained Permanent Gold Ingot *18, obtained...]
"It’s equipment indeed!"
Han Xing was overjoyed, and quickly checked the attributes of this helmet.
[Helmet of Fear (Orange) lv45, Quality - Legend, Armor: 274~289, Spirit +300, Hit Rate +20%]
[Attached Effects]: Breath of Fear (Magic Resistance increased by 10%), Dark Amplification (Magic Damage increased by 15%), Direct Death Demon Eye (legendary effect)]
[Note: Fear Wanderer Set 1/5, can be combined with Robe of Fear, Fear Bracelet, Fear Pants, Boots of Fear for set effect.]
[Three-piece Set Attribute: All Attributes increased by 25%, Five-piece Set Attribute: Attack Power increased by 20%, Magic Damage increased by an additional 20%]
[Upon collecting the five-piece set, the set function ’Trembling Spirit’ of ’Fear Wanderer’ can be activated!]
After viewing the attributes of this helmet, Han Xing was utterly shocked!
Powerful!
Undoubtedly, even without the set attributes, the attributes of this helmet are already very formidable.
Even compared to Han Xing’s current level 40 golden helmet, its attributes are twice as high!
Moreover, those special effects are a boon for the magic system profession.
Han Xing’s breathing became a bit rapid.
Because, it’s confirmed now that the Abyssal Rift’s 49th layer has a chance to drop an Orange Set.
Although he didn’t know the probability.
But given their number of entry tickets, Han Xing could definitely speed-run the Abyssal Rift to collect a full Orange Equipment Set!
Coupled with the already terrifying damage of Zhang Lianmeng, equipping a ’Fear Wanderer’ set.
By then, how terrifying would her magic damage become?
Even Han Xing might find himself lacking by comparison!
Thinking of this, Han Xing directly posted the attributes of this helmet to the team channel and said, "Brothers, we’ve got good stuff again."
Everyone also looked to the team channel with a bewildered expression.
"Whoa! Orange Set!"
Cheng Jianyong was incredibly shocked, but upon seeing the helmet’s attributes, he complained slightly, "It’s actually a magic system set, darn it!"
"How great would it be if it was a warrior’s set!"
Hearing this, Shen Yun retracted his longing gaze and gave Cheng Jianyong a sidelong glance.
"Isn’t there a Buxa Golden Set in the lower Abyssal Rift?"
"You, aren’t you satisfied?"
Cheng Jianyong immediately replied, "Can you even compare them?"
"One is a level 40 golden set, the other is a level 45 Orange Set!"
"These two aren’t even on the same level, are they?"
Everyone heard this and didn’t say much in response.
Compared to the Fear Set, the level 40 Buxa indeed pales in comparison.
At this moment, Cheng Jianyong swallowed and said, "Brother Xing, there’s an Orange Set in the Abyssal Rift."
"Shall we come more times next, and try to get a set out for Sister Lian Meng to equip?"

chapters.title: Chapter 310 - 247: Orange Set and Astonishing Gains! (Part 2)
paragraphs: Han Xing nodded and said, "Of course, it’s possible."
"Although we don’t know the drop rate of this set gear, we have plenty of ’Strong Fragments’ in our hands."
"Moreover, our clearing speed is very fast. If we don’t get it in a day, we can farm for several days. We’ll eventually collect a full set."
Everyone, upon hearing this, showed expressions of longing.
Then, Han Xing directly tossed the helmet to Zhang Lianmeng.
Zhang Lianmeng took it in a daze.
When she saw this bizarre helmet with skin deathly pale like a corpse and a bright red eyeball on the forehead, her face turned white, and she instinctively wanted to throw it away.
Han Xing seemed to sense her thoughts and said,
"This equipment, although ugly, has really strong attributes."
"If you can farm a full set, your strength will at least increase by one tier. By then, you might even surpass me and become the strongest in our team."
Upon hearing this, Zhang Lianmeng suppressed her discomfort and asked in confusion, "Really? Then, can I help you shoulder more burdens then?"
Han Xing paused for a moment, then nodded, "Of course, you can. Your increased damage will also greatly benefit us."
Zhang Lianmeng’s discomfort instantly vanished, and she showed a genuine smile.
She seemed not to mind the appearance of the helmet anymore and put it in her backpack, encouraging herself,
"I will work hard to level up, strive to reach level 45 quickly, equip the set gear, and provide more help for Brother Xing!"
This woman becomes incredibly motivated whenever she hears she can assist Han Xing.
Han Xing nodded, saying no more.
These things, he just kept in mind.
After collecting the materials on the ground,
the system prompt appeared again.
[Abyssal Rift Layer 49 cleared successfully, this battle took 17 minutes and 32 seconds...]
[The passage to Abyssal Rift Layer 50 has opened. Please, Brave Squad, decide whether to continue the challenge or exit...]
A deep foggy passage appeared before everyone’s eyes.
Shen Yun asked at this time, "Brother Xing, shall we continue?"
Upon hearing this, Han Xing fell into deep thought.
In the challenge of Layer 49, a level 45 lord had already appeared.
And as the last layer of a reward stage,
the difficulty of Layer 50 will only be higher.
But with higher difficulty comes greater rewards.
It’s possible that the boss at the end might drop a new set gear!
Moreover, the first to clear Layer 50 can obtain a unique first-clear reward!
The first-clear reward of Layer 40 already introduced the ’Spiritual Shock Tower’ as a high-level building.
The blueprint reward for Layer 50 should at least be on par with the Hellfire Missile Silo, right?
Thinking of this, Han Xing was about to choose the challenge.
But the next moment, he was suddenly shocked.
No, wait!
Layer 49 already had lord-level creatures. How powerful would the creatures in the more terrifying Layer 50 be?
Even if he had the confidence to win, it would surely come with great risks.
If an accident happened, resulting in casualties, Han Xing would likely regret it deeply!
Thinking of this, Han Xing suddenly sobered up.
He took a deep breath, then looked at everyone and said, "Let’s stop here for today."
"The final boss on Layer 50 might exceed our strength range. Even if we could win, it would be a narrow victory."
"In this world, we only have one life, so there’s no need to take unnecessary risks."
Upon hearing Han Xing’s words, everyone was a bit surprised.
From the recent battle, although the monsters on Layer 49 were terrifyingly strong, they hadn’t given it their all.
At least Han Xing and Su Xiaoyang hadn’t used the secret skills they learned after their fourth transformation, and Zhang Lianmeng hadn’t used her forbidden curse skills.
Logically, they should be able to push further.
At this moment, Shen Yun couldn’t help but ask, "Brother Xing, aren’t we going to try it?"
"I remember there’s a first-clear reward for Layer 50, right?"
Han Xing shook his head, "No."
"There’s no need to take this risk now."
"Although Layer 50 has a first-clear reward, it seems that other teams haven’t even passed Layer 40."
"So, we should have no competitors, and there’s no need to worry about other teams snatching the reward before us."
"Moreover, we have enough Strong Fragments on hand, and we can always go to the Abyssal Rift."
"There’s no need to rush."
After hearing this, everyone nodded with understanding.
Although Han Xing’s decision seemed somewhat conservative,
they also knew it was for their safety.
And regardless of what, as long as Han Xing made a decision, they would follow his lead.
At this time,
Han Xing directly clicked ’No’.
The next moment, the system prompt came.
"Selection successful. Your team’s highest cleared layer has been recorded. Next time you enter the Abyssal Rift, you can start challenging from layers 1-49 again."
"You will be transported back to the Holy Spirit Realm in ten seconds."
Everyone quietly waited.
After ten seconds,
thick black smoke enveloped everyone again.
Their vision began to change.
Han Xing knew the teleportation had begun.
After a whirlwind sensation,
everyone was back in a familiar place.
Ten Thousand Stars City.
It was already late at night by now.
Unknowingly, they had spent four to five hours in the Abyssal Rift.
At this moment, the night sky over Ten Thousand Stars City was dotted with stars.
Clouds drifted everywhere in the sky.
Compared to the oppressive darkness of the Abyssal Rift,
the scenery of the Holy Spirit Realm was like paradise.
Upon exiting, Han Xing immediately checked his territory to see if it had been attacked.
He noticed something unexpected—some Thunderbolt Towers and Hellfire Missile Silos in his territory had been activated.
This indicated that other creatures had approached Ten Thousand Stars City during their absence.
He looked around suspiciously.
But there were no signs of battle nearby.
Han Xing thought to himself, "No obvious battle traces, and only a few Thunderbolt Towers were activated..."
"This suggests that the enemy wasn’t very strong."
"Probably some wandering Sky Island Monsters that saw Ten Thousand Stars City and tried to land, only to be repelled by the Thunderbolt Towers."
Han Xing also shook his head.
At this moment, everyone was still immersed in the great harvest from the Abyssal Rift.
Cheng Jianyong impatiently asked, "Brother Xing, when are we going to the Abyssal Rift again?"
Han Xing chuckled, "Why in such a hurry? Eager to equip that Golden Armor set?"
Cheng Jianyong laughed, "Yeah, even though that Golden Armor set isn’t as strong as Sister Lianmeng’s Fear Set, it’s much better than the equipment I have!"
"And the most important thing is, it looks cool!"
"Even a skeleton looks imposing wearing it. Won’t I charm many beauties with my looks?"
Cheng Jianyong couldn’t help but be narcissistic.
Han Xing smiled, "I know you’re eager, but hold your horses."
"Next, we’ll dive into the Abyssal Rift continuously, farm until you’re satisfied!"
"But now, it’s late. Let’s rest tonight, and we’ll continue our charge tomorrow."
Beside them, Shen Yun also patted Cheng Jianyong on the shoulder and said, "Hurry and rest."
"Enchanting countless beauties indeed, anything can happen in your dreams."
After that, everyone returned to their respective homes.
Han Xing walked near the City Lord’s Mansion.
Then he opened his backpack and directly learned the newly acquired ’Spiritual Shock Tower’ blueprint.
Now, in his blueprint inventory, there was a new, all-black abyssal building similar to the Guangzhou Tower.
As Han Xing predicted, the ’Spiritual Shock Tower’ lined up with the ’Thunderbolt Tower’, belonging to the same level of advanced defense towers.
Now, the number of high-level blueprints in his inventory was increasing.
This Abyssal Rift journey could be considered very rewarding.
Even the Ancient Weapon he most wanted to create, the Demon Elephant War Chariot, now had all the materials needed!

"Moreover, our clearing speed is very fast.

"If you can farm a full set, your strength will at least increase by one tier.

Then, can I help you shoulder more burdens then?"

Your increased damage will also greatly benefit us."
Zhang Lianmeng’s discomfort instantly vanished, and she showed a genuine smile.

chapters.title: Chapter 311 - 248: Hardworking and Enduring Wolf Cavalry
paragraphs: Looking at the materials in his backpack, Han Xing excitedly said, "Great, finally I can witness the grandeur of the ancient weapons!"
Han Xing directly clicked on Build!
And he built three at once!
The system prompt appeared.
"Constructing ancient weapon: Demon Elephant War Chariot, remaining time 7 hours 12 minutes..."
Han Xing nodded: "Seven hours, not bad!"
"By tomorrow morning, I should be able to see the ancient weapons completed."
Then he clapped his hands and went straight to a good night’s sleep.
However, tonight Zhang Lianmeng slept with him.
Han Xing hugged the beauty and comfortably fell into his dreams.
Next day.
The two felt each other’s warmth and woke up in each other’s arms.
Early in the morning, Han Xing received a system prompt.
"Your territory building: Demon Elephant War Chariot has been constructed successfully..."
Three prompts appeared simultaneously.
This means that all three Demon Elephant War Chariots have been completed.
Han Xing gently got out of bed and covered Zhang Lianmeng with the quilt.
Then he went outside the Lord’s Mansion.
At this time.
On the wide street, there were three giant war chariots with a ferocious appearance and glittering with golden light parked!
These three chariots were almost identical to what was depicted in the blueprints.
Only, compared to the flat images, seeing them in person brought an even more shocking visual impact.
Standing about eight meters tall, even taller than a Golden Armor Puppet.
The chariot’s length approached twelve meters.
Counting the length of the elephant trunk cannon at the front, it was as long as fourteen meters.
It’s truly a colossal entity!
"So strong! The sense of oppression from a single ancient weapon is equivalent to a Four-star Lord!"
The lord Han Xing was talking about was naturally not someone ordinary like Zefer.
But rather a ’Fear Wanderer’, a level 45 Lord!
And this was just the automatic mode of the Demon Elephant War Chariot.
If someone was inside controlling it, the combat power exerted would be even more terrifying!
Han Xing was also satisfied looking at these three ingeniously crafted, masterpiece-worthy ancient weapons.
Then, he directly opened the territory interface and summoned a Wolf Cavalry Guard.
Yes, over this month, Han Xing not only built a large number of Thunderbolt Towers and Hellfire Missile Silos.
But he also established two barracks and the Big-beaked Bird’s Nest.
Now, the number of Wolf Cavalry had broken through a million, and the combined number of Minotaurs and Big-beaked Birds was about the same figure.
Moreover, these units were not ordinary ones.
They were all level 41, powerful creatures with Fourth Transformation strength!
Before long, a group of green figures appeared from afar.
They lined up neatly, a total of ten Wolf Cavalry, marching uniformly towards Han Xing.
Then, these Wolf Cavalry came to Han Xing’s side, performed a knight’s salute together, and respectfully said, "Greetings to the Lord!"
Han Xing nodded.
He looked at the Wolf Cavalry and then at the ancient war chariots, and said, "Today, I have a task for you."
The Wolf Cavalry perked their ears to listen.
"I need you to start taking turns learning to operate these three chariots until you master them."
Upon hearing this, the Wolf Cavalry all looked at the Demon Elephant War Chariots.
And as they saw the ferocious appearance and massive bodies, they all showed a bit of reluctance.
"Lord... Are you sure you want us to learn to operate such equipment?"
Han Xing nodded, "Yes, and not only you; I will also get more Wolf Cavalry involved in training."
"Within ten days, I want to see at least a thousand Wolf Cavalry proficiently operating the ’Demon Elephant War Chariot’."
"Can you accomplish this task?"
The Wolf Cavalry didn’t agree immediately this time; instead, they showed a bit of reluctance on their faces.
Though the Wolf Cavalry were highly skilled in riding skills.
Whether it’s war beast warhorses, they could quickly grasp their habits, establish rapport, and control them.
Controlling a chariot... really was a first-time experience.
Han Xing seemed to have caught onto their thoughts, so he said: "If you think it’s beyond you, it’s alright."
"I can think of another way, summon a batch of more intelligent units to learn to operate these tools."
The group of Wolf Cavalry instantly had grave expressions upon hearing this.
They showed a proud and stubborn expression on their faces, and said loudly, "Lord, please entrust us with the task, we promise to complete it!"
The look in these Wolf Cavalry’s eyes revealed a spirit unwilling to admit defeat.
It seemed they were very dissatisfied with Han Xing’s last remark!
In their knowledge, the Wolf Cavalry was the bravest and most combative race, naturally also the wisest!
Compared to those brash Minotaurs that only know how to smash with pillars or those dumb birds that only know how to use claws and long beaks to attack.
They had long evolved to tame ferocious beasts to assist them in combat.
So now, upon hearing Han Xing say he was going to find a batch of smarter units to operate the Demon Elephant War Chariots.
It immediately stirred up their desire to win.
Han Xing heard this, and a faintly discernible smile appeared at the corners of his mouth.
He looked at these Wolf Cavalry, thought for a moment, then said slowly: "You don’t have to force yourselves to agree, I mentioned that even if you can’t do it, nothing will happen to you."
"As the bravest and most courageous troops in my territory, your performance has been excellent overall."
Han Xing gave a heartfelt praise.
However, upon hearing this, the wolf cavalry became even more anxious.
"Lord, we can do better!"
"That’s right, Lord, please believe us, we can definitely complete the task!"
"You don’t need to find other troops; leave these chariots to us, you can absolutely rest assured!"
Upon hearing this, Han Xing seemed to be caught in hesitation.
The wolf cavalry nervously awaited Han Xing’s decision.
After a moment, Han Xing slowly said, "Alright then, I will continue to entrust this task to you."
These wolf cavalry all let out a long sigh of relief, then displayed a relaxed smile.
Suddenly, Han Xing’s expression turned solemn, "As the most intelligent and courageous race, I believe you can perfectly complete the task!"
Upon hearing Han Xing’s praise, these wolf cavalry were fired up.
And Han Xing’s next words further ignited the fire in their eyes.
"If this task is completed well, I have rewards here."
"Next, the first thousand warriors who master the Demon Elephant War Chariot will each receive a Golden Longsword gifted by myself!"
Upon hearing this, a type of wolf cavalry’s eyes instantly turned red.
To them, a Golden Longsword may not have attributes much stronger than the Silver Swords they wield.
However, this is a weapon personally bestowed by the Lord, a symbol of honor!
And for the wolf cavalry, honor is greater than life!
In an instant, they all raised their Silver Swords and shouted excitedly!
"Ow!"
"Ow!"
"Ow!"
Seeing the enthusiastic looks of the wolf cavalry, Han Xing also smiled.
Then, he waved his hand and said, "Alright, take these three chariots and start training."
Upon hearing this, the wolf cavalry saluted, "Wolf Cavalry, taking orders!"
After speaking, they led the three Demon Elephant War Chariots and began special training.
At this moment.
Shen Yun and Cheng Jianyong were also awakened by the howling of the wolf cavalry.
They both looked with a strange expression at the three ferocious chariots.
Han Xing turned to look at them and said, "Awake?"
"Prepare yourselves; today we will continue to charge into the Abyssal Rift."
Upon hearing this, everyone showed joy on their faces.
Soon after, Su Xiaoyang and Zhang Lianmeng finished freshening up and dressed simply before arriving at Han Xing’s sides.
Then, all five simultaneously crushed the Stronger’s Mark in their hands.
[Abyssal Rift Teleportation Channel has been established. Since your team has a clearance record, please select entry level, 1-49 levels...]
Han Xing contemplated briefly, then chose level 30 directly.
[Teleporting, target level: 30...]
The group’s vision went dark, initiating the teleportation phase.
At the same time.
In the vast Witch Race Territory, a region millions of kilometers away from Han Xing and his team.
A huge Sky Island floated in mid-air.
Covered densely with various True Spirit Towers, Tower of Witch Souls, and other advanced defense towers.
And most importantly.
Besides these advanced defense towers.
At the center of this Sky Island, there’s a colossal building over a thousand meters high, like a statue.
This statue’s exterior resembles a sort of fierce beast, exuding an astonishing killing aura.
The surface of the statue looked like it was splashed with a blood-red color.
This indicated, when creating this building, a massive amount of Philosopher’s Stone must have been used!
And the Philosopher’s Stone is a material used for crafting Divine Artifacts.
This building must possess unimaginable power.
Besides these defense towers, around the Sky Island various steel war chariots float, along with waves of well-equipped flying troops.
In terms of firepower strength alone, this is even more fearsome than Wu Ling’Er’s main city.
Moreover, in this region, there’s more than one Sky Island of this firepower level.
Throughout the region, there’s at least a thousand such Sky Islands of varying sizes.
They are spaced apart, forming a stringent steel defense line.
Even a Legendary Level powerhouse arriving would get struck a couple of blows; a slight misstep, and they would fall here.
And this is one of the defense lines of the Witch Race Territory.
At this moment, in a conference hall.
A dozen Witch Race officers surrounded a conference table, silent.
They all directed their gaze towards the middle-aged Witch Race male in the leading seat, seemingly waiting for him to speak.
Before him was placed a plaque labeled [Third Corps Commander].
However, the Witch Race officer did not speak, instead looking at the person sitting opposite him.
A woman.
Legendary Powerhouse, Feienna.
The curvaceous Feienna lay on a spacious chair in a reclined position.
Resting her head on the armrest, she lightly raised her delicate feet, occasionally popping a pale fruit into her mouth.
Every swallow produced a sound of satisfaction...
Making the group of officers stare with wide eyes.

In terms of firepower strength alone, this is even more fearsome than Wu Ling’Er’s main city.
Moreover, in this region, there’s more than one Sky Island of this firepower level.
Throughout the region, there’s at least a thousand such Sky Islands of varying sizes.
They are spaced apart, forming a stringent steel defense line.
Even a Legendary Level powerhouse arriving would get struck a couple of blows; a slight misstep, and they would fall here.
And this is one of the defense lines of the Witch Race Territory.
At this moment, in a conference hall.
A dozen Witch Race officers surrounded a conference table, silent.
They all directed their gaze towards the middle-aged Witch Race male in the leading seat, seemingly waiting for him to speak.
Before him was placed a plaque labeled [Third Corps Commander].
However, the Witch Race officer did not speak, instead looking at the person sitting opposite him.
A woman.
Legendary Powerhouse, Feienna.
The curvaceous Feienna lay on a spacious chair in a reclined position.
Resting her head on the armrest, she lightly raised her delicate feet, occasionally popping a pale fruit into her mouth.
Every swallow produced a sound of satisfaction...
Making the group of officers stare with wide eyes.

chapters.title: Chapter 312 - 249: Witch Race Conference, the Mysterious Woman
paragraphs: "Mmm... Delicious, delicious!"
"I never expected to enjoy such tasty food in such a remote place, it’s truly wonderful..."
Feienna, like a child, wore a look of satisfaction on her face.
The officers exchanged strange glances.
At this moment, the middle-aged Witch Race man sitting at the head of the table said sternly, "Priest Feienna, this is a meeting; please be more serious."
Upon hearing this, Feienna glanced at him and then continued to eat on her own.
She seemed to completely ignore him.
The officer, seeing this, his gaze turned cold, seemingly unfazed by Feienna’s status as a Legendary Powerhouse.
He swept a glance at Feienna and let out a cold laugh.
Then he said to the other officers, "The meeting is now starting."
"Before that, I have a few things to say."
"Recently, the frequency of raids by the Shadow Legion has decreased, giving us more time to develop."
"But we cannot be negligent; the more it seems like this, the more vigilant we must remain."
"These Shadow Fangs are extremely cunning, always launching surprise raids on our Witch Race Territory."
"Recently, we must intensify the training of Warriors to be ready for war at any moment!"
After the officer finished speaking, the other Witch Race officers nodded in agreement.
At this point, a Witch Race officer with a slightly sunken nose echoed, "General Korden is absolutely right."
"These Shadow Fangs, in recent years, have been targeting us, the Witch Race, raiding our critical resource areas and populous main cities everywhere."
"A few years ago, they even forced us to tighten our defenses."
"Now the Elf Race’s Holy Tree is destroyed, causing the space in the entire Holy Spirit Realm to become increasingly unstable."
"Unexpectedly, this has given us a breather."
"Now, those Shadow Fangs are wary of the space turbulence in the Witch Race Territory and dare not teleport as recklessly as before."
"And we only need to hold these important areas, and the Shadow Legion will be at a loss against us."
Upon hearing this, the crowd also broke into slight smiles of relief.
However, at this moment, Commander Korden couldn’t bring himself to smile at all.
He asked with a very serious expression, "What... are you all smiling at?"
"Have we, the Witch Race, not learned enough harsh lessons at the hands of the Shadow Legion?"
"Don’t forget the Xian Royal City incident decades ago—didn’t the deaths of tens of billions of our kin get your attention?"
"The Shadow Legion’s strength far exceeds our imagination, even enough to annihilate the entire Witch Race."
"The calmer the enemy appears, the less we can afford to let our guard down!"
"Do you all understand?"
In the face of his questioning.
The Witch Race officers were as silent as cicadas in winter, not daring to breathe loudly.
The atmosphere of the meeting became somewhat oppressive.
Yet amidst this oppressive atmosphere.
The crowd suddenly heard a pleasant chuckle.
"Oh my... Commander Korden truly is irritable, isn’t he?"
"Keeping your nerves tense for a long time isn’t good for your health, you know."
Upon hearing this, Commander Korden immediately turned to Feienna.
Although he was not a legend, he seemed completely indifferent to legendary power.
Korden said in a deep voice, "Priest Feienna, I hope you won’t interrupt when I’m speaking."
"Your previous behavior was already the most tolerance I’ve shown you."
"Here, regardless of whether you’re a priest or whatever your identity, everyone must listen to me."
Feienna listened but remained unmoved, twisting her graceful figure on the large chair before shifting to a more comfortable position.
"Mmm... Just make sure your subordinates listen to you."
"But don’t count me in~
"I have my own way of doing things."
Feienna stretched lazily, inadvertently revealing a patch of smooth skin, causing the officers to stare wide-eyed.
This woman, carrying an innate seductive aura, was simply an amplifier of desire.
However, Korden remained unmoved.
He snorted coldly, "Feienna, what you say doesn’t count."
"Here, I won’t allow a second voice to emerge, especially during wartime."
"Considering your identity as one of the Thirteen Priests, I won’t normally restrict you."
"But during wartime, you must follow my orders to the letter."
"If I order you to charge, you must charge. If I order you to kill, you must kill."
"Whether the enemy is a Dominator or a Legend, even at the risk of your life, you must execute my command!"
He spoke firmly.
As if he hadn’t considered Feienna’s legendary status at all.
In his eyes, he didn’t see Feienna as a woman at all.
But regarded her as a powerful weapon of war.
At this time, even with Feienna’s good temper, she couldn’t help but become angry.
She sprang to her feet, standing barefoot on the chair, and said angrily, "Korden, how dare you speak to this priest that way!"
"Do you really think you can do as you please just because this is the Witch Race Border?"
"Don’t forget, I’m the Thirteen Priest personally appointed by the Lord Saint Master, not someone you can order around at will."
However, upon hearing this, Iker coldly laughed.
"Is that so? But as I recall, you came to the Witch Race Border carrying a crime, seeking to atone with meritorious deeds, didn’t you?"
"A priest who persecuted her kin for the position of Saintess cannot earn my respect."
These words could be said to completely tear apart their facade.
Feienna clenched her fists, exuding killing intent, "Do you... want to die?"
At this moment, a Legendary Level aura burst forth.
The entire council hall was filled with a deathly oppressive presence,
yet Korden remained unfazed.
Despite only having the power of someone at the Peak of Tier Four, Korden’s face did not change under the pressure of Feienna’s presence.
It was as if he had weathered many storms without even a furrowed brow.
Korden scoffed: "Feienna, don’t think you can suppress me with your legendary presence."
"Here, this is the Third Legion of the Witch Race, boasting hundreds of millions of elite Witch Race soldiers."
"And I’ve earned my place here not by just flapping my lips."
"I’ve killed Legendary Powerhouses before, Feienna, do you want to try me?"
Korden clenched his fists, eyes shining with intense war intent.
Opposite him, Feienna’s expression shifted.
That’s when she remembered Iker’s title.
Godslayer—Korden.
In his career record, he had slain no less than three renowned figures within the Shadow Legion!
This was not because Korden’s own power was exceedingly strong, slaying legends with the strength of a Tier Four.
Rather, it was his unparalleled strategic and formation prowess.
Even a Legendary Level powerhouse could not immediately escape when encircled by Korden’s army.
But now, with the distance between them, Feienna could absolutely burst forth and end his life in a fraction of a second.
Yet, as if Korden read her mind, he asked: "Feienna, have you thought it through?"
"Right now, I have no bodyguards, nor can I immediately summon chariots to besiege you."
"Do you want to try killing me now?"
His tone hinted at an eagerness, almost hoping Feienna would strike him.
However, the more Korden spoke, the less confident Feienna felt.
Under the gaze of both commanders.
Feienna’s face turned bright red with frustration.
The next moment, she stomped her foot, exclaiming angrily: "Damn you, Korden!"
"You’re all bullying me!"
With that, Feienna’s figure disappeared.
The officers looked at each other in bewilderment.
They too saw Feienna’s reaction before she left, all showing curious expressions.
Korden, however, was not surprised at all.
He knew Feienna wouldn’t dare to make a move.
Then Korden continued: "Alright, let’s resume the meeting."
At that moment, after leaving the council hall, Feienna flashed into her bedroom.
She flung herself onto the bed, covering her head with a pillow, venting her anger.
"Ahhh! Damn it, damn it, damn it!"
"All of these guys are bullying me one by one!"
"This woman Wu Ling’Er hit me, the High Priest punished me, and now even a four-tiered ant dares to provoke me!"
"I’m so mad, I’m so mad, I’m so mad!!"
As she spoke, Feienna’s voice took on a sobbing tone.
"Why... Lord Saint Master clearly said I could inherit the position of Saintess..."
She seemed extremely aggrieved.
At that moment, the lights in the bedroom suddenly dimmed.
Feienna’s expression changed, her tear marks instantly vanished.
"Who’s there?"
In the next moment, she saw a Black Shadow standing before her.
The silhouette was graceful, with a robe trailing to the ground and a hood on its head.
It looked at Feienna, letting out a hollow laugh.
"Hehehe..."
"To think that the little girl I rescued hundreds of years ago would grow to this extent."
"Feienna... do you remember me?"
Upon hearing this, Feienna’s eyes seemed to flash with contemplation, then she exclaimed in shock: "It’s you?"
Feienna immediately became vigilant.
She clearly knew how terrifying this woman was.
The hooded woman, seeing Feienna recall, continued with a light laugh: "It seems you remember."
"So, do you remember the promise you made me back then?"
Feienna’s body stiffened, her legs straightened, ten delicate toes tightly clinching together.
She did not answer, seemingly engulfed in great fear.
A moment later, the hooded woman said: "You remember, don’t you?"
"Back then, you promised me that if I rescued you and granted you great power, you would offer your soul."
"Now, Feienna, it’s time to fulfill that promise!"
Feienna shook her head continuously as the woman slowly approached her.
"No! I cannot give my soul to you!"
"I haven’t become the Saintess yet! I have very important things to do!"
However, the hooded woman did not heed her plea.
Instead, she extended a hand, slowly reaching for Feienna.
Feienna’s expression grew grave.
The next moment, a Legendary Level aura burst forth!

chapters.title: Chapter 313 - 250: Powerful Set Bonus!
paragraphs: At the same time.
Han Xing and others, currently undergoing an Abyssal Rift transfer, experienced a few seconds of darkness.
Their vision was restored.
When they opened their eyes, they found themselves back in the fog-filled Abyssal Rift.
The system prompt appeared.
[Transfer complete. Current scene: Abyssal Rift: Floor 30...]
[The challenge is about to begin. Please Survivor, be prepared.]
The group exchanged glances and entered battle mode.
They had already cleared Floor 30 once and were quite familiar with the power of the monsters inside.
As the Skeleton Army on the ground and the Ghost Army in the mist charged at them,
everyone’s attacks burst out simultaneously.
Rumble!
A few minutes later, two Level 30 Leader Monsters were decapitated by Cheng Jianyong with a single sword stroke.
The system prompt appeared.
[Floor 30 challenge is completed in 3 minutes and 21 seconds...]
Cheng Jianyong laughed, "Hey! I remember last time on Floor 30, it took us almost four minutes."
"This time we shaved off half a minute."
"At this rate, our clear progress will be faster and faster!"
Everyone laughed as well.
Then they continued into the first layer of the Abyssal Rift.
Poof! Poof poof poof!
Monster after monster fell under their attacks.
The following levels were cleared in three to four minutes each.
Until they reached Floor 40 of the Abyssal Rift, where they encountered once again the Skeleton General clad in Golden Battle Armor, Buxa!
At this moment, Cheng Jianyong, seeing him, advanced as if seeing a smooth-skinned beauty.
Uttering strange howls as he ran.
"Buxa, watch me strip you naked!"
Buxa could not understand Cheng Jianyong’s bold words.
Seeing the human charging forward, it seemed somewhat surprised.
Yet, it still let out a cold snort.
The Golden Spear in its hand thrust forward sharply.
The next moment.
Cheng Jianyong flickered, jumping high into the air.
Sudden Burst of Killing Intent!
"Ha... Take my sword!"
Eagle Fall Slash!
A sword slashed downwards, and the poor Buxa didn’t have time to react before being knocked off its feet again.
Then it faced a barrage of attacks from everyone.
After a rather painful thrashing.
Buxa was once again reduced to a pile of bone fragments.
However, this time, no equipment dropped from Buxa.
Though they knew items like such sets wouldn’t drop easily,
everyone still felt a bit disappointed.
But soon, they regained their confidence.
Because ahead, an even more powerful Orange Set was waiting for them!
Star River Squad began speeding through.
In two hours, they reached Floor 49 of the Abyssal Rift once more.
This was where they had encountered the ’Fear Wanderer’.
After clearing a massive number of Abyssal Monsters, the Level 45 Lord ’Fear Wanderer’ appeared again.
But compared to the last time,
the group handled it with greater ease.
Coal Ball unleashed a burst, reducing its defense.
Then everyone concentrated their attacks, breaking the ’Fear Wanderer’s Magic Shield.
Afterwards, it was an overwhelming crush.
In fifteen minutes, the ’Fear Wanderer’ was shattered into pieces again.
But this time, they didn’t get new pieces of the Fear Set.
At this moment, Cheng Jianyong couldn’t help but complain: "Damn, not a single piece of equipment dropped!"
"Is our luck really that bad?"
Shen Yun shook his head and analyzed, "It might not be our bad luck; it’s likely the normal rate for the Abyssal Rift."
"You have to know, these are set items. Any Survivor with a set can see their attributes skyrocket.
"Such powerful equipment naturally doesn’t drop often."
Cheng Jianyong then asked, "Then how did we manage to get two pieces last time?"
Shen Yun shrugged, "Maybe it was the system’s first clear reward."
"The first time always guarantees a set drop; after that, it’s all luck."
Hearing this, everyone felt it made some sense and nodded in agreement.
Although no sets dropped from the run,
they still gained a lot of good stuff from this Abyssal Rift expedition.
Among them, they gathered 4597 Abyssal Magic Stones, 121 Permanent Gold Ingots, and several thousand pieces of Mithril.
Additionally, the boss at the end dropped a total of 3 pieces of Golden Equipment.
Plus, they obtained 17 Heroic Spirits!
The rewards were quite impressive!
Besides these materials and equipment, they also gained loads of experience!
From Floor 30 to Floor 49.
The experience bars of Zhang Lianmeng and others increased by about 40%.
Since Han Xing was one level higher than them, his experience gain was 20%.
At this rate, a few more runs will get everyone leveled up!
At this point, Cheng Jianyong excitedly exclaimed, "Brother Xing, I’m just 10% away from reaching level 41!"
"This Abyssal Rift is truly a great place!"
Han Xing nodded.
It is indeed a great place. Just the yield from one run, in Abyssal Magic Stones alone, is enough for him to set up two or three Spiritual Shock Towers.
And with the gain in Heroic Spirits, just two runs can get him three Demon Elephant War Chariots!
Considering that each run takes two hours.
They could potentially speed-run the Abyssal Rift seven to eight times in a day!
However, the reason they could reap such rich rewards was mainly because Han Xing and his team managed to clear enough layers.
Currently, most Survivor squads stop at Floor 30 of the Abyssal Rift.
Even the fastest squad, Boundless, is still stalled at Floor 39, not daring to challenge Floor 40.
So, this is also Han Xing and his team’s advantage.
Thinking of this, Han Xing, leading the team, teleported out of the Abyssal Rift.
Next up.
They teleported back in once more.

Additionally, the boss at the end dropped a total of 3 pieces of Golden Equipment.
Plus, they obtained 17 Heroic Spirits!
The rewards were quite impressive!
Besides these materials and equipment, they also gained loads of experience!
From Floor 30 to Floor 49.
The experience bars of Zhang Lianmeng and others increased by about 40%.
Since Han Xing was one level higher than them, his experience gain was 20%.
At this rate, a few more runs will get everyone leveled up!
At this point, Cheng Jianyong excitedly exclaimed, "Brother Xing, I’m just 10% away from reaching level 41!"
"This Abyssal Rift is truly a great place!"
Han Xing nodded.
It is indeed a great place.
Just the yield from one run, in Abyssal Magic Stones alone, is enough for him to set up two or three Spiritual Shock Towers.
And with the gain in Heroic Spirits, just two runs can get him three Demon Elephant War Chariots!
Considering that each run takes two hours.
They could potentially speed-run the Abyssal Rift seven to eight times in a day!
However, the reason they could reap such rich rewards was mainly because Han Xing and his team managed to clear enough layers.
Currently, most Survivor squads stop at Floor 30 of the Abyssal Rift.
Even the fastest squad, Boundless, is still stalled at Floor 39, not daring to challenge Floor 40.
So, this is also Han Xing and his team’s advantage.
Thinking of this, Han Xing, leading the team, teleported out of the Abyssal Rift.
Next up.
They teleported back in once more.

chapters.title: Chapter 314 - 250: Powerful Set Bonus!
paragraphs: Then they started the challenge from the 30th floor.
After rushing through the Abyssal Rift three times consecutively.
The whole group leveled up.
Zhang Lianmeng and Su Xiaoyang, among others, all reached level 41.
While Han Xing reached level 42, his attributes saw a significant increase.
The experience required for the next level once again multiplied.
However, this was within their expectations.
Later on, the experience required for each level up becomes increasingly alarming.
Apart from those materials and experience, they hadn’t found any Golden Set or Orange Set items.
The group roughly deduced.
The drop rate for this type of set was indeed very low.
Previously, their consecutive drops were purely due to the first-clear status bonus.
After that, it was all down to chance.
And when Han Xing and the others challenged the Abyssal Rift for the fifth time.
They came again to the 40th floor, in front of the Skeleton General: Buxa.
With plenty of experience.
Now, they were quite familiar with this Lord’s skills.
After a brief encounter.
Buxa, before he could even charge, was picked off his horse by Cheng Jianyong with a bewildered look.
But then, a round of focus fire.
The poor Buxa couldn’t even use a skill before being pummeled into a heap of bone debris by the group again.
But this time, Han Xing saw that laying silently on Buxa’s body was a golden battle spear.
Everyone’s eyes lit up.
Cheng Jianyong rushed over first, excitedly saying, "It dropped! It finally dropped!"
"Buxa’s Golden Battle Spear! Hahaha!"
Seeing his excited look, the group also smiled.
After five explorations and twelve hours, they finally got a set piece.
This probability could be considered both low and high.
At least for Han Xing and the others, it was quite a nice drop.
The Golden Battle Spear, like the Longsword, is a melee weapon.
The Swordsman and Berserker professions in the Warrior class can equip it.
However, using the battle spear to perform skills will alter the attack stance accordingly.
For instance, the ’Iaijutsu Slash’ skill, when released using the battle spear, will unleash a destructively powerful spear qi.
Transforming from an area attack to a linear attack.
Although the attack power will increase significantly.
Good things come in pairs.
Next, at the 49th floor’s ’Fear Wanderer’, they found an Orange Set piece.
[Fearful Gloves (Orange) lv45, Quality: Legend, Armor: 180~194, Attack Speed +20%, Magic Damage +10%.]
Everyone’s faces showed joy.
Now, two pieces of the Fear Set’s five-piece set have dropped.
Although the Fear Set is level 45 equipment, Zhang Lianmeng still needed some time to equip it.
But with their current leveling speed, reaching level 45 wasn’t much of a hurdle.
Perhaps by the time they collected the full Fear Set, Zhang Lianmeng would be level 45.
When the day’s intense battle was over.
The group tallied their gains.
They explored the Abyssal Rift a total of eight times, taking 17 hours.
They gained a total of 37289 Abyssal Magic Stones and 106 Heroic Spirits.
As well as two set items, a Golden Battle Spear (Gold) and a Fear Bracelet (Orange).
Then, Han Xing used all the materials gained today to forge Hellfire Missile Silo and Demon Elephant War Chariot.
This time, Han Xing waved his hand generously, and directly raised eleven Demon Elephant War Chariots in one go!
Then, he clapped his hands satisfactorily and went back to rest.
Next day...
Han Xing woke up from his dreams.
Once again hearing the completion notice for the Demon Elephant War Chariot.
When he walked out of the Lord’s Mansion, he immediately saw eleven towering, formidable ancient weapons lined up on the street.
Han Xing nodded in satisfaction and said, "Very good, one Demon Elephant War Chariot’s combat power is equivalent to a Fourth Transformation Lord."
"If this pack of Wolf Cavalry can master it proficiently, it would be even stronger."
"Eleven chariots together might even challenge a Fourth-Turn Dominator level creature!"
"Against a Fifth Transformation Legend, although there’s still no assurance, it’s close!"
Han Xing, with an excited gaze, summoned a troop of Wolf Cavalry.
Then, he had this group of Wolf Cavalry, along with the Demon Elephant War Chariots, join the training regimen.
Next, Han Xing and his team continued to rush through the Abyssal Rift.
The whole day through, they once again cleared the Abyssal Rift eight times.
However, on the second day’s speed run through the Abyssal Rift, they did not find any set items.
They did earn a lot of experience points though.
Han Xing used the materials collected from the Rift to forge more Abyss Technology and Ancient Weapons.
On the third day, they continued exploring the Abyssal Rift.
The days repeated in this cycle.
Time flew by, and half a month had passed.
Half a month later.
The vast Ten Thousand Stars City remained in its original place.
After so long, the territory of Ten Thousand Stars City hadn’t expanded at all.
Compared to the near-rapid expansion of the previous month, now it’s almost at a standstill.
This was because Han Xing had been continuously exploring the Abyssal Rift for the past half month.
Thus, pausing the development of Ten Thousand Stars City.
However, although the territory size didn’t increase much.
But Han Xing and the others had undergone a tremendous change in strength.
Now, all five members of the Star River Squad have reached level 45.
Their attributes have increased significantly!
Moreover, they also exchanged a large number of Golden Treasure Chests at the Battle Merit Store, opening many level 45 pieces of equipment, further boosting their strength.
In half a month’s time, they practically completed the progress that would take other Survivors half a year, or even a year.
It was truly astonishing!
At this moment.
On the opposite street, a towering Golden Armor Warrior suddenly appeared.
Every step he took emitted a creaking metallic sound.
Under the curious gaze of the crowd, this Golden Armor Warrior raised the golden battle spear in his hand, and excitedly said.
"Hahaha! The last Buxa Set piece finally dropped for me!"
"The attribute boost from the eight-piece set is truly incredible, so exhilarating!"
This man, shouting and in full golden armor, armed to the teeth, was Cheng Jianyong.
In half a month’s time, after numerous explorations of the Abyssal Rift.
They finally managed to get the complete Buxa Set.
Even though it’s just level 40 equipment, it brought him at least a 40% damage increase.
In addition to other attributes and set effects.
Cheng Jianyong can now withstand the Demon Eye Lord ’Fear Wanderer’s’ attacks for a full minute, holding his ground.
Note, this is only in a solo situation.
If he has the support of his teammates, that Demon Eye Lord won’t even be able to touch the hem of Cheng Jianyong’s clothes.
This made him increasingly arrogant.
However, before Cheng Jianyong could relish his victory for long.
A woman, clad in a Pale Robe and wearing a Demon Eye Helmet, slowly approached the group.
She exuded a cold and sinister aura all over.
Before she even got close, the group felt her imposing presence.
As if the Demon Eye Lord had reappeared.
However, when the figure slowly lifted her head, the group saw an absolutely beautiful face.
And beneath the Pale Robe, a striking figure that couldn’t be ignored.
This person was none other than Zhang Lianmeng, fully equipped with the ’Fear Set’.
Even though the set’s appearance was somewhat terrifying, it didn’t diminish the beauty she exuded.
As if evil and holiness, two contrasting auras manifested simultaneously within this woman.
Faced with the group’s gaze, Zhang Lianmeng shyly lowered her head.
At this moment, Han Xing walked over and said, "Changed?"
"Yes." Zhang Lianmeng lightly nodded her head.
Han Xing also examined her for a moment, then continued to ask.
"How does it feel?"
Zhang Lianmeng showed a slight smile on her face, "It feels quite good."
"This set, although a Magic-Type Equipment, has high defense."
"Moreover, it greatly boosts attributes, with all five pieces combined, it has increased 1200 points of Spirit, boosting my Magic Damage by more than 50%, and with the set effect..."
"The actual damage increase is more than double!"
After hearing Zhang Lianmeng’s description, the group couldn’t help but gulp.

chapters.title: Chapter 315 - 251: Mutual Development, Power Boost
paragraphs: The enhancement of the Fear Set is extremely formidable!
At Han Xing’s level, the damage has already reached a very terrifying degree.
Even a casual 10% increase can bring a very high amplification effect.
Now hearing Zhang Lianmeng say, that the Fear Set has doubled her magic damage, just thinking about it is deeply shocking.
If it’s Zhang Lianmeng in this state, a large fireball might be unbearable even for Shen Yun!
Next to them.
Su Xiaoyang held Zhang Lianmeng’s arm, happily saying, "Sister Lian Meng is so amazing!"
"Brother Han Xing was right, your damage is already the highest among all of us!"
Shen Yun and Cheng Jianyong also praised repeatedly.
Facing everyone’s compliments, Zhang Lianmeng lowered her head, tightly clutching the corner of her magic robe with her right hand, appearing very embarrassed.
However, although the attributes of the set are extreme, it was within Han Xing’s expectations.
After all, even the attributes of scattered pieces of Orange Equipment are very formidable.
Moreover, what Zhang Lianmeng has on is a level 45 Orange Set!
This enhancement was indeed within expectations.
At this moment, Shen Yun suddenly asked, "Brother Xing, what’s our task today? Should we continue grinding Abyssal Rift, rushing levels?"
Han Xing thought for a moment, then said, "Today, we won’t continue with Abyssal Rift."
"Now that Cheng Jianyong and Lian Meng’s sets are complete, the goal is considered achieved."
"Our levels have also been raised to level 45."
"I’ve calculated that even if we maintain our current speed, it will take at least ten more days to reach level 46."
"The experience required becomes more terrifying as we progress."
"So, Abyssal Rift can be paused for now."
"We’ll proceed when we are ready to challenge higher layers."
Upon hearing this, everyone nodded.
Han Xing then continued, "Next, let’s keep exploring the Sky Island and expand the territory of Ten Thousand Stars City."
Upon hearing this, everyone’s eyes lit up, and they nodded in agreement.
"Alright!"
Next, Ten Thousand Stars City continued to advance in the vast Witch Race Territory.
At this moment, Han Xing stood at the highest point of the Lord’s Mansion.
Gazing at the distant Wolf Cavalry army, taking turns learning to control the Demon Elephant War Chariots.
Although a portion of the chariots were still somewhat clumsy in their actions.
Among them, Han Xing saw that the movements of several chariots had reached a flexible level.
This indicates that some of the Wolf Cavalry have gradually become proficient in controlling the Demon Elephant War Chariots.
Seeing their efforts, Han Xing nodded in satisfaction.
Over these days, he has harvested 306 Heroic Spirits, and can make a total of 30 Demon Elephant War Chariots.
However, he has only crafted 22 Demon Elephant War Chariots so far.
The reason he didn’t continue crafting is because his reserves of Philosopher’s Stones are insufficient.
It takes 50 Philosopher’s Stones to craft a Demon Elephant War Chariot.
Crafting 22 chariots consumed 1,100 of them.
Now, in Han Xing’s warehouse, there are only a little over 1,000 Philosopher’s Stones left.
Moreover, these remaining Philosopher’s Stones are reserved for crafting the Oracle Throne.
He wouldn’t use them unless absolutely necessary.
At this moment, Han Xing sighed and said, "Philosopher’s Stones are a major gap..."
"Not only do Divine Artifacts need them, but crafting Ancient Weapons also requires a lot."
"Including that Holy Artifact, the amount of Philosopher’s Stones needed is even more exaggerated."
"If I were to rely solely on myself to collect that many Philosopher’s Stones, who knows how long it would take...
Thinking of this, Han Xing sighed again.
As for the source of Philosopher’s Stones, Han Xing also has a solution in mind.
It’s to take a batch of Space Backpacks and find Wu Ling’Er to trade for a lot of Divine Stones.
With the Witch Race’s resource reserves, the quantity of such rare ores must be considerable.
And these Powerhouses have a strong demand for Space Backpacks.
Therefore, this is a win-win trade.
However, to trade with the Witch Race, there’s a major prerequisite.
That is, he must have the strength to threaten or even kill Legendary Powerhouses.
This isn’t because Han Xing doesn’t trust Wu Ling’Er.
Rather, it’s because he doesn’t trust the other Powerhouses of the Witch Race.
Because, as soon as Han Xing starts trading with Wu Ling’Er, when a large quantity of Space Items flows into the hands of those Powerhouses.
It will surely draw their attention.
And they will try every means to trace the source of these Space Items.
Then, combining with Han Xing’s Human Race identity.
They would immediately deduce whose hands these Space Items come from.
By then, it might bring a disaster upon himself.
Han Xing’s expression became serious, and he murmured, "So, until I have the strength to deal with Legends, I can’t approach Wu Ling’Er."
"Nor can I reveal the fact that I have a large number of Space Backpacks."
He gazed at his territory, a trace of a worried expression flashed across his face.
Compared to a month and a half ago, the development on Han Xing’s side has indeed been incredibly rapid.
But asking himself, Han Xing knew there was still a long way to go before he could threaten the legends.
Moreover, he always felt that something big was about to happen recently.
This was a kind of intuition for Han Xing.
The last time he had this feeling was on the eve of the blood tide burst.
Though this premonition was not always one hundred percent accurate, it’s good to be prepared beforehand.
However, although anxious, Han Xing had no immediate solution at hand right now.
As previously mentioned.
Things need to be tackled step by step; steady development is the way.
Ten Thousand Stars City kept moving, starting to explore in the vast Witch Race Territory...
At the same time, the development of Xingyu City over there was also gradually getting on track...
Land of the Abandoned Gods.
Inside Xingyu City.
Compared to more than half a month ago, Xingyu City welcomed another round of changes.
Firstly, the territorial area surged nearly five to six times, reaching over ten thousand square kilometers.
On it were bustling crowds and groups of well-equipped Wolf Cavalry Guards shuttling back and forth on the streets.
Besides that.
Surrounding this gigantic Sky Island, there were hundreds of thousands of smaller Sky Islands floating around.
Some of these were Sky Islands of the Immortal Mansion forces’ survivors.
Some were Sky Islands of those outsider survivors.
Now, with the commercial model of Xingyu City getting on track, daily traffic had reached a rather terrifying number.
At this moment.
At the edge of Xingyu City’s Sky Island, there was a newly merged, yet undeveloped, barren plot.
A group of survivors were orderly queuing on this barren land.
And at the front of the queue, a female mage holding an account book was coordinating with these survivors.
At this moment, the group of survivors were whispering to each other.
An older-looking middle-aged survivor said to a young-looking survivor behind him.
"Did you see that? That female mage is the one responsible for acquiring our territory, named Wu Geng Liuli, we call her Sister Liuli."
"Later, when it’s our turn, remember to speak politely, she’s our big benefactor, offending her won’t yield any benefits."
Behind, the survivor who looked sixteen or seventeen trembled slightly, then nodded and said, "Okay, Boss Jiao, I got it!"
The number of people in line kept decreasing.
Half an hour later, it was finally the turn of that young-looking survivor.
He looked at the female mage, forcing a smile on his face.
"Liuli... Sister Liuli, hello."
At this point, the female mage named Wu Geng Liuli raised her head, glanced at the survivor in front.
She didn’t seem to express anything about his smile and said directly.
"Name, Wang Teng."
"In this battle outside, you brought back a total of 3,400 square Sky Island territory; per the contract, you need to hand over 1,000 square meters to merge into Xingyu City, correct?"
The survivor named Wang Teng responded promptly, "Correct!"
Wu Geng Liuli nodded, "Okay, go ahead and segregate the land area yourself, just merge it into Xingyu City then."
At this moment, Wang Teng continued,
"Sister Liuli, please take the remaining more than 2,000 square meters of my Sky Island territory."
His eyes were filled with anticipation.
Wu Geng Liuli glanced at him, seemingly not surprised.

"Alright, for this transaction, you’re choosing to sell 2,000 square meters of Sky Island territory to Xingyu City, as per the Lord’s pricing, one square meter equals 100 Spirit Cores. I will transact 200,000 Spirit Cores to you, is that okay?"
Upon hearing this, Wang Teng’s face immediately lit up with joy, quickly nodding, "No problem! Of course, no problem!"
"Thank you, Sister Liuli!"
Wu Geng Liuli nodded and then initiated the transaction request to him.
When the 200,000 Spirit Cores were credited, the young man’s breath involuntarily quickened!
Then, this young fellow immediately found that older survivor, excitedly saying, "Jiao... Boss Jiao!"
"I got it exchanged!"
"Over here at Star God, you can really exchange territory for resources!"
"And they even gave me so many Spirit Cores at once!"
Such a huge number of Spirit Cores, which he had never seen in his life!
Wang Teng was only a level 27 survivor, not even at the Third Transformation.
Before this, he always dwelled within the territory of the Immortal Mansion.
Even though Luo Chan had been kind to them, contributions for team development were still a necessity.
With his strength, he roughly earned only one or two thousand Spirit Cores a day normally.
After contributing 50% of his profits to the team, what fell into his own pocket, was scarcely a thousand Spirit Cores.
Yet now, he suddenly gained 200,000 Spirit Cores, almost equating to half a year’s earnings.
The other survivors in line also heard Wang Teng’s excited shouting, showing envy in their eyes.
Prior to this, it’s likely none of them thought that territory area could be sold.
Moreover, at such a price.
Even when they fought to explore territories during their time in the ’Immortal Mansion’, it was always merged into the team leader without compensation.
That was during a very difficult period.
Under the enormous pressure of the blood tide, only by gathering all strength could they barely survive...
