Gazing at the distant Wolf Cavalry army, taking turns learning to control the Demon Elephant War Chariots.
Although a portion of the chariots were still somewhat clumsy in their actions.
Among them, Han Xing saw that the movements of several chariots had reached a flexible level.
This indicates that some of the Wolf Cavalry have gradually become proficient in controlling the Demon Elephant War Chariots.
Seeing their efforts, Han Xing nodded in satisfaction.
Over these days, he has harvested 306 Heroic Spirits, and can make a total of 30 Demon Elephant War Chariots.
However, he has only crafted 22 Demon Elephant War Chariots so far.
The reason he didn’t continue crafting is because his reserves of Philosopher’s Stones are insufficient.
It takes 50 Philosopher’s Stones to craft a Demon Elephant War Chariot.
Crafting 22 chariots consumed 1,100 of them.
Now, in Han Xing’s warehouse, there are only a little over 1,000 Philosopher’s Stones left.
Moreover, these remaining Philosopher’s Stones are reserved for crafting the Oracle Throne.
He wouldn’t use them unless absolutely necessary.
At this moment, Han Xing sighed and said, "Philosopher’s Stones are a major gap..."
"Not only do Divine Artifacts need them, but crafting Ancient Weapons also requires a lot."
"Including that Holy Artifact, the amount of Philosopher’s Stones needed is even more exaggerated."
"If I were to rely solely on myself to collect that many Philosopher’s Stones, who knows how long it would take...
Thinking of this, Han Xing sighed again.
As for the source of Philosopher’s Stones, Han Xing also has a solution in mind.
It’s to take a batch of Space Backpacks and find Wu Ling’Er to trade for a lot of Divine Stones.
With the Witch Race’s resource reserves, the quantity of such rare ores must be considerable.
And these Powerhouses have a strong demand for Space Backpacks.
Therefore, this is a win-win trade.
However, to trade with the Witch Race, there’s a major prerequisite.
That is, he must have the strength to threaten or even kill Legendary Powerhouses.
This isn’t because Han Xing doesn’t trust Wu Ling’Er.
Rather, it’s because he doesn’t trust the other Powerhouses of the Witch Race.
Because, as soon as Han Xing starts trading with Wu Ling’Er, when a large quantity of Space Items flows into the hands of those Powerhouses.
It will surely draw their attention.
And they will try every means to trace the source of these Space Items.
Then, combining with Han Xing’s Human Race identity.
They would immediately deduce whose hands these Space Items come from.
By then, it might bring a disaster upon himself.
Han Xing’s expression became serious, and he murmured, "So, until I have the strength to deal with Legends, I can’t approach Wu Ling’Er."
"Nor can I reveal the fact that I have a large number of Space Backpacks."
He gazed at his territory, a trace of a worried expression flashed across his face.
Compared to a month and a half ago, the development on Han Xing’s side has indeed been incredibly rapid.
But asking himself, Han Xing knew there was still a long way to go before he could threaten the legends.
Moreover, he always felt that something big was about to happen recently.
This was a kind of intuition for Han Xing.
The last time he had this feeling was on the eve of the blood tide burst.
Though this premonition was not always one hundred percent accurate, it’s good to be prepared beforehand.
However, although anxious, Han Xing had no immediate solution at hand right now.
As previously mentioned.
Things need to be tackled step by step; steady development is the way.
Ten Thousand Stars City kept moving, starting to explore in the vast Witch Race Territory...
At the same time, the development of Xingyu City over there was also gradually getting on track...
Land of the Abandoned Gods.
Inside Xingyu City.
Compared to more than half a month ago, Xingyu City welcomed another round of changes.
Firstly, the territorial area surged nearly five to six times, reaching over ten thousand square kilometers.
On it were bustling crowds and groups of well-equipped Wolf Cavalry Guards shuttling back and forth on the streets.
Besides that.
Surrounding this gigantic Sky Island, there were hundreds of thousands of smaller Sky Islands floating around.
Some of these were Sky Islands of the Immortal Mansion forces’ survivors.
Some were Sky Islands of those outsider survivors.
Now, with the commercial model of Xingyu City getting on track, daily traffic had reached a rather terrifying number.
At this moment.
At the edge of Xingyu City’s Sky Island, there was a newly merged, yet undeveloped, barren plot.
A group of survivors were orderly queuing on this barren land.
And at the front of the queue, a female mage holding an account book was coordinating with these survivors.
At this moment, the group of survivors were whispering to each other.
An older-looking middle-aged survivor said to a young-looking survivor behind him.
"Did you see that?
That female mage is the one responsible for acquiring our territory, named Wu Geng Liuli, we call her Sister Liuli."
"Later, when it’s our turn, remember to speak politely, she’s our big benefactor, offending her won’t yield any benefits."
Behind, the survivor who looked sixteen or seventeen trembled slightly, then nodded and said, "Okay, Boss Jiao, I got it!"
The number of people in line kept decreasing.
Half an hour later, it was finally the turn of that young-looking survivor.
He looked at the female mage, forcing a smile on his face.
"Liuli...
Sister Liuli, hello."
At this point, the female mage named Wu Geng Liuli raised her head, glanced at the survivor in front.
She didn’t seem to express anything about his smile and said directly.
"Name, Wang Teng."
"In this battle outside, you brought back a total of 3,400 square Sky Island territory; per the contract, you need to hand over 1,000 square meters to merge into Xingyu City, correct?"
The survivor named Wang Teng responded promptly, "Correct!"
Wu Geng Liuli nodded, "Okay, go ahead and segregate the land area yourself, just merge it into Xingyu City then."
At this moment, Wang Teng continued,
"Sister Liuli, please take the remaining more than 2,000 square meters of my Sky Island territory."
His eyes were filled with anticipation.
Wu Geng Liuli glanced at him, seemingly not surprised.
"Alright, for this transaction, you’re choosing to sell 2,000 square meters of Sky Island territory to Xingyu City, as per the Lord’s pricing, one square meter equals 100 Spirit Cores.
I will transact 200,000 Spirit Cores to you, is that okay?"
Upon hearing this, Wang Teng’s face immediately lit up with joy, quickly nodding, "No problem!
Of course, no problem!"
"Thank you, Sister Liuli!"
Wu Geng Liuli nodded and then initiated the transaction request to him.
When the 200,000 Spirit Cores were credited, the young man’s breath involuntarily quickened!
Then, this young fellow immediately found that older survivor, excitedly saying, "Jiao...
Boss Jiao!"
"I got it exchanged!"
"Over here at Star God, you can really exchange territory for resources!"
"And they even gave me so many Spirit Cores at once!"
Such a huge number of Spirit Cores, which he had never seen in his life!
Wang Teng was only a level 27 survivor, not even at the Third Transformation.
Before this, he always dwelled within the territory of the Immortal Mansion.
Even though Luo Chan had been kind to them, contributions for team development were still a necessity.
With his strength, he roughly earned only one or two thousand Spirit Cores a day normally.
After contributing 50% of his profits to the team, what fell into his own pocket, was scarcely a thousand Spirit Cores.
Yet now, he suddenly gained 200,000 Spirit Cores, almost equating to half a year’s earnings.
The other survivors in line also heard Wang Teng’s excited shouting, showing envy in their eyes.
Prior to this, it’s likely none of them thought that territory area could be sold.
Moreover, at such a price.
Even when they fought to explore territories during their time in the ’Immortal Mansion’, it was always merged into the team leader without compensation.
That was during a very difficult period.
Under the enormous pressure of the blood tide, only by gathering all strength could they barely survive...

chapters.title: Chapter 316 - 252: Acquiring Territory, Giant Sky Island!
paragraphs: Including other teams as well.
Everyone has already accepted that the territory must be contributed to the team for free.
But now, on Han Xing’s side, there is no such rule. Except for the 30% stipulated in the contract, which you must comply with by handing it over for free.
If you make contributions beyond the contract, Xingyu City will also pay you additional compensation.
At first, when Lanlan announced that Lord Star River had decided to use resources to purchase the survivor’s territory, everyone thought they had misheard.
Until the first Survivor explored a Sky Island, brought back a territory of tens of thousands of square meters, and contributed it all to Xingyu City, directly receiving a million Spirit Cores!
At this moment, the survivors from the Immortal Mansion were completely convinced.
They all began to control their Sky Islands, frantically exploring the Sky Islands around Xingyu City.
Rushing, fearing to miss the opportunity.
With the efforts of hundreds of thousands of survivors.
Han Xing’s Xingyu City expanded five to six times in size within a week.
Of course, Han Xing also paid an enormous amount of resources for this.
However, compared to the value these Sky Island Territories can bring in the future, the current expenditure is worth it.
Look at this.
The number of stores in Xingyu City has reached over 300,000 in half a month.
Among them, more than half are shops opened by those members of the Immortal Mansion.
Under Luo Chan’s leadership, they selected many well-located shops in Xingyu City.
Plus, the entry of other freelancers.
Various dining, leisure, and entertainment shops have all been established.
Now, the commerce in Xingyu City can truly be described as a hundred flowers blooming.
Many survivors come to Xingyu City and feel as if they’ve found the feeling of Blue Star, loitering around, reluctant to leave.
Moreover, not only do these entertained survivors find belonging, but other survivors also discover many structures in Xingyu City that are helpful to them.
Such as the Mercenary Guild, which gathers a large number of idle survivors.
They seek suitable teammates to team up with or can also issue various commission tasks here.
Additionally, due to Han Xing’s deterrence.
The entire Xingyu City, even the surrounding area, presents a harmonious scene.
Whether it’s the Sky Island Monsters or other survivors, no one dares to cause trouble here.
After all, in the past few days, those survivors have personally witnessed.
Some massive Sky Islands floated over, with a very large area.
Clearly, there were terrifying monsters on them.
However, before these Sky Islands got close.
Xingyu City suddenly experienced a slight tremor.
Then, they saw dozens of ghostly green flames rising into the air.
With an explosion, those massive Sky Islands were blasted into pieces on the spot.
From tens of kilometers away, they couldn’t even see what the monsters looked like inside, they were directly blown to pieces by the unknown means of Xingyu City.
This environment also gave survivors a rare sense of security.
They subconsciously began to regard it as a safe haven and sanctuary.
And this phenomenon naturally brought Xingyu City an even more terrifying influx of people.
Now, the number of survivors actively living in Xingyu City has reached 20 million.
Daily traffic has exceeded 100 million.
If it weren’t for the large-scale territorial expansion during this period, it really couldn’t accommodate this terrifying number of people.
And the astonishing flow of people naturally brings astonishing revenue.
As the City Lord.
Han Xing now receives an astronomical number of Spirit Cores every day.
Of course, the expenses are also terrifying.
Expanding territory and constructing more buildings also require a large number of resources.
However, as long as you persist through this initial period.
Later on, it will all be long-term profits.
Other survivors have also caught onto the business opportunity in Xingyu City.
And when they eagerly hurrying over to sign the Lord Contract with Han Xing, they were told.
All open shops in Xingyu City have already been rented out.
Including housing, they were all gone.
Now, all survivors know how popular Xingyu City is.
Every day, who knows how many survivors are wandering around and spending there.
It’s said that even a dog could make a fortune by opening a small shop in Xingyu City.
However, having missed the best opportunity in the first wave.
They could only regretfully blame themselves for being shortsighted, wondering why they didn’t sign the Lord Contract on the first night Xingyu City opened.
However, the next words from Lanlan, the current agent of Xingyu City, once again gave them hope.
The second batch of shops in Xingyu City is under construction and will be open again later.
Hearing this, these survivors also became excited.
And secretly decided, next time, they must be the first to sign the contract and then grab the best locations for shops!
At this time, in the Witch Race Territory.
After exploring a Sky Island, Han Xing listened to Lanlan’s report, with a hint of joy on his lips.
It must be said that the decision to open Xingyu City was the right one.
Now, in the warehouse of his Lord’s Mansion, countless materials have already been accumulated.
Spirit Cores, Permanent Gold Ingots, Mithril, and so on—the materials that can be bought in large quantities on the market have all reached astronomical numbers.
As for these basic materials, he doesn’t lack them at all.
What he lacks are high-level materials like the Philosopher’s Stone and Shadow Divine Stone...
And even in the Witch Race Territory, these things are not so easy to acquire.
Han Xing encouraged himself in his heart.
"The development of Xingyu City’s commercial city has already stepped onto the right track, I must work harder as well!"
"Once the issue of these high-level materials is resolved, I can start mass-producing ancient weapons and even create Divine Artifacts in quantity!"
"By then, I won’t say the entire Holy Spirit Realm, but at least in the Witch Race Territory, I would be able to walk with confidence!"
Han Xing felt invigorated, and Ten Thousand Stars City continued to advance.
Along the way, they kept exploring various giant Sky Islands.
The territory area expanded rapidly.
After six hours of exploration, they expanded over hundreds of square kilometers of territory in total.
At this moment, Ten Thousand Stars City finally temporarily halted its advance.
Because, before Han Xing and his group, appeared the largest Cloud Sky Island they had ever encountered in history.
The area was as large as several hundred square kilometers!
Equivalent to half the size of Ten Thousand Stars City now!
Before this, even in the Land of the Abandoned Gods, the largest Sky Island they had encountered was only a dozen or so square kilometers at most.
Such a massive Cloud Sky Island, it was the first time they had seen one.
At this moment, everyone was looking up, gazing at the disproportionately large Sky Island.
Cheng Jianyong exclaimed in surprise beside them, "Such a large Sky Island, if we annex it, it would at least match our week’s exploration progress, right?
Everyone simultaneously nodded.
"Then what are we waiting for, let’s go!"
After saying this, Cheng Jianyong raised his Golden Battle Spear, already eager to go.
At this time, Shen Yun stopped him and said, "Hold on a moment."
"Though this Sky Island is massive, correspondingly, it also means the monsters inside are terrifyingly strong."
However, Cheng Jianyong said, "What’s the matter, are you scared?"
"No matter how powerful, it can’t possibly be Legendary level."
"If it were Legendary, we would have been sensed not long after approaching this Sky Island."
Everyone was taken aback, not expecting Cheng Jianyong’s perception to be so sharp.
Because what he said was indeed correct.
Previously, everyone had learned about the terrifying strength of Legendary Powerhouses from Wu Ling’Er.
With the intensity of a Legendary Powerhouse’s aura, they would have felt a sense of mortal danger even dozens of kilometers away, let alone getting close.
But now, even though they were so close, they didn’t feel any strong sense of danger on this Sky Island.
This indicated that, although the monsters inside were formidable, there was a limit to their strength.
At least for everyone, it posed no threat.
Shen Yun had no words to counter Cheng Jianyong and gave him a sideways glance, saying, "Let’s wait for Brother Xing to observe first."
At this moment, after observing for a while, Han Xing also said, "Indeed, as Cheng Jianyong said, we didn’t sense a Legendary aura inside."
"Let’s go, we can go take a look!"
Upon hearing this, everyone nodded together.
Then, Han Xing directly controlled Ten Thousand Stars City, moving closer to this Sky Island.
A system prompt appeared.
[This is a giant Sky Island that drifted from a very distant place, containing precious mineral resources due to its unique geological structure.]
[However, it has already been occupied by a group of dark underground creatures and has been regarded as their territory. Enter or not?]
Upon hearing the initial prompt, everyone was visibly interested.
Because they knew they had found the treasure this time!
Previously, even in those resource Sky Islands, like the Permanent Gold Ore Vein and Purple Gold Ore Vein.
Before entering, the system would merely prompt that it contained rich mineral resources.
But now, the system prompt was: ’precious mineral resources’!
This indicated that there could be even more advanced ores inside than Permanent Gold and Purple Gold!
There are many ores more advanced than these materials, such as Lava Crystal Stone, Vitality Ore, Rhythm Black Iron, etc...
Whichever it may be, it shows that this Sky Island contains astonishing value!
Han Xing, with a gleam of excitement in his eyes, directly clicked confirm.
The next moment, the vast cloud layer dissipated.
In front of everyone, a massive Sky Island appeared, its entire body blackish-blue, like a gigantic meteorite from outer space!
The entire Sky Island had no sign of vegetation, as if life was utterly unsuitable here.
Moreover, on the surface of the Sky Island, there were numerous mining pits that seemed to have been extracted by humans.
Machines exuding steam were excavating the ores.
And beside these machines stood a group of short-statured beings with mouse-like heads.
This group of creatures had bare upper bodies, revealing muscular torsos, and were diligently collecting the ores from the ground and loading them onto mining carts to transport away.
Seeing the appearance of these monster-like creatures, everyone couldn’t help but exclaim.
"Goblins!"
Yes, these creatures were one of the intelligent races of this world, goblins.
Previously, they occasionally encountered them on some special Sky Islands.

chapters.title: Chapter 317 - 253: Goblins, the Demon Elephant War Chariot’s Might Revealed!
paragraphs: However, compared to other goblins, most are hiding in threes and fives beneath the surface of those Sky Islands.
It’s rare to see more than ten goblins gather together.
Yet the number of goblins here has completely exceeded everyone’s understanding.
It has even developed into a tribe.
These goblins have clear divisions of labor and cooperation.
There are goblin laborers specifically transporting minerals, and goblin supervisors overseeing them.
And, those goblin combat units holding long spears and swords.
Seeing the equipment on that group of combat goblins, everyone was taken aback.
Because, what they were wearing was at least Purple Armor, which equates to Silver Equipment.
Among them, there were even a few pieces of Golden Equipment mixed in.
With a quick glance, at least a few thousand goblin warriors were wearing this level of armor.
With so much Silver Armor, its value is beyond imagination.
Cheng Jianyong also complained, "Damn, a group of goblins dressed so well?"
However, at this moment, Han Xing’s eyes were already gleaming.
Because here, it’s not the Abyssal Rift.
These monsters’ equipment won’t vanish with their corpses after death.
In other words, Han Xing can completely strip off this group of goblins’ clothes.
Whether thrown into Xingyu City’s shops for sale or equipped on the Wolf Cavalry or Minotaur Army, it’s a good choice.
Before Han Xing, the attributes of these goblins appeared.
[Goblin Laborer: Ordinary Creature]
[Level]: 35
[Attributes]: Power 732, Agility 647, Spirit 689, Constitution 604.
[Skills]: Hardworking and Enduring Hardship, Shrinking.
[Goblin Warrior: Ordinary Creature]
[Level]: 41
[Attributes]: Power 2032, Agility 1984, Spirit 1864, Constitution 2102.
[Skills]: Goblin Spear Technique, Thrust.
[Bear Goblins Captain: Elite Creature]
[Level]: 41
Everyone noticed that these goblins ranged from level 25 to 45.
This strength explains why they didn’t sense any danger on this Sky Island.
At this moment, the group of goblins seemed to have noticed Han Xing and others.
The next moment, thousands of beady eyes simultaneously gazed over.
Their eyes were filled with vigilance and killing intent.
With so many stares, even those with strong nerves felt a bit uneasy.
At this time, Shen Yun asked with a puzzled expression, "Brother Xing, this group of goblins seems different from those we encountered before."
"Goblins we encountered before would burrow away at the sight of us humans, never thinking to resist."
"But now, this group of goblins not only isn’t afraid of us, but looks menacing instead."
After Shen Yun spoke, the others nodded in agreement.
Because of their nature, the Goblin Race is famously timid and cowardly.
Upon seeing an enemy, their first instinct isn’t to resist but to find a way to flee.
The goblins in front of them indeed seemed peculiar.
However, Han Xing shook his head and said, "There’s nothing strange about it."
"As an intelligent race, once they develop to a certain scale, they develop territorial consciousness."
"No matter how timid they are by nature, they will be very resistant to other creatures approaching their territory."
"However, although this group of goblins has developed territorial awareness, their inherent cowardice still prevents them from attacking us immediately."
"If it were other monsters, they would’ve already rushed at us the moment they saw us, not giving us the chance to chat leisurely here."
After hearing Han Xing’s analysis, everyone had an expression of realization on their faces.
Just as he said.
Right now, on the vast surface of the Sky Island, from one deep hole after another, more and more goblin warriors continued to emerge.
Yet even so, they didn’t dare attack Han Xing and the others.
Instead, they all gathered together, as if this would give them confidence.
In no time, tens of thousands of goblin warriors gathered on the surface.
Their levels ranged from 30 to 45, and they were well-equipped, making them a formidable force.
Cheng Jianyong then said, "Brother Xing, it seems like these goblins are ready to fight us to the end."
"Should we charge directly, or use the Defense Tower from our territory for a sweep first?"
After listening, Han Xing didn’t answer but instead asked a question.
"Have you noticed that the minerals these goblin laborers are mining look familiar?"
"Familiar?" Cheng Jianyong asked, puzzled.
"Yes."
Han Xing nodded and said, "Look at those black stones in their minecarts. With the water undulating on their surface, don’t they look like the raw ores of Rhythm Black Iron?"
After hearing this, everyone was taken aback.
Then, when they looked at the minerals in the goblin laborers’ cart, their eyes widened.
Cheng Jianyong exclaimed, "Holy crap! It really is Rhythm Black Iron!"
Before, they hadn’t noticed.
Now, after Han Xing’s reminder, they realized that this group of goblins was extracting Rhythm Black Iron, such a precious metal, and in vast quantities!
If the entire mine were to be excavated, how much Rhythm Black Iron could be refined?
It’s simply unimaginable!
It’s important to know that Rhythm Black Iron isn’t just a main material for crafting Ancient Weapons; it can also be exchanged with Dwarves for Ancient Weapon Blueprints.
Its uses are extremely extensive.
Shen Yun remarked in awe from the side, "It’s truly unimaginable that such a massive Sky Island conceals such a vast quantity of precious metal..."
Everyone simultaneously swallowed hard.
And then, Han Xing maneuvered Ten Thousand Stars City to approach this vast mountain.
At this moment.
The goblins, seeing the enemy approaching, instinctively wanted to throw down their weapons and scramble back into the mines.

chapters.title: Chapter 318 - 253: Goblins, the Demon Elephant War Chariot’s Might Revealed!
paragraphs: However, when they saw so many of their tribe around them, they suddenly found some confidence.
They simultaneously raised their weapons, making threatening gestures.
"Jiji! Jiji!!"
These goblins emitted strange rat-like cries from their mouths.
It seemed that as long as Han Xing and the others dared to approach, these goblins would dare to give them a rain of spears.
At this moment, a tall goblin, standing nearly two meters tall and covered with blue-gray mane, emerged from the crowd.
It grasped a massive chain hammer, looked at Han Xing and the others, and made a series of deep sounds from its mouth.
"Agisimino, Worried Syrah..."
Everyone looked at each other in confusion.
But at this time, with the system’s translation, Han Xing understood the meaning of this goblin giant.
"Human Race! Quickly leave the Sky Island of the Goblin Race, this is not a place you can meddle with!"
"If you don’t heed the warning, you will be pierced through by our sharp spears and become ground worm kebabs!"
The other goblins were also excitedly shouting after hearing this.
"That’s right, ground worm kebabs!"
"Crunchy, with a chicken flavor!"
"Lord Xiong the goblin is mighty!"
This bear goblin, as a level 43 elite monster, does have quite some strength.
At least, most survivors encountering it now would be crushed head-on.
However, Han Xing and his group have developed for over half a month, and their level exceeds it.
Even their entire set of attributes surpasses this goblin by a wide margin.
An elite monster like this, Zhang Lianmeng could directly kill with just a large fireball.
So they entirely disregard this goblin.
The goblins saw Han Xing silent and thought this group of humans was scared.
Excitedly, each raised their spears or swords,
"Ha, brothers look! This group of humans seems to be scared stiff by Lord Xiong!"
"Yeah, look at their dumbfounded appearance, just like they’ve never seen the world!"
"Weak humans! Crawl back into your ground holes and drink milk!"
This group of goblins was arrogantly taunting Han Xing and the others, thinking that it could boost their confidence.
Moreover, the more they saw Han Xing and the others not reacting, the more they believed the humans were scared.
At this point, the goblins began to grow restless, even preparing to launch an attack.
After all, killing an enemy would be something they could boast about among their companions for a long time.
Among goblins, they could even enjoy priority in mate selection.
Looking at the arrogant appearance of these goblins.
At this time, Shen Yun grabbed his hammer, a faint holy light appeared on his body, he turned and asked, "Brother Xing, are we preparing to act?"
His tone was very calm, as if in front of them were not tens of thousands of goblin troops but tens of thousands of ants.
However, given their strength, they indeed did not need to regard the goblins.
Han Xing nodded, "Yes, we’re preparing to act, but before that, let me test something small."
Everyone was somewhat puzzled after hearing this.
They didn’t know what Han Xing meant by testing something, but they imagined they’d soon find out.
Indeed.
When Han Xing lightly waved his hand.
From the rear Xingyu City, suddenly exploded twenty paths of dazzling golden light, instantly charging toward the sky!
Before the goblins could see what it was, they saw those dozens of golden lights, at a terrifying speed, rushing towards them!
In an instant, it crossed seven or eight kilometers, appearing above Han Xing and the others.
At this moment, the goblins finally saw what those golden lights were.
They were weapons of war, externally magnificent and fierce, enormously sized, and exuding an astonishing grandeur!
Demon Elephant War Chariots!
Because they added ten Heroic Spirit souls as Artifact Souls, each Demon Elephant War Chariot had the lord-level pressure.
At this moment, more than twenty appeared simultaneously, equivalent to more than twenty lords descending simultaneously.
A deathly presence almost instantly left these goblins feeling blank-minded!
However, before they could react.
They saw that human in front casually say.
"Go ahead, let me see how your half-month training has been."
The group of goblins was confused, seemingly not knowing to whom this human was speaking.
Yet in the sky, those war machines appeared to receive orders simultaneously.
The next moment, they launched a swift assault, charging furiously at the goblins!
The goblin group erupted into chaos, some goblin warriors instinctively chose to fall back.
At this moment.
Within the chaotic goblins, suddenly appears urgent shouting.
"Attack, attack... Attack! Quickly attack!"
This voice was not loud, but the goblin warriors seemed to find their composure, and the fear was slightly dispelled.
The next moment, several thousand goblin spearmen threw their weapons mightily and hurled them forward!
"Oh yeah!"
Several thousand spears turned into raindrops, accompanied by breaking air sounds, hitting the Golden War Chariot’s body.
Ding ding ding!
The sound of metal clashing resonated.
However, the next scene made those attacking goblins utterly dumbfounded.
As their attack hit the surface of the Demon Elephant War Chariot, it was immediately deflected.
Not to mention causing damage.
The surface’s golden paint wasn’t scratched at all.
The goblins were terrified, the hard-earned momentum they gathered drained instantly.
However, at this moment, seated within the war chariot, observing the scene, the wolf cavalry showed a bloodthirsty look.
They excitedly said, "The Lord was right!"
"These chariots have incomparable defense and destructive power, even the attacks of a four-star leader can’t shake them!"
"Being inside is the safest place!"
"Today, I definitely want to show my abilities to the Lord, demonstrating our training results over these days!"
The next moment.
A Demon Elephant War Chariot directly dived and charged fearlessly into the goblin troops.
The immense size of the Demon Elephant War Chariot brought an unparalleled oppressive sense.
Below, the fear in the goblins’ eyes grew even heavier.
At this moment, the bear goblin hastily shouted, "Defense! Quickly form a defense formation to intercept this chariot!"
The goblins heard this, mustered courage, gathered together, and prepared to intercept.
Yet, what they didn’t know was that this move nearly provided the Demon Elephant War Chariot with an excellent output space.
At this moment, the wolf cavalry also looked excitedly, saying, "Haha, these goblins are foolish, gathering together for me to kill, a bunch of idiots!"
Then, inside the Demon Elephant War Chariot, he found a red button and excitedly pressed it hard.
[Tank Charge]: Charge forward a certain distance, dealing 150% of attack power to all enemies along the way!
When the Demon Elephant War Chariot’s front touched the goblins, their so-called defense formation was shattered almost instantly.
Poof, poof, poof!
Hundreds of goblin warriors were instantly knocked flying, their bones crunching.
And this was just the nightmare’s beginning.
With a hum sound.
The next moment, the sawtooth blades on both sides of the Demon Elephant War Chariot started instantly.
The goblins nearby barely reacted before being swept in by the sawtooth blades.
Hissing... hissing hiss...
The sound of flesh being cut echoed, severed limbs mixed with blood sprayed everywhere!
The goblins’ screams were endless.
Then.
The Demon Elephant War Chariot brought a trail of gold light, carving a long blood path through the goblins.
Countless goblins were ground into meat paste by the chariot’s charge.
The tragic scene continuously shook the goblins’ hearts.
Their formed formation was destroyed in moments.
Watching the terrifying destructive power of the Demon Elephant War Chariot, Han Xing also excitedly clenched his fist.
"Excellent, the learning speed of these wolf cavalry surpasses my expectations!"
"Didn’t expect them to quickly master the war chariot’s control!"
The others beside were also shocked beyond measure!

chapters.title: Chapter 319 - 254: Heartache and the Goblin Prophet
paragraphs: The team members on the side were shocked to see the golden war chariot wreaking havoc everywhere.
Cheng Jianyong couldn’t help but mutter, "Damn, is this what Brother Xing called a little thing?"
"This is just a human-shaped meat grinder, isn’t it?"
"Too terrifying!"
The others nodded in agreement upon hearing this.
However, this was only the beginning.
As the first Demon Elephant War Chariot started operating.
In the air.
The other wolf cavalry were not to be outdone.
They seemed unwilling to let that single wolf cavalry steal the limelight.
The remaining twenty-one Demon Elephant War Chariots simultaneously raised their heads at this moment.
The elephant trunk cannon at the front of the chariots instantly stood upright.
Then, a terrifying energy fluctuation began brewing.
They simultaneously used another large area skill of the Demon Elephant War Chariot.
[Flaming Strike]: Control the cannon at the front of the vehicle to unleash a devastating attack, dealing 20,000 points of damage to the enemy.
And cause the hit enemy to enter a burning effect, dealing 1,000 points of damage per second, effect lasting 10 seconds.
The next moment.
Twenty-one energy shells containing an aura of destruction fell heavily at this moment.
Rumble! Rumble!
Towering flames rose.
The momentum of each shell was comparable to the bombardment of the Hellfire Missile Silo.
At this moment.
Tens of thousands of goblin warriors were engulfed in flames, a massive mushroom cloud rose.
Even the people in Ten Thousand Stars City felt the intense shock waves.
When the mushroom cloud disappeared.
At least hundreds of square kilometers of the giant Sky Island evaporated instantly at this moment.
Blazing flames were burning.
The entire goblin sky island turned into a scene like purgatory.
The figures of those tens of thousands of goblin warriors disappeared entirely at this moment.
This shocking scene not only stunned everyone, even Han Xing was left in a daze.
A moment later.
Cheng Jianyong seemed to recover from the shock, wiped the ash from his face, "Terrifying, so damn terrifying!"
"Is this the horror of ancient weapons?"
"A round of focused fire, I estimate not even a Four-star Lord could survive! The Dominator saw this and would have to kneel on the spot."
"If there were dozens more of these chariots? Wouldn’t even a Legend be terrified?"
Han Xing did not contradict him.
Because what Cheng Jianyong said was true.
According to Han Xing’s estimation, the firepower of a hundred Demon Elephant War Chariots would be enough to threaten a Legend.
Five hundred Demon Elephant War Chariots could annihilate a Legend!
And this was Han Xing’s target quantity.
However, at this moment, in contrast to the shock on everyone’s faces.
After his initial surprise, Han Xing looked back at the Sky Island with a look of intense distress.
At this moment, he clenched his fist and angrily thought in his heart.
Damn it! These wolf cavalry, just focused on showing off the firepower of the Demon Elephant War Chariots, completely disregarded the consequences!
Damn it, they blasted away at least a quarter of the Sky Island in one wave.
You guys had your fun, but how much Rhythm Black Iron do I have to lose here?
Han Xing felt his heart bleeding!
But, he couldn’t blame those wolf cavalry.
After all, he was the one who initially said to test the power of the ancient weapons.
At this time, Zhang Lianmeng looked at Han Xing’s constipated expression, feeling a bit strange.
However, when she followed Han Xing’s gaze, she instantly understood.
With her understanding of Han Xing, she knew that although he was generous to his people, he was a standard penny-pincher.
In his eyes, he probably already considered this Sky Island as his own property.
The Rhythm Black Iron inside was all seen as his assets.
But now, with so much blasted away by the wolf cavalry in one shot, wouldn’t it make his heart ache terribly?
Zhang Lianmeng looked at his expression, feeling both heartbroken and amused.
Everyone else also noticed Han Xing’s grievance, and one by one, they offered their condolences.
However, while comforting him, they couldn’t hide the smile on their faces.
Han Xing also took a deep breath to calm himself.
Then, he led everyone to formally enter the goblin’s Sky Island Territory.
Although this Sky Island was heavily bombarded by the Demon Elephant War Chariots, a large amount of territory was destroyed.
However, its vast area meant there were still plenty of resources left inside.
Moreover, there were also many goblins left.
At this moment.
The remaining goblins seemed not to have recovered yet.
That previous wave of bombing wiped out nearly eighty percent of their warriors in the entire tribe!
Such a massive loss was almost unbearable!
And when they saw the perpetrators of all this,
That is, the group of humans, stepped onto their Sky Island.
At this moment.
The goblins seemed to have seen the most terrifying sight of their lives.
As if those approaching were not humans, but demons!
The next moment, the goblins screamed, some diving into holes, some running around the entire Sky Island chaotically.
Others simply hid under mining carts, exposing only half of their backsides.
Looking at the chaos before them.
Everyone knew that these goblins had been scared out of their wits.
Now, even if they put a sword to their throats, the goblins wouldn’t dare to resist.
At this time, Cheng Jianyong asked beside him, "Brother Xing, how do we handle these goblins?"
Everyone also looked at Han Xing.
According to their previous habits, when exploring a Sky Island, they would naturally clear out all the monsters inside, leaving none behind.
Otherwise, as long as one monster was alive, the system would determine they had not completed the exploration and would not allow merging.

And cause the hit enemy to enter a burning effect, dealing 1,000 points of damage per second, effect lasting 10 seconds.
The next moment.
Twenty-one energy shells containing an aura of destruction fell heavily at this moment.
Rumble!
Rumble!
Towering flames rose.
The momentum of each shell was comparable to the bombardment of the Hellfire Missile Silo.
At this moment.
Tens of thousands of goblin warriors were engulfed in flames, a massive mushroom cloud rose.
Even the people in Ten Thousand Stars City felt the intense shock waves.
When the mushroom cloud disappeared.
At least hundreds of square kilometers of the giant Sky Island evaporated instantly at this moment.
Blazing flames were burning.
The entire goblin sky island turned into a scene like purgatory.
The figures of those tens of thousands of goblin warriors disappeared entirely at this moment.
This shocking scene not only stunned everyone, even Han Xing was left in a daze.
A moment later.
Cheng Jianyong seemed to recover from the shock, wiped the ash from his face, "Terrifying, so damn terrifying!"
"Is this the horror of ancient weapons?"
"A round of focused fire, I estimate not even a Four-star Lord could survive!
The Dominator saw this and would have to kneel on the spot."
"If there were dozens more of these chariots?
Wouldn’t even a Legend be terrified?"
Han Xing did not contradict him.
Because what Cheng Jianyong said was true.
According to Han Xing’s estimation, the firepower of a hundred Demon Elephant War Chariots would be enough to threaten a Legend.
Five hundred Demon Elephant War Chariots could annihilate a Legend!
And this was Han Xing’s target quantity.
However, at this moment, in contrast to the shock on everyone’s faces.
After his initial surprise, Han Xing looked back at the Sky Island with a look of intense distress.
At this moment, he clenched his fist and angrily thought in his heart.
Damn it!
These wolf cavalry, just focused on showing off the firepower of the Demon Elephant War Chariots, completely disregarded the consequences!
Damn it, they blasted away at least a quarter of the Sky Island in one wave.
You guys had your fun, but how much Rhythm Black Iron do I have to lose here?
Han Xing felt his heart bleeding!
But, he couldn’t blame those wolf cavalry.
After all, he was the one who initially said to test the power of the ancient weapons.
At this time, Zhang Lianmeng looked at Han Xing’s constipated expression, feeling a bit strange.
However, when she followed Han Xing’s gaze, she instantly understood.
With her understanding of Han Xing, she knew that although he was generous to his people, he was a standard penny-pincher.
In his eyes, he probably already considered this Sky Island as his own property.
The Rhythm Black Iron inside was all seen as his assets.
But now, with so much blasted away by the wolf cavalry in one shot, wouldn’t it make his heart ache terribly?
Zhang Lianmeng looked at his expression, feeling both heartbroken and amused.
Everyone else also noticed Han Xing’s grievance, and one by one, they offered their condolences.
However, while comforting him, they couldn’t hide the smile on their faces.
Han Xing also took a deep breath to calm himself.
Then, he led everyone to formally enter the goblin’s Sky Island Territory.
Although this Sky Island was heavily bombarded by the Demon Elephant War Chariots, a large amount of territory was destroyed.
However, its vast area meant there were still plenty of resources left inside.
Moreover, there were also many goblins left.
At this moment.
The remaining goblins seemed not to have recovered yet.
That previous wave of bombing wiped out nearly eighty percent of their warriors in the entire tribe!
Such a massive loss was almost unbearable!
And when they saw the perpetrators of all this,
That is, the group of humans, stepped onto their Sky Island.
At this moment.
The goblins seemed to have seen the most terrifying sight of their lives.
As if those approaching were not humans, but demons!
The next moment, the goblins screamed, some diving into holes, some running around the entire Sky Island chaotically.
Others simply hid under mining carts, exposing only half of their backsides.
Looking at the chaos before them.
Everyone knew that these goblins had been scared out of their wits.
Now, even if they put a sword to their throats, the goblins wouldn’t dare to resist.
At this time, Cheng Jianyong asked beside him, "Brother Xing, how do we handle these goblins?"
Everyone also looked at Han Xing.
According to their previous habits, when exploring a Sky Island, they would naturally clear out all the monsters inside, leaving none behind.
Otherwise, as long as one monster was alive, the system would determine they had not completed the exploration and would not allow merging.

chapters.title: Chapter 320 - 254: Heartache and the Goblin Prophet
paragraphs: That being said.
But the goblins in front of him were not like those mindless monsters, killing them didn’t evoke any feelings.
This was a group of intelligent, emotional creatures, numbered in the hundreds of thousands.
If they were to be completely wiped out, even if they could do it, there would still be some discomfort in their hearts.
However, Han Xing did not share this sentiment.
In his eyes.
A monster is just a monster, even if it’s intelligent and emotional, it’s still a monster.
As long as it’s not of the Human Race, once killed, it becomes just a pile of experience points.
So, Han Xing directly ordered, "Do it, kill them all."
Everyone’s expressions shifted, and they lifted their weapons, ready to launch an attack.
The goblins caught their movement from the corner of their eyes and were scared out of their wits, stumbling over each other.
They also started yelling gibberish.
Just as Han Xing was about to launch an attack.
Suddenly, from within a pit in front of them, emerged an old goblin with gray hair and whiskers.
It extended its two rat-like paws, leaping several meters high.
Once out, the aging goblin spouted a long string of gibberish.
Translated, it meant.
"Brave warriors of the Human Race, hold your hands!"
It raised the goblin race’s totem with both hands, a gesture of surrender.
Everyone was taken aback, and their attack movements froze in mid-air.
Because they felt a powerful aura emanating from the old goblin.
A formless domain of power enveloped everyone.
This old goblin was actually a Lord-level creature!
However, it seemed too aged to fully exert its Lord-level strength.
As soon as it landed, its body trembled and almost fell over.
But before it could stabilize itself, it was suddenly knocked over by a few panicked goblins.
"Ouch!"
The old goblin let out a strange cry, falling heavily to the ground.
The entire Sky Island was filled with the chaotic movements of the goblins, who were petrified with fear.
Observing the chaos,
The old goblin sighed helplessly.
It uttered a series of sounds.
The other goblins, upon hearing the voice, paused their headless panicking.
The chaotic scene gradually subsided.
At this moment, the goblins who had calmed down looked fearfully yet curiously at the aging goblin.
They seemed unsure of what it intended to do.
The old goblin got up again, slowly making its way to Han Xing and the others.
Then, it began slowly, "Ahem, strong warriors of the Human Race, please hold your hand.
Everyone was stunned, apparently not expecting the goblin to initiate communication.
Moreover, it was different from the others.
In the cloudy eyes of this old goblin, they saw a glint of wisdom.
The curiosity in Han Xing’s heart was piqued, so he asked, "What do you intend to do?"
The old goblin breathed a sigh of relief seeing their halted attack movement.
It coughed a few times, responding slowly.
"Brave warriors of the Human Race, the goblin race has long occupied this place; it has become our territory."
"Today, your unexpected intrusion was due to the reckless behavior of my people, offending you."
"Here, I apologize to all of you on their behalf."
"I hope that you could give us a chance, let our goblin race have a way out."
The old goblin adopted a very humble attitude.
It didn’t even mention that Han Xing and the others had just wiped out tens of thousands of goblins, taking all the blame itself.
Apparently, it was very clever, knowing how to pacify enemies with words first.
This was a trait those low-intelligence goblins didn’t possess.
In front of Han Xing, the attributes of this old goblin appeared.
[Goblin Prophet: Lord-level Creature]
[Level]: 44
[Attributes]: Power 3041, agility 2763, Spirit 3354, Constitution 2573
[Skills]: True Words Domain, Shrinking, Prophetic Art, Destiny Divination.
As expected, this goblin was a Lord-level creature.
But due to its aging and weakening, its body attributes were inferior even to the leader-level monsters of the same rank.
It didn’t have the strength of a Lord-level creature.
At this moment, after hearing the goblin prophet, Han Xing didn’t respond but instead asked.
"Reason."
The old goblin was stunned, seemingly not understanding Han Xing’s question.
Han Xing continued, "Reason to spare you."
Upon hearing this, the old goblin silently let out a breath of relief.
As long as they were willing to talk, it meant the goblin race was temporarily out of danger.
The old goblin pondered for a moment, a glint of shrewdness appeared in its cloudy eyes.
Then, it slowly said, "If brave warriors of the Human Race could give us a chance, our goblin race will offer you seventy percent of the treasures."
"These are items our hundreds of thousands of people have gathered from various places, containing all kinds of precious minerals and rare treasures."
"I’m sure they will satisfy the brave warriors of the Human Race."
However, after hearing this, Han Xing didn’t agree but asked, "Why should I?"
The old goblin was stunned, again not understanding Han Xing’s words.
"If I kill you, these treasures will be mine regardless," Han Xing continued.
There wasn’t a hint of malice in his words.
However, when the old goblin met Han Xing’s gaze, its body trembled involuntarily, almost instinctively wanting to kneel down.
From this man, it felt an overwhelming power!
Even in its prime, it wouldn’t match this man, let alone in its current aged state.
At that moment, the goblin prophet shook like a sieve.
It couldn’t refute, because what Han Xing said was true.
If it spared these goblins, it could only get seventy percent of the treasures.
If it killed them, they would gain everything.
Besides, these goblins were not likely to be grateful and earn Affinity.
After all, in that first round of bombing, they had killed at least seventy or eighty thousand goblins, most of which were combat units.
These goblins, at this moment, already hated them to the bone but didn’t dare to show it.
Including the old goblin as well.
At this moment, the old goblin took a few deep breaths, seemingly trying to calm its fear.
It felt the terrifying aura from these humans.
The old goblin seemed to have made a difficult decision.
It said solemnly.
"What the brave warrior of the Human Race said is correct, all treasures would be yours if you killed us."
"But clearly, this is not a good choice."
As the old goblin spoke, its tone also rose a little.
Suddenly, a black device appeared in its hand, faintly emitting a red glow.
Han Xing, intrigued, asked, "Oh? Why?"
The old goblin said solemnly, "Our goblin race has been stationed on this giant mine for many years, and naturally, we have laid many setups."
"One of which is that we have hidden a large quantity of explosives deep beneath this Sky Island."
"And what I hold in my hand is the detonator."
"If the brave warriors of the Human Race insist on slaughtering the goblin race."
"Then I will blow up this Sky Island!"
"And you all will gain nothing!"
Staring at the old goblin, Han Xing’s eyes flickered with an imperceptible hint of killing intent.
"Are you threatening us?" Han Xing asked, narrowing his eyes.
At this point, everyone understood the meaning behind the old goblin’s words.
It intended to use the resources on this Sky Island to force everyone to spare these goblins.
Otherwise, there would be mutual destruction.
For a moment, a hint of killing intent appeared in everyone’s eyes.
Cheng Jianyong raised the Golden Battle Spear, murderously asking, "Brother Xing, should we do it?"
To take action meant ignoring the resources on this Sky Island and killing all these goblins.
The number of goblins living here was in the hundreds of thousands; killing them all would be a bloody massacre.
However, the old goblin’s threat to destroy the Sky Island also provoked murderous intentions in their hearts.
For a moment, Zhang Lianmeng and Su Xiaoyang also entered a combat state!

chapters.title: Chapter 321 - 255: Clues to the Wujin Goddess and the Divine Artifact
paragraphs: At this moment.
The entire goblin sky island was shrouded in a strong aura of killing intent.
After the five completed their fourth transformation, their physical attributes had undergone earth-shattering changes.
The aura they emitted invisibly was comparable to that of lord creatures.
The group of goblins felt a deathly oppression.
Especially that human mage in the pale robe, the aura emanating from him was even more terrifying.
As if a real demon had descended into the human world!
Han Xing waved his hand, signaling everyone to remain calm for the moment.
Then, he looked at the old goblin and asked, "Are you saying that if we make a move, you’ll destroy this sky island rather than leave it to us?"
Upon hearing this, the old goblin’s fearful face showed a hint of joy.
It seemed to think its threat had finally worked, and immediately said, "That’s right!"
Han Xing nodded after hearing this.
Then, before anyone reacted.
Han Xing’s figure suddenly disappeared from where he stood.
Shen Yun and Cheng Jianyong focused their eyes intently.
This old goblin, though aged, had a lord-level power of level 44 that was not to be underestimated.
Moreover, with its identity as a prophet, it had a keen sense of crises.
The old goblin’s expression changed dramatically, planning to press the detonation device in its hand and perish together with everyone.
However.
At this moment, Han Xing.
As soon as his figure disappeared, he activated the special effect on his medal, ’Breath of the Wild.’
The already terrifying speed doubled again!
Moreover, he activated the burst skill ’Instant Shadow Flash.’
At this moment, Han Xing’s speed had reached a certain level.
Legendary!
Even though the old goblin realized, it couldn’t keep up with its actions.
Han Xing, like a phantom, appeared beside the old goblin.
The next moment, the old goblin’s hand holding the detonator was severely injured.
An arrow pierced through its wrist, causing the detonator to fall to the ground.
"Ah!"
The old goblin screamed in agony.
Before everyone could react.
Then, it felt its view rising higher.
The old goblin was grabbed by the neck by Han Xing, lifted directly into the air.
At this moment, the old goblin’s strength attribute was no match for Han Xing, being suppressed single-handedly, struggling in mid-air but unable to break free.
Han Xing said coldly, "Threatening me?"
The situation changed too quickly, even Cheng Jianyong and Shen Yun only realized now.
Now, the other goblins saw their leader captured, and fear appeared in their eyes.
They wanted to rush up to rescue the old goblin, but their naturally timid nature held them back.
The old goblin struggled fiercely for a while, but realizing it was futile, it directly chose to give up.
It looked at Han Xing with cloudy eyes and said with difficulty, "Human, human race..."
"Even if... you kill me, you won’t... obtain my tribe’s treasures..."
However, at this moment, Han Xing no longer wanted to waste words with the old goblin.
"Is that so? If you have any other means, feel free to use them and see if you can threaten me." Han Xing’s tone carried a faint hint of murderous intent.
At this moment, the old goblin finally realized that its threats not only had no effect but instead provoked the killing intent in their hearts.
At the brink of life and death, the old goblin hurriedly said, "Wait... wait a minute..."
"I have a divine artifact-level treasure here..."
Han Xing sneered and didn’t pay attention.
"Old fool, trying to stall for time with such petty tricks at this time?"
Having said that, he waved his hand.
All the teammates behind entered combat mode.
At this moment, the old goblin realized that this human no longer believed it.
So, it hurriedly said, "It’s true!"
"I really have a divine artifact in my hands, it’s related to the Wujin Goddess."
Hearing the four words ’Wujin Goddess,’ the hand Han Xing intended to attack stopped in mid-air.
The name of this goddess was very familiar.
Even when on Blue Star, Han Xing had heard about her in some books or films.
She was the goddess who, legend has it, ruled over wealth and treasures.
Thoughts flashed in Han Xing’s eyes.
In such a short time, this old goblin probably couldn’t make up this name to deceive him.
The artifact it mentioned should have some credibility.
So, Han Xing directly asked, "What is that divine artifact? What is its function?"
"W... Wujin Goddess’s mask! This mask can help you gain more wealth, and even help you find what you need the most!" the old goblin replied quickly.
After listening to the old goblin’s description, Han Xing felt a bit more convinced, so he asked, "Where is the mask?"
The old goblin quickly said, "Where the mask is located..."
It whispered a string of syllables.
From there, only Han Xing could hear.
Han Xing listened intently.
A moment later.
The two seemed to have exchanged some words.
Han Xing nodded and said, "Alright, as for the condition you mentioned, I agree to it."
"As long as you give me this mask, I will spare your goblin race."
Han Xing was preparing to let the old goblin go.
And it was at this moment that he felt a terrifying aura erupt from the old goblin.
Han Xing’s eyes widened, surprised at the old goblin.
He couldn’t understand why it suddenly burst forth at this moment?
Han Xing was already prepared to let it go, didn’t it realize that its behavior now was akin to courting death?
Yet before Han Xing could do anything.
He saw the goblin struggling to lift an arm, seemingly wanting to make some movement.

So, Han Xing directly asked, "What is that divine artifact?
What is its function?"
Wujin Goddess’s mask!
This mask can help you gain more wealth, and even help you find what you need the most!" the old goblin replied quickly.
After listening to the old goblin’s description, Han Xing felt a bit more convinced, so he asked, "Where is the mask?"
The old goblin quickly said, "Where the mask is located..."
It whispered a string of syllables.
From there, only Han Xing could hear.
Han Xing listened intently.
A moment later.
The two seemed to have exchanged some words.
Han Xing nodded and said, "Alright, as for the condition you mentioned, I agree to it."
"As long as you give me this mask, I will spare your goblin race."
Han Xing was preparing to let the old goblin go.
And it was at this moment that he felt a terrifying aura erupt from the old goblin.
Han Xing’s eyes widened, surprised at the old goblin.
He couldn’t understand why it suddenly burst forth at this moment?
Han Xing was already prepared to let it go, didn’t it realize that its behavior now was akin to courting death?
Yet before Han Xing could do anything.
He saw the goblin struggling to lift an arm, seemingly wanting to make some movement.

chapters.title: Chapter 322 - 255: Clues to the Wujin Goddess and the Divine Artifact (Part 2)
paragraphs: Rear.
Zhang Lianmeng and others’ expressions changed.
They instinctively thought that the old goblin was about to lash out.
So they all instantly prepared to attack, blasting towards the old goblin.
"Wait a moment!" Han Xing quickly stopped them.
However, his voice seemed to be a step late.
Behind him, an arrow was already rapidly shooting.
Thump!
The next instant.
The arrow hit the old goblin right between the eyes, its body suddenly stiffened.
Then, its neck twisted to the side, losing all signs of life.
At this moment.
The group of goblins stared blankly at their prophet and its limp body.
They also saw the arrow that had pierced through its entire head.
At this moment, the group of goblins confirmed their leader was dead.
The entire Sky Island instantly erupted into unprecedented chaos!
The goblins shouted and cried, clutching their heads in agony, as if the end of the world was nigh.
Shen Yun and others, too, stared blankly at the figures in the team.
The one who attacked was Su Xiaoyang.
Her eyes were also puzzled, looking at the arrow she shot unconsciously, she quickly said, "I, I didn’t mean to..."
"I don’t know what happened!"
Listening to Su Xiaoyang’s strange words, everyone was puzzled.
Because at their level of power, one wouldn’t lose concentration or attack unconsciously during battles.
Han Xing nodded and said, "It’s okay, it has nothing to do with you."
"This old goblin courted death itself, you were likely subjected to its mind control skill, causing you to attack unconsciously."
Listening to Han Xing’s explanation, everyone suddenly understood and nodded.
Including Su Xiaoyang, who suddenly sighed with relief.
Although they figured out what had just happened.
They still didn’t understand why that old goblin would do such a thing.
At this moment, the Sky Island remained in chaos.
Han Xing didn’t care.
He directly threw the old goblin’s corpse aside.
Then he took a deep breath and said solemnly, "If you don’t want to die, quiet down!"
The voice spread across the entire Sky Island.
The next moment, the chaotic group of goblins quieted down completely.
They looked fearfully at the human in front of them.
Because the goblin prophet had lost its life at his hands.
Ignoring the fearful gazes of the goblins.
Han Xing continued to ask, "I ask you, do you want to die or live?
His voice was like the whisper of a demon.
Hearing Han Xing’s words, Cheng Jianyong and Shen Yun and others were somewhat surprised.
Because at the beginning, they planned to kill all these goblins.
But now, it seems Han Xing changed his mind?
However, these goblins didn’t care about any plans.
Initially thinking they’d face annihilation after the goblin prophet died.
But now, they saw hope to live again.
The next moment, all these goblins nodded excitedly and said.
"Want to live! Want to live!"
"We want to live."
In their eyes, there was a desire for survival.
Han Xing nodded, a smile creeping on his lips.
Then, he continued, "Okay, as the price for survival."
"I want your entire goblin tribe to pledge allegiance to me, is there any problem?"
This group of goblins had long been frightened, not to mention allegiance, even if serving as horses and cattle, they’d agree without hesitation!
Thump! Thump!
In an instant, a large number of goblins knelt down.
They lay on the ground, urgently saying, "We are willing!"
The goblin race, as a species, is notoriously timid and cowardly, lacking spine.
As long as they can live, even being used as slaves isn’t a problem.
Han Xing’s lips curved with a trace of a smile, "Alright, congratulations on your survival."
On the Sky Island, hundreds of thousands of goblins felt pardoned, breathing a collective sigh of relief.
At this moment, behind them, Shen Yun and Cheng Jianyong seemed somewhat surprised.
They quietly discussed at the back.
"Brother Xing is planning to tame this group of goblins?" Cheng Jianyong asked.
Shen Yun nodded, "It seems so, since he’s already said so."
Cheng Jianyong was very surprised, "But with so many goblins, how will Brother Xing subdue them?"
"The goblin race is timid and cowardly, hardly reliable for loyalty; they might pledge allegiance to Brother Xing today, but betray him tomorrow."
Cheng Jianyong’s words were accurate.
Though these goblins seemed obedient now, it’s based solely on Han Xing’s overwhelming power.
If faced with a stronger enemy later, these goblins would definitely flee first, rather than help.
After a moment’s thought, Shen Yun said, "Maybe Brother Xing plans to use the Lord Contract Scrolls to tame them."
Cheng Jianyong was stunned, "No way?"
"Contract scrolls on the market are priced at tens of thousands, even tens of thousands of Spirit Cores per scroll."
"A goblin’s worth doesn’t match this price at all."
Shen Yun shrugged, admitting he wasn’t sure.
Then, he patted Cheng Jianyong’s shoulder, "Alright, don’t overthink it, let’s just see how Brother Xing arranges things."
Cheng Jianyong nodded.
At this moment.
The group of goblins was respectfully kneeling on the ground.
However, in their eyes, Han Xing saw some falseness and cunning.
This group of goblins, though intelligent, weren’t very clever.
Many emotions were expressed clearly on their faces.
Han Xing naturally knew why these goblins had such expressions.
Goblins are a race known for their survival skills and fast reproduction.
As long as given the chance to live, temporarily serving like horses and cattle is no issue.
Just secretly developing, there’s always an opportunity to escape.
Han Xing seemingly saw through their intentions.
But instead of anger, he showed a peculiar smile.
"Then, starting now, all of you goblins, shall sign a Lord Contract with me."
Upon hearing the Lord Contract, these goblins simultaneously stiffened.
They seemed aware of the effect of this item.
Once the contract is signed, they’ll never be able to defy the contract lord.
Not even a single rebellious thought can occur.
This was completely contrary to their plan!
They knew, signing such contracts required appropriate scrolls.
These scrolls were extremely precious, even some legendary powerhouses didn’t have many of them.
At this moment, the goblins retained a final bit of hope, testingly asking, "H-Human lord."
"Are you sure you want to sign contracts with our entire goblin race, we have hundreds of thousands..."
"Is the number of scrolls you have... sufficient?"
Han Xing nodded and smiled, "That’s nothing for you to worry about."
"Though the number of scrolls I have isn’t large, signing all the goblins on this Sky Island is no problem."
The next moment, Han Xing waved his hand.
Before him appeared thousands upon thousands of pale yellow papers.
These scrolls were undoubtedly what Han Xing entrusted Lanlan to sweep up in the trading channel.
As Cheng Jianyong and Shen Yun mentioned, these scrolls were rare and precious.
Except for a few appearing in the initial leaderboard rewards.
Later, only a few lucky survivors found them on some Sky Islands by chance.
Thus, in the entire trading channel, the number of contract scrolls was around three million.
And each’s price wasn’t low, the cheapest being six thousand Spirit Cores per scroll.
However, Han Xing didn’t mind.
It’s worth noting that among billions of global survivors.
He had become the undisputed richest person, owning immense resources.
Not only the resources in his warehouse.
Xingyu City, with its daily traffic flow in the millions, and tens of thousands of shops, continuously providing him with revenue.
Though contract scrolls are precious and expensive, they posed no problem for Han Xing.
So, Han Xing directly informed Lanlan, to sweep goods from the trading channel in quantity.
Under the massive monetary assault.
In a short time, Lanlan acquired nearly a million ’Lord Contract Scrolls’ for Han Xing!

chapters.title: Chapter 323 - 256: Subjugating the Goblins, Prophet’s Cave
paragraphs: At this moment, facing the pile of Contract Scrolls stacked like a mountain, all the goblins fell silent, their expressions as pained as if they were constipated.
Han Xing showed a devilish smile at the corner of his mouth.
"From today onwards, all of you in the Goblin Race will serve me."
"You must work to earn the materials to live, and the chance to survive."
"Now, call out all of your tribe members!"
"In ten minutes, any goblin that hasn’t signed a contract will be considered a hostile creature by me, and will bear the consequences!"
Hearing Han Xing’s deadly threat.
All the goblins realized he was serious!
This human possessed terrifying power, capable of easily wiping out their entire race.
For a moment, a large number of goblins rushed forward in a frenzy to sign Contract Scrolls with Han Xing, fearing they might be a step too late.
Meanwhile, Han Xing received continuous prompts from the system.
In no time at all, tens of thousands of goblins on the surface had signed.
Then, more ordinary goblins crawled out from various burrows.
Their numbers were so dense, they resembled an explosion of a rat swarm.
Quickly, the entire Goblin Race on this Sky Island had signed contracts with Han Xing.
Then, hundreds of thousands of goblins respectfully knelt on the ground.
Han Xing was also satisfied as he looked at the scene before him.
At this moment, a system prompt arrived.
"You have cleared all hostile creatures, now this Sky Island is in an unowned state, do you want to merge it?"
Hearing the system prompt, Han Xing thought to himself, indeed.
As long as he turned all these goblins into his contract servants, it was equivalent to them becoming allied units.
The system would determine he had successfully dealt with all the monsters on this Sky Island.
Then, Han Xing directly clicked merge.
A system prompt appeared.

"Successfully merged Sky Island, your territory area has expanded, you have obtained territory resources: Rhythm Black Iron Vein*1... obtained goblin tents, goblin totems, goblin camps, Goblin Treasure Vault (locked)..."
A large amount of item information appeared on the system prompt.
From this long list of item information, it was clear how vast the resources within this Sky Island were.
At this moment, after signing the Lord Contract, the fear and reluctance in the eyes of the goblins vanished completely.
Now, it had all turned to admiration and respect!
At this time, Han Xing also saw the Loyalty above these goblins’ heads.
[Loyalty]: 80 (Respect)
All were above 80.
As long as they signed the Contract Scroll, these creatures’ Loyalty would be forcibly set to above 80.
Subsequently, as long as Han Xing didn’t excessively abuse them, the goblins’ Loyalty would not easily decline.
Moreover, with time or certain experiences, Loyalty would continue to rise.
Until Loyalty reached 100, which is the level of fanaticism, it would stop.
At this moment, the goblins collectively shouted loudly, "Greetings to the Lord!"
Listening to this, Han Xing also nodded in satisfaction.
Then, he stepped forward and said, "First, go to my territory and find a place to stay for a while."
"Later, I’ll arrange work for you."
Upon hearing this, the goblins responded in unison, "Order received, Lord!"
Then, the goblins ran in a grand procession to Han Xingkong Island.
After these goblins left.
Shen Yun asked from the side, "Brother Xing, what happened?"
Han Xing knew what he meant.
Originally, the plan was to kill all these goblins.
There was no need to go through so much trouble to get a bunch of Contract Scrolls for these creatures.
After all, apart from mining, these goblins had no combat ability.
This was a completely losing deal.
Han Xing pointed to the ground, at the corpse of the Goblin Prophet and said, "Because this guy offered a condition."
"A condition?" Everyone was taken aback.
Han Xing nodded, "Yes, this old goblin told me there is a Divine Artifact Level treasure in the Goblin Cave below."
"A Divine Artifact?" Shen Yun was visibly shocked.
"What kind of treasure, Brother Xing!"
Han Xing said, "It’s said to be a mask of the Goddess of Wealth."
"However, according to the old goblin, this treasure has a Special Effect, which is sensing Resource Sky Islands at an extremely long distance."
"Over the years, the Goblin Race relied on it to find numerous treasures on those Sky Islands."
"It taught me how to use it, on the condition that I spare the goblins."
Han Xing turned and smiled as he said, "So, I agreed."
After hearing this, everyone also looked enlightened.
At this time, Cheng Jianyong asked in confusion, "Then, since Brother Xing you promised not to kill them, why did the old goblin do that?"
"Did it seek death itself?"
This question was something everyone wanted to know.
The old goblin’s puzzling actions had everyone baffled.
Hearing this, Han Xing replied directly, "This old goblin was playing tricks with me."
"It deliberately provoked Xiaoyang to attack it, then died in front of these goblins."
"I don’t know its exact purpose."
"However, it’s likely trying to plant the seeds of hatred in the hearts of these goblins."
"And hatred is the fastest way for a race to rise."
After hearing this, everyone felt Han Xing’s guess made some sense.
Cheng Jianyong suddenly shouted angrily, "Damn it, this old goblin was still playing tricks with us!"
"However, it probably didn’t expect Brother Xing would use a large number of Contract Scrolls to make these goblins completely subjugated."
"Don’t even mention hatred, they probably have long forgotten about the old goblin’s death to the ends of the sky by now!"
