chapters.title: Chapter 324 - 256: Subjugating the Goblins, Prophet’s Cave
paragraphs: The team members laughed.
At this moment, Han Xing shook his head and said, "Alright, don’t worry about that old goblin."
"Now, let’s all go explore these goblin nests together and see if we can find some treasures!"
Everyone’s eyes lit up immediately.
As a race fond of collecting various rare treasures, the goblins have been developing here for so many years.
Their potential wealth must be incredible!
Moreover, among a string of system prompts, Han Xing also saw a special hint.
[Locked Vault]
This was the first time Han Xing encountered something locked,
so he was quite eager about what might be found in the Goblin Cave!
At this time.
Ten Thousand Stars City had already merged with this giant Sky Island, and the territory area has skyrocketed.
Han Xing looked at the goblins gathered together on the territory of Ten Thousand Stars City.
Then he randomly pointed at one and said, "Come here for a moment."
The goblin that was pointed at initially had a slightly confused look in its eyes.
Once it confirmed that Han Xing was calling it, the goblin’s confusion immediately turned into ecstasy.
It started walking quickly over, respectfully saying, "Greetings, Lord."
Han Xing noticed that this goblin’s appearance was a bit different.
Its feet were large, resembling fish fins, as if it had undergone some genetic mutation.
However, Han Xing didn’t pay it any mind and instead asked, "Are you familiar with the cave environment below?"
The goblin with large feet replied promptly, "Of course, Lord."
"I grew up down there, lived for decades, and memorized the paths of every tunnel."
Han Xing nodded, "Not bad."
"Do you know where the Prophet’s Cave is?"
This goblin was surprised when it heard the name ’Prophet’s Cave’.
Then, it replied directly, "I know, Lord."
"The Prophet’s Cave is the place where the Prophet most frequently stays, and only he can enter there."
Han Xing’s eyes brightened.
Because, before dying, that old goblin had told Han Xing that the place where the Divine Artifact was stored was right here.
"Very well, lead the way!" Han Xing said directly.
"Yes, Lord!"
The goblin finished speaking, found a ground hole, and dived straight into it.
Everyone followed behind it.
Looking at the eerie hole before them and the massive terrain of the entire Sky Island.
One could imagine a vast space hidden below.
Then, Han Xing took the lead and jumped down first.
The other team members followed suit.
This tunnel space was very narrow, just big enough to accommodate these goblins less than a meter tall.
As humans, they had to bend down slightly to barely make it through.
After passing through this long tunnel.
A complex network appeared before everyone’s eyes, with thousands of interconnecting passages, forming a mysterious and vast underground world.
The space inside was interconnected in all directions, and hundreds of thousands of goblins had long lived here.
The tunnels were filled with Dark Fire Stones, providing heat and lighting.
Additionally, each tunnel entrance was marked with landmarks and directions.
Ahead, the goblin, remembering the Lord’s command, led them straight toward the ’Prophet’s Cave’.
Everyone followed the goblin, twisting and turning, through the tunnels.
Just as they were about to become dizzy from all the turns.
Ahead, they finally saw a passage marked with special symbols.
The space here was much more spacious.
At the end of the passage, a massive stone was blocking the way.
At this time, the guiding goblin said, "We’re here, Lord. This is where the Prophet often stays."
"Except for him, no other goblin has ever ventured in."
"According to the Lord Prophet, the stone blocking the entrance to the passage weighs thousands of tons!"
"Even calling a hundred goblin warriors would not let anyone move this stone without the method of the Lord Prophet!"
Hearing this, everyone exchanged glances.
The giant stone before them was indeed quite large, and judging by its material, it was no ordinary stone.
Breaking through it would be quite challenging.
Shen Yun, standing by, asked, "Brother Xing, did the old goblin tell you how to move the stone?"
Han Xing shook his head.
However, Cheng Jianyong, the strongest member in the team concerning power, scoffed at hearing this, "What? No one can move this stone?"
"Let me try!"
Seeing Cheng Jianyong step forward, the goblin quickly said, "Please wait, warrior!"
"This stone has been enchanted by the Lord Prophet."
"If you don’t dispel the enchantment and force it open, you’ll suffer severe backlash, and even life-threatening danger!"
Hearing the goblin’s serious tone, Cheng Jianyong’s steps paused in mid-air.
Everyone knew that after signing the Lord Contract Scroll, the goblin wouldn’t deceive them.
It saying there was a life danger meant the enchantment must be quite formidable.
At this moment, Han Xing again felt that the old goblin was quite cunning, putting so many measures in the goblin pathways.
As everyone hesitated slightly.
Cheng Jianyong snorted coldly, "What could an enchantment from a Four-Star Lord level old goblin be capable of?"
"Let me see for myself!"
With that, he went directly to the stone, placed both hands on it, and shouted.
"Open for me!"
Rumble, rumble!
The entire passage began vibrating continuously.
At the same time.
The blue-black stone erupted with blinding red light.
It seemed as if Cheng Jianyong’s actions had triggered the enchantment on the stone!
Chi... Chi-chi...
The red light began to erode Cheng Jianyong’s body.
The goblin beside them exclaimed in panic, "It’s over, it’s over!"
"This lord has already triggered the enchantment. If he doesn’t stop, he’ll really be killed by its backlash!"
But Han Xing and the others could not see that Cheng Jianyong was in any grave danger.
All they saw was him holding the stone, his expression a bit pale, yet he was still struggling against the enchantment’s energy.
Moments later, Cheng Jianyong suddenly grinned.
"This enchantment... doesn’t seem so hard to handle?"
"It couldn’t even break my armor, hahaha!"
Cheng Jianyong was overjoyed.
The golden armor he wore, besides offering nearly terrifying combat capabilities, provided formidable defense power.
Even a Four-Star Elite could not typically break its defense.
Enveloped in the goblin’s astonished gaze, the stone, once considered immovable by any force.
At this moment, was actually being forced a few centimeters away by this human’s brute force.
Cheng Jianyong continued exerting force, his face flushed, holding his breath.
"Come on! Open for me!"
Rumble! Rumble!
The trembling of the passage grew stronger.
With a screeching sound.
The enchantment on the whole stone seemed to be announcing its failure.
The stone subsequently rolled aside.
This scene left the nearby goblin gaping.
Cheng Jianyong now took a heavy breath and arrogantly said, "A mere rock is nothing but this, hahaha!"
Seeing his boastful manner, everyone wasn’t surprised.
After all, after completing the Fourth Transformation, Cheng Jianyong’s power had already exceeded two thousand points.
Plus, he recently equipped the full Buxa Set, enchanting it with the Destruction Rune, pushing his strength attribute to a remarkably high level.
So, Cheng Jianyong moving the stone was expected.
At this moment.
Han Xing gazed past Cheng Jianyong’s figure.
An obscure cave appeared before him.
This appeared to be the area where the Goblin Prophet usually lived.
Inside were stone beds, stone tables, stone stools, and other furniture...
However, Han Xing’s eyes were instantly drawn to the center of the cave, where there was a blue-black stone platform.
On the platform, quietly lay a pale golden mask.
Han Xing’s eyes shone brightly.
He quickly stepped forward and picked up the mask!

chapters.title: Chapter 325 - 257: Divine Artifact Mask, Goblin Treasure Vault!
paragraphs: At this moment, a system notification appeared.
"You have obtained a special item: Mask of the Golden Goddess (Red)."
The word ’Red’ at the end was so glaring.
Han Xing’s eyes opened wide!
The old goblin was not lying; this item was truly a divine artifact.
And it’s not just any divine artifact; it involves a legendary deity, Wujin.
A legendary Goddess of Wealth!
No wonder the Goblin Elder said it’s an artifact that can make an entire tribe prosper!
Then, with trembling hands, Han Xing checked the attributes of this mask.
[Mask of the Golden Goddess (Red)]: Special Equipment.
[Equipment Effect]: After binding with the Mask of the Golden Goddess, the character’s Luck Value attributes increase by +10 (hidden attributes, cannot be viewed through the character panel).
[Accompanying Unique Effect]: Wujin Revelation (Different revelation effects are triggered by offering a specific quantity of sacrifices).
Note: After the initial binding, a specific sacrifice must be offered to activate different revelation effects.
After reading the attributes of this mask, although Han Xing’s face still showed surprise, he was also somewhat puzzled.
This item, unlike the ’Oracle Throne’, does not directly provide survivors with powerful combat and survival abilities.
The effect introduction above is also very vague, requiring a specified number of sacrifices to open.
However, connecting it to the mask’s name, Han Xing suddenly understood.
After all, she’s the Goddess of Wealth; her hobby in life was collecting all the precious things in the world.
To use her mask, beings must offer a certain number of sacrifices.
This personality is somewhat similar to Han Xing’s.
At this moment, a system notification appeared.
"Would you like to bind the special unique item: Mask of the Golden Goddess? Once bound, this item cannot be traded or transferred. If the survivor dies, the item will automatically disappear."
This was the first time Han Xing had bound a special divine artifact-level item; hearing the system prompt, there was a hint of surprise in his eyes.
"Cannot be traded, and it will automatically disappear if one dies?
Although a bit puzzled, Han Xing still clicked bind directly.
"Binding successful, Luck Value attributes +10."
At this moment, the other team members all looked at Han Xing with curious eyes.
Han Xing knew their thoughts, so he directly posted the attributes of this mask to satisfy their curiosity.
However, after reading the mask’s attributes, their expressions became even more puzzled.
"Increases Luck Value, what kind of attribute is this?"
Everyone shook their heads, their eyes also full of confusion.
Cheng Jianyong saw the last note on the mask and asked, "This divine artifact is really freaking weird, isn’t it?"
"Effects not specified, need to offer sacrifices to activate?"
"Damn, were we tricked by that old goblin?"
At this point, Han Xing shook his head and said, "Not at all, that old goblin told me the activation method for the effects and what the sacrifices are."
After hearing this, everyone nodded in realization.
Han Xing continued:
"The old goblin said the mask has been in its possession for decades."
"Over the years, it has offered countless rare treasures to experiment with the mask’s effect, but mostly, they were met with no response."
"However, it wasn’t all for nothing."
"At times, when offering certain materials to a specific quantity, it would trigger the Wujin Goddess’s revelation."
"Different materials bring different revelation effects."
"Through repeated failures, the old goblin finally activated three special effects."
Everyone listened intently.
Han Xing paused, then continued: "These three special effects are ’Eye of Treasure’, ’Eye of Desire’, and ’Eye of the Divine’."
"The sacrifices required are 100 million Spirit Cores, 100,000 Permanent Gold Ingots, and 100 pieces of Philosopher’s Stone."
After hearing this, everyone showed a look of understanding.
At this point, Shen Yun asked, "Brother Xing, do you want to activate it now to see?"
Han Xing smiled and nodded.
He directly opened the warehouse interface for his territory and checked his territory’s resources.
On it, the quantities behind thousands of materials had reached astronomical numbers.
Including Spirit Cores and Permanent Gold Ingots, Han Xing had a large reserve!
Except for a shortage of Philosopher’s Stone reserves, with only 1121 pieces left.
However, he could still afford 100 Philosopher’s Stones.
Han Xing clicked the + sign on the divine artifact mask effect.
A system notification appeared.
[Would you like to sacrifice 1 billion Spirit Cores, 100,000 Permanent Gold Ingots, and 100 Philosopher’s Stones to activate the ’Wujin Goddess Revelation’?]
"Yes."
The next moment, a massive amount of materials disappeared from the warehouse.
The mask erupted with dazzling golden light.
Then, the entire Prophet’s Cave was filled with golden light, so bright that everyone could not open their eyes.
At this moment, a mysterious power suddenly descended.
This power far surpassed legend, and just a trace made everyone involuntarily kneel!
Above, everyone felt a vast, ethereal power.
As if a deity had descended!
Thud!
Before Han Xing and the others could react.
Nearby, the goblin had already knelt directly.
This scene left everyone speechless.
At this moment, Han Xing and the others gritted their teeth, struggling to hold on.
But thankfully, the power didn’t last long and disappeared directly.
At this moment, a system notification appeared.
"Successfully activated the effects of the Wujin Goddess Mask: Eye of Treasure, Eye of Desire, Eye of the Divine."
[Eye of Treasure]: Opens the effect of Eye of Treasure for survivors, allowing exploration and marking of resource Sky Islands within a range of 10 to 1,000,000 kilometers.

chapters.title: Chapter 326 - 257: Divine Artifact Mask, Goblin Treasure Vault!
paragraphs: Note: Each time the "Eye of Treasure" is activated, a tribute of 100 million Spirit Cores is required. The special effect lasts for ten seconds with a 24-hour cooldown.
[Eye of Desire]: Activates the Eye of Desire effect for the Survivor, allowing them to locate the items and resources they currently need most, highlighted for easy identification.

Note: Each time the "Eye of Desire" is activated, a tribute of 100,000 Permanent Gold Ingots is required. This special effect lasts for ten seconds and can be stacked with the Eye of Treasure effect, with a 24-hour cooldown.
[Eye of the Divine]: Upon activation of the Eye of the Divine effect, the Survivor’s critical strike rate is increased by 100%, and critical strike damage by 150%.
With each attack, the target’s armor is reduced by 10%, up to a maximum of 50%. (Ineffective against beings above Demigod Level).
Note: Each time the "Eye of the Divine" is activated, a tribute of 100 Philosopher’s Stones is required. This special effect lasts for ten seconds with a 24-hour cooldown.
At this moment, having read through the activated effects of the mask, Han Xing’s eyes were filled with unparalleled shock!
Could it truly be worthy of being called a Divine Artifact level item?
These three special effects, each more terrifying than the last.
The first special effect, Eye of Treasure, upon activation, is equivalent to automatically enabling a search area, which can help Han Xing locate nearby Sky Island resources.
The second special effect, Eye of Desire, though its specific effects are unknown, if it truly works as described, could help Han Xing find the things he needs most.
The effect it unleashes might be even more terrifying.
What surprised Han Xing the most, however, was the final "Eye of the Divine" special effect.
The critical strike rate and critical strike damage in the forefront need no further explanation.
But the effect that reduces armor was what truly surprised Han Xing.
According to the note, it is ineffective against beings above Demigod Level.
This means that.
As long as the target is below Demigod Level, including beings at the Demigod Level, they will be affected by this special effect!
Once an attack hits, the armor is directly weakened by 50%.
If an ordinary legendary being is affected by this special effect, their Defense will be greatly reduced.
By then, it’s possible they could actually cause damage to Legendary Powerhouses!
At this moment, Han Xing took a deep breath.
He realized the terror and importance of this mask in his hand.
If used correctly, this "Eye of the Divine" might really allow him to possess the Power to contend with legends during the Fourth Transformation stage!
And this was something Han Xing had been pursuing all along!
Seeing the expectant eyes of the others.
Han Xing directly posted the attributes of the activated mask.
Seeing the attributes of these three special effects, the team members were utterly shocked!
Cheng Jianyong exclaimed, "Damn, this is too damn outrageous, isn’t it?"
"Each of these special effects is so abnormal?"
Shen Yun nodded, swallowing involuntarily, and said, "Indeed, if used well, the first two special effects can help us find a lot of precious resources."
"However, each activation requires an investment of 100 million Spirit Cores and 100,000 Permanent Gold Ingots. This cost is quite hard to bear."
"At this stage, besides Brother Xing, others can’t recklessly use this mask; it’s really too expensive."
Everyone nodded in agreement.
The attributes of the "Mask of the Golden Goddess" were beyond expectations.
Han Xing was quite satisfied too.
He then directly stored the mask in his backpack.
With a stroke of fortune, Han Xing’s mood improved significantly.
He looked at the goblin guide outside the door and asked, "What’s your name?"
The goblin quickly replied, "My Lord, we goblins with no combat ability don’t have names. Usually, my companions call me Big Toe, so you can call me Big Toe too."
Han Xing didn’t mind the goblin’s weird name and replied, "You did well. If you encounter any problems in the future, you can come to me."
The goblin, as if granted a great grace, expressed its joy and knelt on the ground, saying, "Thank you, my Lord!"
Han Xing nodded and then said directly, "Big Toe, do you know the location of the Goblin Treasure Vault?"
Big Toe was stunned upon hearing this, a hint of hesitation flashing in its eyes.
After all, the goblin treasure vault was the lifeline of their race.
It was the accumulation of tens of thousands of goblins over many years.
In their eyes, it was as important as Life itself.
However, under the influence of the Lord Contract, they prioritized Han Xing’s orders.
Eventually, the goblin ceased its internal struggle and replied, "My Lord, I know where it is. Do you wish to see it?"
Han Xing nodded, "Yes."
"Alright, my Lord, I will lead you there now."
Saying this, the goblin began to lead the group through the Goblin Maze once more.
Han Xing exchanged glances with his team, their faces showing a trace of joy.
They were immensely looking forward to the items within the goblin treasure vault!
After passing through several corridors, the group was nearly dizzy from the labyrinthine paths.
Finally, they arrived in front of a massive stone wall.
Below the wall was an iron door made entirely of Rhythm Black Iron.
The corners of everyone’s mouths twitched.
These iron doors stood at least ten meters high and three meters wide.
Considering their thickness, it’s likely the goblin race consumed an astonishing amount of Rhythm Black Iron to forge them.
Once again, Cheng Jianyong took the lead, rushing to the iron door, attempting to push it open with brute force.
But no matter how hard he tried, even using all his strength, he couldn’t push the iron door open.
Cheng Jianyong was infuriated, activating his equipment’s special effects one by one, his momentum continuously rising.
"Heave ho! Open for me!!!" Cheng Jianyong shouted.
The veins on his forehead bulged, using almost all his Power.
The nearby corridor began to shake violently.
However, apart from a few slight tremors, the iron door did not budge.
Han Xing, seeing that he wanted to continue, stopped him from behind.
"Cheng Jianyong, stop trying.
"For an iron door made of such special metal, it can’t be opened by pure Power alone."
Cheng Jianyong nodded, halting his attempts.
Han Xing then turned to the goblin behind him and asked, "Big Toe, do you know how to open these two iron doors?"
The goblin’s eyes flashed with a recollective expression upon hearing this.
It seemed to be trying to remember something.
After a moment, Big Toe slowly spoke, "My Lord, I remember now!"
"The Lord Prophet said there is a special Array on these doors that he placed. Only those recognized by the Goblin Race can open it."
"If you try to force it open, the Array will trigger the taboo inside, blowing up the entire vault!"
Hearing the goblin’s words, Han Xing’s heart skipped a beat.
He didn’t doubt that the goblin was lying to him.
Han Xing simply didn’t expect that the old goblin would have kept a backup plan in this situation.
The old goblin knew that after being dealt with by Han Xing, he would definitely target the goblin race’s treasure vault.
But due to the restrictive measures, forcing it open would cause an explosion.
And he would gain nothing from it.
Therefore, for Han Xing to open the vault, he had to be recognized by the Goblin Race.
As a result, he wouldn’t kill off the Goblin Race en masse.
He might even provide them with good treatment to gain their trust.
At this moment, Han Xing truly appreciated the old goblin’s cunning.
He quietly thought, "Damn it, this old goblin is quite a talent."
"Truly becoming wiser with age, laying down so many backup plans in such a short time."
"If he could be used by me, he might produce unexpected results."
Thanks to the existence of the Lord Contract, Han Xing wasn’t worried about being unable to control this old goblin.
However, given the old goblin’s abilities, it probably foresaw this as well, hence choosing to die, giving Han Xing no chance at all.
Thinking this far, Han Xing shook his head.
Since he’s already dead, there’s no point in dwelling on it.
But, no matter how astute the old goblin was, he hadn’t calculated that Han Xing would suddenly acquire so many lord contracts.
He didn’t need to slowly earn the goblin tribe’s trust.
Now, he was the acknowledged master of this group of goblins.
Thus, this iron door posed no real obstacle for him.
He turned his gaze back to the iron door.
With decades of goblin heritage.
This vault must be filled with a tremendous number of extremely precious treasures!
With that thought, Han Xing’s anticipation grew even stronger!

sentences.text: Note: Each time the "Eye of Treasure" is activated, a tribute of 100 million Spirit Cores is required.
The special effect lasts for ten seconds with a 24-hour cooldown.
[Eye of Desire]: Activates the Eye of Desire effect for the Survivor, allowing them to locate the items and resources they currently need most, highlighted for easy identification.
Note: Each time the "Eye of Desire" is activated, a tribute of 100,000 Permanent Gold Ingots is required.
This special effect lasts for ten seconds and can be stacked with the Eye of Treasure effect, with a 24-hour cooldown.
[Eye of the Divine]: Upon activation of the Eye of the Divine effect, the Survivor’s critical strike rate is increased by 100%, and critical strike damage by 150%.
With each attack, the target’s armor is reduced by 10%, up to a maximum of 50%. (Ineffective against beings above Demigod Level).
Note: Each time the "Eye of the Divine" is activated, a tribute of 100 Philosopher’s Stones is required.
This special effect lasts for ten seconds with a 24-hour cooldown.
At this moment, having read through the activated effects of the mask, Han Xing’s eyes were filled with unparalleled shock!
Could it truly be worthy of being called a Divine Artifact level item?
These three special effects, each more terrifying than the last.
The first special effect, Eye of Treasure, upon activation, is equivalent to automatically enabling a search area, which can help Han Xing locate nearby Sky Island resources.
The second special effect, Eye of Desire, though its specific effects are unknown, if it truly works as described, could help Han Xing find the things he needs most.
The effect it unleashes might be even more terrifying.
What surprised Han Xing the most, however, was the final "Eye of the Divine" special effect.
The critical strike rate and critical strike damage in the forefront need no further explanation.
But the effect that reduces armor was what truly surprised Han Xing.
According to the note, it is ineffective against beings above Demigod Level.
This means that.
As long as the target is below Demigod Level, including beings at the Demigod Level, they will be affected by this special effect!
Once an attack hits, the armor is directly weakened by 50%.
If an ordinary legendary being is affected by this special effect, their Defense will be greatly reduced.
By then, it’s possible they could actually cause damage to Legendary Powerhouses!
At this moment, Han Xing took a deep breath.
He realized the terror and importance of this mask in his hand.
If used correctly, this "Eye of the Divine" might really allow him to possess the Power to contend with legends during the Fourth Transformation stage!
And this was something Han Xing had been pursuing all along!
Seeing the expectant eyes of the others.
Han Xing directly posted the attributes of the activated mask.
Seeing the attributes of these three special effects, the team members were utterly shocked!
Cheng Jianyong exclaimed, "Damn, this is too damn outrageous, isn’t it?"
"Each of these special effects is so abnormal?"
Shen Yun nodded, swallowing involuntarily, and said, "Indeed, if used well, the first two special effects can help us find a lot of precious resources."
"However, each activation requires an investment of 100 million Spirit Cores and 100,000 Permanent Gold Ingots.
This cost is quite hard to bear."
"At this stage, besides Brother Xing, others can’t recklessly use this mask; it’s really too expensive."
Everyone nodded in agreement.
The attributes of the "Mask of the Golden Goddess" were beyond expectations.
Han Xing was quite satisfied too.
He then directly stored the mask in his backpack.
With a stroke of fortune, Han Xing’s mood improved significantly.
He looked at the goblin guide outside the door and asked, "What’s your name?"
The goblin quickly replied, "My Lord, we goblins with no combat ability don’t have names.
Usually, my companions call me Big Toe, so you can call me Big Toe too."
Han Xing didn’t mind the goblin’s weird name and replied, "You did well.
If you encounter any problems in the future, you can come to me."
The goblin, as if granted a great grace, expressed its joy and knelt on the ground, saying, "Thank you, my Lord!"
Han Xing nodded and then said directly, "Big Toe, do you know the location of the Goblin Treasure Vault?"
Big Toe was stunned upon hearing this, a hint of hesitation flashing in its eyes.
After all, the goblin treasure vault was the lifeline of their race.
It was the accumulation of tens of thousands of goblins over many years.
In their eyes, it was as important as Life itself.
However, under the influence of the Lord Contract, they prioritized Han Xing’s orders.
Eventually, the goblin ceased its internal struggle and replied, "My Lord, I know where it is.
Do you wish to see it?"
Han Xing nodded, "Yes."
"Alright, my Lord, I will lead you there now."
Saying this, the goblin began to lead the group through the Goblin Maze once more.
Han Xing exchanged glances with his team, their faces showing a trace of joy.
They were immensely looking forward to the items within the goblin treasure vault!
After passing through several corridors, the group was nearly dizzy from the labyrinthine paths.
Finally, they arrived in front of a massive stone wall.
Below the wall was an iron door made entirely of Rhythm Black Iron.
The corners of everyone’s mouths twitched.
These iron doors stood at least ten meters high and three meters wide.
Considering their thickness, it’s likely the goblin race consumed an astonishing amount of Rhythm Black Iron to forge them.
Once again, Cheng Jianyong took the lead, rushing to the iron door, attempting to push it open with brute force.
But no matter how hard he tried, even using all his strength, he couldn’t push the iron door open.
Cheng Jianyong was infuriated, activating his equipment’s special effects one by one, his momentum continuously rising.
"Heave ho!
Open for me!!!" Cheng Jianyong shouted.
The veins on his forehead bulged, using almost all his Power.
The nearby corridor began to shake violently.
However, apart from a few slight tremors, the iron door did not budge.
Han Xing, seeing that he wanted to continue, stopped him from behind.
"Cheng Jianyong, stop trying.
"For an iron door made of such special metal, it can’t be opened by pure Power alone."
Cheng Jianyong nodded, halting his attempts.
Han Xing then turned to the goblin behind him and asked, "Big Toe, do you know how to open these two iron doors?"
The goblin’s eyes flashed with a recollective expression upon hearing this.
It seemed to be trying to remember something.

chapters.title: Chapter 327 - 258: Unlocking the Treasury, Overnight Fortune!
paragraphs: Han Xing was particularly looking forward to the treasures contained in the vault!
Then, he stepped forward, placed both hands on the iron door, and gently pushed.
Accompanied by the creaking sound,
the iron door gradually revealed a gap.
Strong joy appeared on everyone’s faces.
"It really works!" Cheng Jianyong exclaimed in amazement from behind.
"As expected, Brother Xing is the best!"
He gave a big thumbs up.
From this gap, suddenly burst a dazzling golden light.
Even before it was fully opened, everyone felt the breath of treasures hitting them.
It was the aura of various treasures.
"Whoa, is it this exaggerated?"
"How many treasures have your Goblin Race hoarded?" Han Xing asked.
The goblin chuckled awkwardly, "Well, I’m not quite sure, I’m just a regular laborer."
"Actually, over the years, most of the resources have been consumed by ourselves, making machines, weapons, etc., using up quite a bit."
"However, what we consumed were ordinary resources, the more precious ores and rare treasures were all placed in the vault."
"The materials inside were carefully selected by Lord Prophet, so they are all good stuff."
After hearing this, the anticipation in everyone’s eyes grew stronger.
Even Han Xing unconsciously exerted more force in his hands.
As the iron door continued to open, the colorful glow of the treasures grew even more splendid.
It even made everyone unable to open their eyes.
Creak! Creak!
Once the opening was wide enough for one person to pass through, Han Xing couldn’t wait, directly squeezed into the goblin’s vault.
"Follow up!" Han Xing’s voice came from inside.
Everyone’s eyes lit up when they heard this.
Then they followed in single file.
What they saw next was the most shocking scene of their lives.
In front, there were piles of dazzling, mountain-like precious gems.
In the corner, they saw a heap of Shadow Divine Stones emitting black smoke, roughly estimated to be three to four thousand pieces.
The Rhythm Black Iron was even more impressive, being the main material of this Sky Island, it was piled directly into a huge mountain in this vault!
Next to it, there was also a heap of Philosopher’s Stones emitting a red glow, numbering in the several thousands as well.
Besides these, they also saw Lava Crystal Stones steaming with heat, Ice Crystal Stones radiating intense cold, and Thunder Stones sparking with electricity.
A dazzling array, overwhelming to the eyes!
"Oh my god, oh my god, oh my god!"
"We’re rich, we’re really rich this time!"
"Damn, so many Philosopher’s Stones, so many Shadow Divine Stones!"
Cheng Jianyong exclaimed dramatically from the side!
But no one said anything.
After all, this haul was indeed terrifyingly great.
Even with Han Xing’s composure, he couldn’t help but feel a little breathless, not to mention the others.
Now, the five of them stood in front of the pile of gems, dumbfounded as if they had discovered a Giant Dragon’s treasure.
Han Xing swallowed hard and then couldn’t wait to start tallying the gains this time.
Apart from that heap of Shadow Divine Stones and Philosopher’s Stones.
Han Xing also saw some stones beside them with a transparent sheen but exuding a mysterious aura.
Glancing casually, this haul rivaled the mission rewards for escorting Wu Ling’Er.
Although it wasn’t enough to completely rid him of worries about these high-level materials,
this fortune could almost be described as instant wealth overnight!
Han Xing walked to the middle of the pile of gems, picked up a seemingly transparent yet glowing stone.
A trace of expectation appeared in Han Xing’s eyes, and he said excitedly, "I hope this is the stone I’ve been looking for."
The attributes of the stone appeared in front of him.
[Shimmering Terra Stone]: A peculiar stone containing the Power of Creation, with a strong spatial stabilization effect.
At this moment, Han Xing was exhilarated: "It’s truly the Shimmering Terra Stone!"
"Great!"
Looking at the small mountain in front of him, a rough estimate showed that there were at least two thousand Shimmering Terra Stones!
Han Xing was immensely excited, "Great, four out of the five materials needed to craft the Oracle Throne are now gathered."
"Now, I just need to find the last material, the Divine Oracle Scripture, and I can start crafting this Divine Artifact."
"By then, I will finally have the power to defend myself in the face of a Legend!"
Han Xing clenched his fist, and a gleam flashed in his eyes.
Then, he turned around and said to the goblin: "Big Toe, there’s nothing more for you here, you can go."
The goblin, after hearing this, hurriedly left respectfully.
After that, Han Xing directly opened the territory interface and issued an order to a group of Wolf Cavalry.
A few minutes later, a few hundred robust Wolf Cavalry, each carrying a large box, arrived at the goblin’s mine.
Han Xing watched as this group of Wolf Cavalry packed all the piles of gems into treasure chests.
They were going to transport these gems and metals back to the warehouse in Ten Thousand Stars City.
Even though this Sky Island was already occupied by Han Xing and was his territory,
only by keeping these treasures under his pillow could Han Xing truly feel at ease!
This trip to the goblin’s mine resulted in gains far beyond anyone’s expectations.
Not only did they obtain a Divine Artifact Level mask, but they also acquired a large amount of high-level gems!
With satisfaction on their faces, everyone left the goblin’s mine together.
Then, Han Xing returned to his territory.
There, hundreds of thousands of goblins were waiting expectantly for Han Xing’s command.
Seeing those hundreds of thousands of rat-like eyes, all staring intently at him.

chapters.title: Chapter 328 - 258: Unlocking the Treasure Vault, Overnight Riches! (Part 2)
paragraphs: Han Xing said to them, "The goblin mine cave, where you previously lived, has been requisitioned by me."
"From now on, you can live in my territory."
"I will provide you with various living supplies and safety protection."
"But in return, you must exchange labor for these resources, understand?"
A group of goblins nodded after hearing his words, indicating they had no objections.
Han Xing nodded.
Then, he assigned a task to this group of goblins, which was to continue mining this mountain.
It contains a large amount of Rhythm Black Iron.
If it can be fully extracted, it would be an astonishing income.
It can prepare him for future ventures into the Dwarf Race territory.
As for the residence of this group of goblins, due to their nature, they were uncomfortable living in those spacious houses, preferring to live in underground tunnels.
Han Xing casually picked a mountain range and let them dig and build houses themselves.
The next day...
When the sun rose.
Hundreds of thousands of goblins emerged from the tunnels, forming long lines.
They came to an open space, picked up their mining tools, and began the excavation work on the mine where they previously lived.
As agreed upon, the adult goblins needed to exchange labor for the living resources needed for the entire tribe.
Except for the really old goblins and young ones still in the growth stage, all other goblins must come out to work.
Including the female goblins, everyone was treated equally by Han Xing.
At this moment, you could see the goblins either carrying mining picks or pushing mining carts, heading towards the Black Iron Mine.
Mining is one of the Talent Skills of the Goblin Race.
Under Han Xing’s command, hundreds of thousands of goblins began mining the mountain.
With the sound of clinking chimes.
Large rocks containing Rhythm Black Iron were broken apart, and then transported by a special team to the nearby Smelting Workshop.
After processing, these ores were refined and shaped.
Then, they turned into blocks of Rhythm Black Iron.
At this moment.
Han Xing looked at the long lines of goblins in the territory, forming an assembly line operation.
Almost every minute, new ores were extracted and sent to one Smelting Workshop after another for processing.
Then, the Minotaurs transported the Rhythm Black Iron pieces into the warehouse.
Everything was proceeding methodically, realizing assembly line work.
And on his territory resources, the number of Rhythm Black Iron was rising at a rate of 7 to 10 pieces per second.
Han Xing set the working hours for the goblins to be six hours, with a one-hour break in between.
However, it was divided into two shifts of goblins working alternately.
Thus, a day consisted of twelve hours of continuous profit for Han Xing.
Now, he could harvest hundreds of thousands of pieces of Rhythm Black Iron daily!
Previously, this group of goblins treated the mountain as their residence, so they didn’t extract much Rhythm Black Iron ore.
However, now under Han Xing’s instructions, they began large-scale excavation.
The efficiency of work by hundreds of thousands of goblins was astonishing.
According to Han Xing’s estimate, it would take only about half a month to empty the mountain.
And Han Xing would obtain at least millions of pieces of Rhythm Black Iron from it!
Han Xing was also pleased and said, "Although I don’t know how much Rhythm Black Iron the Dwarf Race needs to exchange for an Ancient Weapon Blueprint."
"But with my current reserves, it should be more than enough."
"By then, once I establish a trade route with Wu Ling’Er, I can start mass-producing various Ancient Weapons!"
"Then, even if facing a Legend, they’ll be blasted away by me."
"I can dominate the entire Holy Spirit Realm, hahaha!"
Han Xing thought arrogantly and couldn’t help but laugh heartily.
Below, Cheng Jianyong and the others heard Han Xing’s laughter and exchanged glances.
"What’s Brother Xing thinking about laughing so happily?" Cheng Jianyong asked.
Shen Yun shrugged, indicating that he didn’t know either.
At this moment, Han Xing’s figure suddenly disappeared.
The next moment, he appeared directly in front of them.
The almost teleport-like speed shocked everyone secretly.
Han Xing then said, "Alright, today we continue to explore the Sky Island to see if we can find more surprises!"
Then, he pulled out a light golden mask from his bag.
Beside him, Shen Yun and others also had their eyes lit up.
This mask was the Divine Artifact, ’Mask of the Golden Goddess’s Treasure Mask’, they found in the Goblin Cave yesterday.
"Brother Xing, are you going to activate the mask’s special effects now?" Shen Yun asked with a smile.
Han Xing nodded.
After hearing his response, everyone’s eyes were filled with anticipation.
After all, they also wanted to see the magical effects of this mask!
Then, Han Xing pressed the activation button, and a system prompt appeared.
"Do you want to consume ten million Spirit Cores to activate the Mask of the Golden Goddess’s special effect: Eye of Treasure?"
"Do you want to consume 100,000 Permanent Gold Ingots to activate the Mask of the Golden Goddess’s special effect: Eye of Desire?"
Han Xing directly pressed yes.
Previous attributes information on the mask indicated that the two special effects could be stacked.
Since he decided to use it, Han Xing naturally wanted to maximize the effects!
The next moment, materials worth billions of Spirit Cores in the Lord’s Mansion warehouse vanished.
In exchange, was ten seconds of perception effect!
At this moment.
With the mask on, Han Xing suddenly felt the world before his eyes change.
The territory, the sky, the clouds all disappeared at this moment!
A vast, empty space appeared before his eyes.
This space was incredibly large, and Han Xing seemed to have God’s Perspective, overlooking the scenes within this void.
As his perception spread, weak specks of light began to appear within this void.
When the number of light spots reached tens of thousands.
Han Xing found the brightest light spot was right under his feet
With various colors of red, white, and purple intertwined to form a huge ball of light.
Nearby light spots were mostly ordinary white, only the size of rice grains.
Compared to Han Xing’s location’s light spot, they were akin to fireflies against the brightness of the Bright Moon.
Han Xing pondered, "These light spots should be the Sky Island locations around here."
"And the largest light spot here must be my Ten Thousand Stars City."
At this moment, Han Xing also realized, "It turns out these light spots are marked with different brightness based on the level of resources on the Sky Islands."
"The more resources on a Sky Island, the larger and brighter the light!"
At this moment, Ten Thousand Stars City stored massive precious resources, causing its light to shine so intensely.
Compared to Ten Thousand Stars City, other Sky Islands were on a completely different level.
Additionally, as Han Xing’s perception range expanded.
He faintly sensed that the positions of Sky Islands within thousands of kilometers’ range were all marked out.
Among them, Han Xing also saw some unexpected surprises.
Spotting some extremely large light spots, although not as large as Ten Thousand Stars City, still ten times bigger than ordinary Sky Islands!
"Oh? Is there such a massive light spot nearby thousands of kilometers?"
"Could it be holding extremely abundant resources?"
Han Xing felt a rush of excitement.
He memorized the locations of these two Sky Islands, preparing to find an opportunity to explore them.
Currently the special effect ’Eye of Treasure’ had seven seconds left, Han Xing memorized hundreds of brighter light spots among tens of thousands of Sky Islands.
These were the places he intended to explore next.
"This Mask of the Golden Goddess is truly a treasure!"
At this moment, Han Xing couldn’t help but exclaim again.
Not to mention the other two special effects, the Eye of Treasure alone could significantly aid him.
With the support of the Divine Artifact Mask, his exploration speed will increase by several times, even ten times!
Han Xing continued sensing this Chaos Space.
The next moment.
Han Xing suddenly saw a gigantic ball of light, shining dozens, even hundreds of times brighter than his Ten Thousand Stars City!

Including the female goblins, everyone was treated equally by Han Xing.
At this moment, you could see the goblins either carrying mining picks or pushing mining carts, heading towards the Black Iron Mine.
Mining is one of the Talent Skills of the Goblin Race.
Under Han Xing’s command, hundreds of thousands of goblins began mining the mountain.
With the sound of clinking chimes.
Large rocks containing Rhythm Black Iron were broken apart, and then transported by a special team to the nearby Smelting Workshop.
After processing, these ores were refined and shaped.
Then, they turned into blocks of Rhythm Black Iron.
At this moment.
Han Xing looked at the long lines of goblins in the territory, forming an assembly line operation.
Almost every minute, new ores were extracted and sent to one Smelting Workshop after another for processing.
Then, the Minotaurs transported the Rhythm Black Iron pieces into the warehouse.
Everything was proceeding methodically, realizing assembly line work.
And on his territory resources, the number of Rhythm Black Iron was rising at a rate of 7 to 10 pieces per second.
Han Xing set the working hours for the goblins to be six hours, with a one-hour break in between.
However, it was divided into two shifts of goblins working alternately.
Thus, a day consisted of twelve hours of continuous profit for Han Xing.
Now, he could harvest hundreds of thousands of pieces of Rhythm Black Iron daily!
Previously, this group of goblins treated the mountain as their residence, so they didn’t extract much Rhythm Black Iron ore.
However, now under Han Xing’s instructions, they began large-scale excavation.
The efficiency of work by hundreds of thousands of goblins was astonishing.
According to Han Xing’s estimate, it would take only about half a month to empty the mountain.
And Han Xing would obtain at least millions of pieces of Rhythm Black Iron from it!
Han Xing was also pleased and said, "Although I don’t know how much Rhythm Black Iron the Dwarf Race needs to exchange for an Ancient Weapon Blueprint."
"But with my current reserves, it should be more than enough."
"By then, once I establish a trade route with Wu Ling’Er, I can start mass-producing various Ancient Weapons!"
"Then, even if facing a Legend, they’ll be blasted away by me."
"I can dominate the entire Holy Spirit Realm, hahaha!"
Han Xing thought arrogantly and couldn’t help but laugh heartily.
Below, Cheng Jianyong and the others heard Han Xing’s laughter and exchanged glances.
"What’s Brother Xing thinking about laughing so happily?" Cheng Jianyong asked.
Shen Yun shrugged, indicating that he didn’t know either.
At this moment, Han Xing’s figure suddenly disappeared.
The next moment, he appeared directly in front of them.
The almost teleport-like speed shocked everyone secretly.
Han Xing then said, "Alright, today we continue to explore the Sky Island to see if we can find more surprises!"
Then, he pulled out a light golden mask from his bag.
Beside him, Shen Yun and others also had their eyes lit up.
This mask was the Divine Artifact, ’Mask of the Golden Goddess’s Treasure Mask’, they found in the Goblin Cave yesterday.
"Brother Xing, are you going to activate the mask’s special effects now?" Shen Yun asked with a smile.
Han Xing nodded.
After hearing his response, everyone’s eyes were filled with anticipation.
After all, they also wanted to see the magical effects of this mask!
Then, Han Xing pressed the activation button, and a system prompt appeared.
"Do you want to consume ten million Spirit Cores to activate the Mask of the Golden Goddess’s special effect: Eye of Treasure?"
"Do you want to consume 100,000 Permanent Gold Ingots to activate the Mask of the Golden Goddess’s special effect: Eye of Desire?"
Han Xing directly pressed yes.
Previous attributes information on the mask indicated that the two special effects could be stacked.
Since he decided to use it, Han Xing naturally wanted to maximize the effects!
The next moment, materials worth billions of Spirit Cores in the Lord’s Mansion warehouse vanished.
In exchange, was ten seconds of perception effect!
At this moment.
With the mask on, Han Xing suddenly felt the world before his eyes change.
The territory, the sky, the clouds all disappeared at this moment!
A vast, empty space appeared before his eyes.
This space was incredibly large, and Han Xing seemed to have God’s Perspective, overlooking the scenes within this void.
As his perception spread, weak specks of light began to appear within this void.
When the number of light spots reached tens of thousands.
Han Xing found the brightest light spot was right under his feet
With various colors of red, white, and purple intertwined to form a huge ball of light.
Nearby light spots were mostly ordinary white, only the size of rice grains.
Compared to Han Xing’s location’s light spot, they were akin to fireflies against the brightness of the Bright Moon.
Han Xing pondered, "These light spots should be the Sky Island locations around here."
"And the largest light spot here must be my Ten Thousand Stars City."
At this moment, Han Xing also realized, "It turns out these light spots are marked with different brightness based on the level of resources on the Sky Islands."
"The more resources on a Sky Island, the larger and brighter the light!"
At this moment, Ten Thousand Stars City stored massive precious resources, causing its light to shine so intensely.
Compared to Ten Thousand Stars City, other Sky Islands were on a completely different level.
Additionally, as Han Xing’s perception range expanded.
He faintly sensed that the positions of Sky Islands within thousands of kilometers’ range were all marked out.
Among them, Han Xing also saw some unexpected surprises.
Spotting some extremely large light spots, although not as large as Ten Thousand Stars City, still ten times bigger than ordinary Sky Islands!
"Oh?
Is there such a massive light spot nearby thousands of kilometers?"
"Could it be holding extremely abundant resources?"
Han Xing felt a rush of excitement.
He memorized the locations of these two Sky Islands, preparing to find an opportunity to explore them.
Currently the special effect ’Eye of Treasure’ had seven seconds left, Han Xing memorized hundreds of brighter light spots among tens of thousands of Sky Islands.
These were the places he intended to explore next.
"This Mask of the Golden Goddess is truly a treasure!"
At this moment, Han Xing couldn’t help but exclaim again.
Not to mention the other two special effects, the Eye of Treasure alone could significantly aid him.
With the support of the Divine Artifact Mask, his exploration speed will increase by several times, even ten times!
Han Xing continued sensing this Chaos Space.
The next moment.
Han Xing suddenly saw a gigantic ball of light, shining dozens, even hundreds of times brighter than his Ten Thousand Stars City!

chapters.title: Chapter 329 - 259: Twilight of the Gods, Dark Age
paragraphs: "Holy crap!" Han Xing exclaimed in his heart.
At this moment, Han Xing was utterly shaken.
One must know that his Ten Thousand Stars City already had an extremely profound foundation.
Yet now, that light orb was terrifyingly hundreds of times stronger than his Ten Thousand Stars City!
This means that the amount of resources on it is also more than a hundred times that of Ten Thousand Stars City!
If he could explore it, wouldn’t Han Xing become immensely wealthy?
However, after the shock, Han Xing quickly deduced the background of that Sky Island.
That light orb is likely a Sky Island of the Witch Race, and could even be one of their seventeen main cities.
It holds the foundation of the Witch Race.
Similarly, each main city has a Legendary powerhouse guarding it.
At this moment, Han Xing dismissed the thought.
Kidding me? Going to rob a Witch Race main city is a death wish!
At this time, Han Xing noticed the remaining time on the special effect decreasing, and felt a bit puzzled.
"I’ve already experienced the first effect of the Eye of Treasure, it’s truly powerful."
"But what is the effect of the second Eye of Desire special effect?"
As the ten-second effect duration was about to end, Han Xing was getting a bit impatient.
Just then.
Han Xing suddenly noticed that among the tens of thousands of light points ahead, one light point began to flicker incessantly.
A unique aura seemed to emanate from it, with an invisible attraction.
It attracted Han Xing to investigate.
"What is this..." Han Xing murmured.
However, before Han Xing could take a closer look, the ten-second perception time declared an end.
His vision returned to normal.
Then, Han Xing took off the mask and said, somewhat unsatisfied, "It’s over so quickly."
Beside him, Cheng Jianyong, hearing Han Xing’s words, couldn’t help but say, "It really was too fast."
"Spending billions in resources just for ten seconds of duration, it seems a bit unworthy to me.
Everyone also felt it was somewhat of a loss.
Shen Yun then asked, "So, Brother Xing, did you find any special Sky Islands?"
Han Xing shook his head, "Not too sure, need to go check it out."
"But, it probably won’t be a loss."
Upon hearing Han Xing’s words, everyone felt relieved.
What Han Xing said was true, the effect of the mask indeed would not make him lose anything.
Just the Eye of Treasure alone identified locations of tens of thousands of Sky Islands for Han Xing, making it already worth the investment.
Furthermore, among them, Han Xing also saw two large-scale Sky Islands.
If he could explore them, the benefits generated would absolutely surpass the resources he invested now.
However, before that, Han Xing decided to first check the location of the last discovered light point.
That light point seemed special, it seemed to be the Sky Island marked by the ’Eye of Desire’.
On it, there seemed to be something with a massive attraction for him.
Next, Han Xing directly maneuvered Ten Thousand Stars City towards the marked location.
The massive Ten Thousand Stars City sped forward rapidly.
In Han Xing’s impression, that Sky Island was about a hundred thousand kilometers from their location.
At Ten Thousand Stars City’s current speed, reaching fifty thousand kilometers per hour.
It would only take two hours.
The surrounding scenery began to rapidly recede.
Along the way, they also encountered many Cloud Sky Islands, all of considerable size.
But Han Xing ignored them all.
Right now, he only wanted to find out what was on that alluring Sky Island.
Ten Thousand Stars City traversed the Witch Race Territory for tens of thousands of kilometers.
Two hours later.
Ten Thousand Stars City finally stopped moving.
Because in front of everyone appeared a Sky Island covered in clouds.
This Sky Island wasn’t large, only about five or six square kilometers.
Shen Yun looked at Han Xing and asked, "Brother Xing, are you sure it’s here?
He seemed a bit skeptical.
After all, in everyone’s understanding.
The larger the Sky Island, the richer the resources contained within, and the stronger the monsters.
A Sky Island of just a few square kilometers might not even have monsters with Fourth Transformation strength.
Conversely, there might not be anything good.
Han Xing shook his head, "Let’s go take a look first, I’m not too sure either."
Everyone nodded.
As Ten Thousand Stars City gradually approached this Sky Island.
The expressions of the five people simultaneously changed.
They all felt a sense of crisis on this Sky Island.
Survivors, after completing First or Second Transformation, have bodies that have long surpassed normal human limits.
Their perception of danger is keen.
It is precisely with this perception ability that Survivors can roughly deduce the strength of the monsters within these Sky Islands.
At this time, everyone looked at each other.
Cheng Jianyong said, "I didn’t expect such a small Sky Island to hide such a big threat."
"Feels a few degrees more dangerous than that Goblin Sky Island!"
Shen Yun nodded.
Even they felt a sense of crisis.
This indicates the strength of the monsters inside is even stronger than that old goblin.
However, considering that the old goblin was already aged and weak.
So no matter how strong the monsters inside are, they shouldn’t be much more powerful.
At most, they might just be at Fourth-Turn Lord Level strength.
Thinking of this, everyone felt more confident.
Thus, Han Xing continued to move Ten Thousand Stars City closer, then a system prompt appeared.
"This is an extremely ancient Sky Island, on it is a Lost Temple that once worshipped a powerful Divine Mansion."
"But as the Age of Ten Thousand Gods ended, gods withered, and the remaining Divine Spirits departed the Holy Spirit Realm, the divine power here has also gradually dissipated..."

chapters.title: Chapter 330 - 259: Twilight of the Gods, Dark Age (Part 2)
paragraphs: Upon hearing the hint, everyone looked puzzled.
"Lost Temple, powerful Divine Mansion?"
Cheng Jianyong wondered, "Why does it feel like the things on this Sky Island have backgrounds that are quite intimidating?"
Everyone frowned slightly.
Since entering Sky Island Paradise, they had already discovered.
Sometimes the system would mix in brief background introductions within the hints.
Moreover, although these introductions are short, they are extremely important.
Now, they heard another key piece of information.
That is, the Age of Ten Thousand Gods.
Clearly, this is a very ancient era, even Han Xing had heard of it for the first time.
And as the era ended, the gods withered away.
The remaining Divine Spirits had all left the Holy Spirit Realm.
So, where did these Divine Spirits go?
Han Xing’s gaze revealed a pondering expression.
After a moment, Han Xing shook his head, "Let’s go, let’s go inside and take a look."
Then, he directly clicked to enter.
The clouds dispersed.
In front of everyone, a majestic and ancient building emerged.
Bronze pillars, stone walls, adorned with finely carved patterns.
The tall stone pillars on both sides were engraved with images of exotic beasts, vividly portrayed.
The whole temple exuded a sense of majesty and sanctity.
However, this temple, as the system introduced, had already collapsed.
Carrying the traces of time, the ground was scattered with fallen stone columns, covered in thick dust, showing a sense of desolation.
Cheng Jianyong wondered, "Huh, how come we haven’t seen any monsters on this Sky Island?"
"Could it be that they’re hidden inside the temple?"
Everyone cast their eyes.
Before entering this Sky Island, they felt a sense of crisis on it.
This indicates there are definitely monsters present.
It’s just that currently, the whole Sky Island showed no signs of monsters.
Han Xing glanced at the massive temple, "I reckon they’re inside this temple."
"Let’s find the entrance to this temple together."
After speaking, Han Xing led the team into the Sky Island.
Then, they began searching for the temple’s entrance on the desolate Sky Island.
Crossing collapsed bronze pillars, moving huge stones aside.
A few minutes later, they had nearly circled the temple.
At this moment, Su Xiaoyang’s voice came over, "Sister Lian Meng, Brother Xing, I think I’ve found the entrance."
Upon hearing this, everyone walked over.
Su Xiaoyang was standing on a pile of ruins.
Below these ruins, a faintly visible large yellow metal door could be seen.
The entrance was completely concealed by huge stone pillars piled in front.
Everyone exchanged glances.
Shen Yun said, "Xiaoyongzi, it’s time to show your strengths."
Cheng Jianyong chuckled, seemingly unconcerned.
He directly rolled up his sleeves and rushed over to start moving the huge stone pillars.
"Ha!" With Cheng Jianyong continually letting out roars.
Bronze pillars weighing tens or even hundreds of tons were moved aside and smashed heavily onto the ground.
Boom! Boom boom!
Earth-shattering.
After a series of intense vibrations.
That pile of ruins was entirely cleared.
In front of them, the entrance to the temple appeared.
The golden door was long damaged, through the cracks, glimpses of the interior seemed visible.
However, inside the temple, it was still dark, nothing could be seen.
Han Xing said, "It seems this temple has been abandoned for too long without anyone coming over."
"Let’s go in and take a look."
Then, Han Xing took out a Dark Fire Stone Torch from his backpack and first stepped into the temple.
However, as Han Xing took his first step into the temple.
A system hint appeared in everyone’s ears.
"During that extremely ancient era, mysterious elements roamed between heaven and earth."
"Creatures of the world gained boundless Divine Power through mastering these elements."
"Among them were wind, fire, water, earth, lightning, darkness, light, and other basic elements constructing this world."
"As more and more creatures began to interact with these basic elements, geniuses emerged one after another."
"They used these basic elements to develop different branches, such as the transformation of water into rain and mist, earth into sand and rock, etc."
"Each branch could give birth to a new Divine Spirit."
"More and more divine spirits have manifested, providing this world with boundless vitality."
"That era was known as the Age of Ten Thousand Gods."
"Until one day, two divine spirits with different attributes came into contact, and their differing natures triggered the first war among the gods."
"After the divine war, the victor was surprised to find that the divine power of the being he killed could be absorbed by him after its death!"
"This divine spirit broke through to a higher level instantly."
"From then on, it was an unstoppable chain of events."
"The gods began a chaotic war, and after the great battle, life was utterly extinct, and the world shattered."
"The surviving divine spirits had to leave the Holy Spirit Realm to seek survival."
"And the Holy Spirit Realm, on the brink of shattering, entered its darkest age."
"Terrifying monsters appeared one after another."
"These beasts brought endless nightmares and suffering to all living creatures."
"In extreme despair, the living beings inadvertently discovered the legends of these divine spirits.
"They built temples for these divine spirits, offered sacrifices, and gave their faith, hoping that these divine spirits could save them..."
"Among them were three deities who governed the same source of Light Divine Power: Radiance, Light, and Dawn..."
"Here stands the temple of one of the three gods, the God of Light."
After listening to the system’s long background introduction.
Everyone gasped in amazement.
Indeed, every sentence of the system’s background introduction was extremely important.
This even touched upon a very ancient era, the Age of Ten Thousand Gods.
And after the Age of Ten Thousand Gods came the Dark Age
That is, the era when that group of barbaric monsters was born.
The living creatures of the Holy Spirit Realm endured a millennium of suffering.
They were so desperate that they sought the shelter of those divine spirits.
With the advent of the Hunter, the Dark Age finally glimpsed a ray of hope.
However, ironically, these living creatures did not know that the source of their suffering was these very divine spirits...
Everyone sighed in unison.
Han Xing also furrowed his brow.
Because he knew that the Hunter, also known as the Wild Ranger, was the one who rose during the Dark Age.
So, did the Hunter know about these things?
Did he have any contact with these divine spirits?
All of this was unknown to them.
This world hides too many secrets.
For instance, where did the divine spirits go after leaving the Holy Spirit Realm?
And who is placing generation after generation of the Human Race in the Land of the Abandoned Gods?
How many secrets are still undiscovered by them?
Even though Han Xing now possesses the strength of the Fourth Transformation, and could even be said to be invincible under the rank of Legend,
he still feels he knows too little about this world.
Moreover, the deeper he delves into understanding, the smaller he feels.
This feeling is shared by others as well.
For a moment, everyone had furrowed brows, their hearts filled with a sense of crisis.
Except for Shen Yun.
Unlike Han Xing and the others, he was not concerned with the world’s secrets.
He only remembered the last line of the system prompt.
Shen Yun then said, "Brother Xing, the system mentioned those three divine spirits mastering the power of light; we’ve come into contact with them, haven’t we?"
Everyone was taken aback upon hearing this.
They seemed to have realized something.
The first, the God of Radiance, is the divine spirit whose power Shen Yun inherited, becoming a Radiant Knight.
Then there’s the God of Dawn.
In both Ten Thousand Stars City and Xingyu City, there stands a statue of the Goddess of Dawn.
As for the God of Light...
At this point, Shen Yun quietly said from the back, "I remember, wasn’t the God of Light the deity worshiped by the previous generation of the Human Race?"
"This guy doesn’t seem to be a good person..."
Everyone’s expressions tensed.
They recalled exploring that Two-Star Secret Realm, the ’Knight Judgment Arena.’
Through the cutscene animation, they learned of the God of Light’s oracle to find the Evil God Species among humans.
Moreover, there was a large-scale cleansing among the Human Race, where many innocent children and civilians were implicated.
However, they knew it was just an excuse from the God of Light.
There was no such thing as an Evil God Species.
As for the true purpose of the God of Light, they had no idea.
Thus, in their impression, the God of Light was not a benevolent figure.
Cheng Jianyong then said, "Who cares, anyway, all these lousy divine spirits have left this world."
"Let’s explore his temple and see if we can uncover more secrets."
Everyone agreed with Cheng Jianyong’s decision.
Then, they all stepped into the Divine Hall...

"And the Holy Spirit Realm, on the brink of shattering, entered its darkest age."
"Terrifying monsters appeared one after another."
"These beasts brought endless nightmares and suffering to all living creatures."
"In extreme despair, the living beings inadvertently discovered the legends of these divine spirits.
"They built temples for these divine spirits, offered sacrifices, and gave their faith, hoping that these divine spirits could save them..."
"Among them were three deities who governed the same source of Light Divine Power: Radiance, Light, and Dawn..."
"Here stands the temple of one of the three gods, the God of Light."
After listening to the system’s long background introduction.
Everyone gasped in amazement.
Indeed, every sentence of the system’s background introduction was extremely important.
This even touched upon a very ancient era, the Age of Ten Thousand Gods.
And after the Age of Ten Thousand Gods came the Dark Age
That is, the era when that group of barbaric monsters was born.
The living creatures of the Holy Spirit Realm endured a millennium of suffering.
They were so desperate that they sought the shelter of those divine spirits.
With the advent of the Hunter, the Dark Age finally glimpsed a ray of hope.
However, ironically, these living creatures did not know that the source of their suffering was these very divine spirits...
Everyone sighed in unison.
Han Xing also furrowed his brow.
Because he knew that the Hunter, also known as the Wild Ranger, was the one who rose during the Dark Age.
So, did the Hunter know about these things?
Did he have any contact with these divine spirits?
All of this was unknown to them.
This world hides too many secrets.
For instance, where did the divine spirits go after leaving the Holy Spirit Realm?
And who is placing generation after generation of the Human Race in the Land of the Abandoned Gods?
How many secrets are still undiscovered by them?
Even though Han Xing now possesses the strength of the Fourth Transformation, and could even be said to be invincible under the rank of Legend,
he still feels he knows too little about this world.
Moreover, the deeper he delves into understanding, the smaller he feels.
This feeling is shared by others as well.
For a moment, everyone had furrowed brows, their hearts filled with a sense of crisis.
Except for Shen Yun.
Unlike Han Xing and the others, he was not concerned with the world’s secrets.
He only remembered the last line of the system prompt.
Shen Yun then said, "Brother Xing, the system mentioned those three divine spirits mastering the power of light; we’ve come into contact with them, haven’t we?"
Everyone was taken aback upon hearing this.
They seemed to have realized something.
The first, the God of Radiance, is the divine spirit whose power Shen Yun inherited, becoming a Radiant Knight.
Then there’s the God of Dawn.
In both Ten Thousand Stars City and Xingyu City, there stands a statue of the Goddess of Dawn.
As for the God of Light...
At this point, Shen Yun quietly said from the back, "I remember, wasn’t the God of Light the deity worshiped by the previous generation of the Human Race?"
"This guy doesn’t seem to be a good person..."
Everyone’s expressions tensed.
They recalled exploring that Two-Star Secret Realm, the ’Knight Judgment Arena.’
Through the cutscene animation, they learned of the God of Light’s oracle to find the Evil God Species among humans.
Moreover, there was a large-scale cleansing among the Human Race, where many innocent children and civilians were implicated.
However, they knew it was just an excuse from the God of Light.
There was no such thing as an Evil God Species.
As for the true purpose of the God of Light, they had no idea.
Thus, in their impression, the God of Light was not a benevolent figure.
Cheng Jianyong then said, "Who cares, anyway, all these lousy divine spirits have left this world."
"Let’s explore his temple and see if we can uncover more secrets."
Everyone agreed with Cheng Jianyong’s decision.
Then, they all stepped into the Divine Hall...

chapters.title: Chapter 331 - 260: Entering the Divine Hall, the Descent of Will
paragraphs: As Han Xing and the others entered through the gate, the darkness of the Divine Hall swallowed them.
As soon as they stepped in, they were greeted by a musty smell in the air.
Then, the five of them each held a torch and began searching within the Divine Hall.
By the light of the torches, Han Xing saw that the stone pillars were engraved with a series of murals.
The first mural depicted a scene of innumerable creatures worshiping a man.
The figure of the man appeared towering and majestic,
He raised both arms high, his eyes closed, as if listening to the prayers of his followers.
The second mural showed the man in a standoff with a terrifying fierce beast.
The beast, its face ferocious, emitted different elemental lights from its four hooves.
With every step it took, volcanoes erupted, torrential rain began to fall, bringing terrifying disasters to the world.
Countless creatures crawled under the beast.
The third mural depicted the man subduing that terrifying fierce beast.
Under his boundless mighty power, even such a terrifying beast had to submit.
The subsequent murals followed this style, mostly recording the amazing feats accomplished by this being.
As for their authenticity, it was hard to discern.
After watching for a while, Han Xing began to lose interest.
The space within the Divine Hall was vast.
Four or five square kilometers, roughly the size of two or three neighborhoods.
At this moment, the group, having split up, each made different discoveries within the Divine Hall.
Su Xiaoyang suddenly posted an item information in the team channel.
Then he said, "Brother Xing, I picked up a few strange stones over here, take a look and see if they’re useful."
Upon hearing this, Han Xing also checked the item information.
[Light Divine Stone]: A stone containing traces of Light Divine Power, which can replenish Divine Power to certain special devices or be used as a substitute for the Philosopher’s Stone.
Han Xing was taken aback upon seeing this.
Though he didn’t know what devices it could replenish Divine Power for,
just the fact that it could be used as a substitute for the Philosopher’s Stone was enough to highlight its value.
At this point, Han Xing asked, "Xiaoyang, how many Light Divine Stones did you find there?"
Su Xiaoyang replied, "Only about seven or eight pieces."
"I found them near a box, and there were still many of these stones beside it."
"But among them, most had already lost their Divine Power, as if they had been drained by something..."
Upon hearing the last sentence, everyone’s heart skipped a beat.
The dim and dark Divine Hall was already intimidating.
With Su Xiaoyang’s comment, the atmosphere felt even more eerie.
It was as if there were eyes watching them from the darkness.
At this point, Cheng Jianyong suddenly spoke.
"Brother Xing, Brother Yun, come here quickly, I think I found an altar."
"An altar?" Han Xing asked, puzzled.
Then they all went over to Cheng Jianyong.
In front of everyone appeared a square stone platform, with a groove for placing offerings on top.
Next, the attributes of the altar appeared in front of Han Xing.
[Light Altar]: Offer sacrifices into the altar to communicate with the will of the God of Light, seeking the approval of this ancient existence.
Reading the notes on the altar, everyone felt strange.
"Offer sacrifices? Communicate with the God of Light?"
"Why does this feel like it’s not a good thing?" Cheng Jianyong said, puzzled.
Others shared this sentiment.
In their understanding, the God of Light was not a benevolent deity.
If they could, they preferred not to have any dealings with this divine spirit.
Just then, a system prompt appeared.
"If the Survivors wish to merge the Sky Island, they must offer a sacrifice and communicate with the will of the God of Light, obtaining approval to gain control over the Divine Hall."
"If the Survivors refuse to communicate with the will of the God of Light, they can choose to destroy the altar to forcibly gain control of the Divine Hall.
"This action may trigger serious chain consequences, so choose carefully."
After hearing the system prompt, everyone was stunned.
After many days, the system had once again presented a choice mission.
To merge the Sky Island, they had to offer a sacrifice or destroy the altar.
The introduction clearly indicated that offering a sacrifice was the best choice.
However, they inherently did not want any interaction with that God of Light.
But, if they chose to destroy the altar, it might trigger some serious chain consequences.
For a moment, they were caught in a dilemma.
At this moment, Han Xing asked, "Cheng Jianyong, check what sacrifices are required for the altar."
"Okay, Brother Xing." Cheng Jianyong agreed.

He came to the altar and said, with a strange expression, "Brother Xing, the description says you need to sacrifice 1000 Light Divine Stones, or if you don’t have them, you can use 1000 Philosopher’s Stones instead..."
Upon hearing this, Han Xing immediately snapped, "Damn it, why doesn’t it just rob me?"
"To demand so many Philosopher’s Stones from me, it’s like wanting my life!"
Seeing Han Xing’s agitated appearance, it was hard for anyone not to laugh.
In Han Xing’s eyes, besides his friends,
anyone wanting anything from him must pay the corresponding price.
Even if Han Xing could produce a thousand Philosopher’s Stones.
It’s uncertain whether this broken Divine Hall is even worth that price!
So Han Xing immediately decided to destroy the altar directly!
"Blow it up!"
Cheng Jianyong, receiving the command, wasted no time.
He raised the Golden Battle Spear and unleashed a ’Sudden Burst of Killing Intent’!
