chapters.title: Chapter 332 - 260: Entering the Divine Hall, the Descent of Will
paragraphs: Buzz!
The Golden Battle Spear struck the altar.
Cobweb-like cracks appeared on its surface immediately.
With a crisp shattering sound,
the entire altar crumbled to dust at that moment.
At the same time,
everyone noticed,
the originally dark Divine Hall suddenly burst into a strong white light from a corner.
From that white light, a tall humanoid spectral presence appeared.
"Destroy... the altar of the God of Light..."
"Unforgivable..."
Thud! Thud! Thud!
As if some long-slumbering existence had awakened at this moment.
However, before anyone could clearly see the figure of that existence,
at that moment,
from the fragments of the destroyed altar, an intense white light suddenly burst forth.
This white light, imbued with a vast and terrifying aura, completely illuminated the entire Divine Hall.
Everyone’s faces changed as they felt shocked and fearful.
Cheng Jianyong asked in confusion, "Damn, what’s going on now?"
"Is this the chain reaction the system mentioned?"
Han Xing’s face also changed dramatically.
However, the chain reaction triggered by destroying the altar came too suddenly!
The white light from the altar surged.
And at a very fast speed, shot towards the sky.
At the same time,
an immensely powerful presence suddenly descended.
No one understood what was happening.
They only felt that within the empty Divine Hall, an extremely ancient existence had suddenly appeared.
The terror of this aura was even more frightening than the time on the Path of the Giant Dragon when they faced hundreds of giant dragons.
Even Wu Ling’Er, at her peak, appeared insignificant by comparison.
And Han Xing and the others, under this aura, seemed like mere ants!
Even though they had some Fourth Transformation strength, they were just slightly bigger ants.
At this moment, an inexplicable sense of reverence arose in everyone’s hearts, and they couldn’t help but prostrate themselves on the ground.
In the next moment, the entire dark Divine Hall was instantly filled with intense light.
A strange sound appeared by everyone’s ears.
"Unexpectedly, there are still people who can find the ancient Divine Hall, allowing a trace of my will to descend..."
"After so many years, now the Holy Spirit Realm has gradually regained some vitality."
The voice sounded neither male nor female, like that of a child.
Then, he suddenly spoke in a puzzled tone.
"Hmm, there’s actually a trace of radiance here?"
Then, in front of everyone, a humanoid figure began to condense.
Han Xing and the others felt a stabbing pain in their eyes at just one glance, their brains feeling as if struck by lightning!
A system prompt appeared.
[You have directly viewed an existence beyond the rules, your vision has been forcibly stripped...]
[You have been enveloped by the aura of an existence beyond the rules, all attributes reduced by 90%...]
[You are under the divine might of an existence beyond the rules, action capacity reduced by 100%...]
Cheng Jianyong and others received the same system prompt.
Everyone’s face changed dramatically at once!
What kind of existence is this?
Just one glance and they lost their sight and ability to move!
Even suppressed by its aura, their all attributes decreased by 90%, unable to even struggle!
At this moment, though everyone couldn’t see, they vaguely heard.
"Interesting... this generation of the Human Race, getting out of the Land of the Abandoned Gods so quickly?"
"And someone inherited the power of radiance... interesting, so interesting."
"I wonder if that guy, the God of Radiance, was swallowed by those beasts years ago..."
No one understood the last sentence clearly.
They were already so suppressed by this powerful force, they couldn’t help but prostrate themselves.
At this moment, that figure of light slowly approached everyone.
Since entering Sky Island Paradise, it was the first time they encountered such a terrifying existence.
However, that figure suddenly stopped in place.
At that moment, a similarly terrifying power suddenly descended.
And directly attacked that figure!
As a wave of energy spread,
everyone could clearly feel that the aura of this terrifying existence had greatly weakened.
At this moment, that figure of light said angrily.
"Damn, I was just sending my divine sense into the Holy Spirit Realm for a glance, not truly descending, is it necessary to watch me so closely?"
"Those guys in the Supreme Hall, once the hunters are dead, let’s see how long you can stop us, eventually we will topple your divine positions..."
After speaking, that aura swiftly retreated.
As it left, they heard its mumbling.
With that terrifying aura gone,
they collapsed as if having fought a great battle.
A moment later, Cheng Jianyong palely, and with lingering fear, said, "That thing just now, could it really be the God of Light?"
Han Xing’s expression was difficult as he replied, "Likely, it was him."
Cheng Jianyong swallowed, "Why does it feel like this guy doesn’t get along with the God of Radiance."
"Seeing Xiaoyunzi, this guy almost attacked us!"
Shen Yun’s face was ashen.
Just now, he truly felt a sense of impending death.
The God of Radiance and the God of Light are clearly adversaries.
But fortunately, this existence has constraints on descending into this world, and was even forced to retreat.
Moreover, with its departure, the suppressed powers in everyone returned to their bodies.
Their vision gradually restored.
At this moment, Han Xing breathed a sigh of relief once more, that despairing out-of-control feeling was too overwhelming.
He originally thought that with Legendary Level strength, he could at least protect himself in the outside world.
That’s why he strove towards this direction.
In the end, as Han Xing barely approached this level of power,
now the God of Light appeared!
Damn it, this world’s waters run deep!
At this moment, Han Xing clenched his fist tightly.
He was not intimidated by the God of Light’s terrifying power.
Instead, his survival instinct was awakened.
He needs to become even stronger!
Even if these divine spirits appear, at the very least, Han Xing should have the power to protect himself.
However, before everyone could react,
a familiar mechanical synthetic voice suddenly appeared in the Divine Hall.
"The will of the God of Light has already descended."
"You insignificant ones, have yet to surrender!"
This voice appeared before that terrifying will descended.
At this moment, everyone finally saw the figure clearly.
It was a humanoid creature formed purely of light.
It wore silver armor and held a silver long spear, exuding immense momentum!
In front of everyone appeared the attributes of this humanoid creature.
[Light Attendant: Lord-level Creature]
[Level]: lv45
[Attributes]: Power 4253, Agility 3794, Spirit 4894, Constitution 4308.
[Skills]: Light Domain, Rain of Light, Light Judgment, Bright Spear Technique!
Another Lord-level creature.
In terms of power alone, it’s on par with the ’Fear Wanderer’.
However, at this moment, everyone was no longer what they were before.
They felt no sense of crisis from this lord-like creature.
Additionally, having just been suppressed by the God of Light, each had pent up frustrations.
Cheng Jianyong angrily cursed, "The God of Light intimidating us is one thing."
"But you, a minion, dare to act arrogant in front of us!"
Seemingly understanding Cheng Jianyong’s words,
the Light Attendant turned its gaze and emitted the mechanical synth sound again.
"Disrespect towards the God of Light... Death!"
In the next moment,
the Light Attendant brandished its silver long spear, and a deathly white light shot out instantly.
Cheng Jianyong did a Roll, easily dodging it.
Then he leaped up, shouting angrily.
"Damn! Playing with spears? I’ll take you out!"
Cheng Jianyong, clad in his Golden Armor, the golden light on him swelled.
With terrifying speed, he instantly Charged next to the Light Attendant.
This Light Attendant also instantly raised its Radiant Long Spear.
A sudden burst of killing intent!
Bright Spear Technique!
At this moment, the tips of the two spears clashed.
Ding!
Following a crisp collision sound,
an invisible shockwave swept through the entire Divine Hall.
The huge stones on the ground were all reduced to powder at that moment.

chapters.title: Chapter 333 - 261: The Final Material for Crafting the Divine Artifact
paragraphs: If it were some creatures below the Second Transformation, the mere aftermath of this collision would be enough to kill them!
In the next moment, the Light Attendant and Cheng Jianyong each took a step back.
This collision was actually a tie.
Cheng Jianyong’s face changed, he exclaimed in surprise: "You have some skills, I couldn’t take you down."
However, he didn’t know that his current strength was already extremely terrifying.
To clash with a Lord of the same level and not be at a disadvantage.
At this stage, only the top few humans can do it.
However, Cheng Jianyong was somewhat unconvinced, "You want to fight me with swords?"
"Come, Xiaoyunzi, give me a boost!"
Upon hearing this, Shen Yun cooperated very well, directly activating two group blessings.
Cheng Jianyong felt his attributes suddenly soared!
The golden spear kept stabbing out, with an offensive like a torrential rain, forcing the Light Attendant to retreat continuously.
However, when it saw Shen Yun cast a Blessing Skill, the hatred of this Light Attendant instantly shifted.
It locked all its focus on Shen Yun.
"The power of Radiance, the enemy of the God of Light... must be eliminated..."
Then, this Light Attendant raised its spear high.
The entire Divine Hall immediately lit up.
Above everyone’s heads, a glow appeared.
These glows condensed into the shape of spears and then shot fiercely!
[Divine Hall Secret Skill - Rain of Light]
Buzz!
Countless light spears transformed into a rain of death, falling down.
Each light spear carried the breath of death.
Seeing this, Han Xing directly said: "Shen Yun, throw the Sun directly."
"Let’s take it out together!"
Without hesitation, Shen Yun also directly threw out a ball of brilliant light.
And directly covered the Rain of Light from the Divine Hall Attendant!
Everyone’s attributes soared!
Han Xing didn’t want to entangle with this Lord any longer.
At this moment, Shen Yun activated various special effects to protect everyone.
Han Xing and the others were able to attack safely!
Various skills were unleashed.
Gale·Break!
Meteor Technique!
Elf’s Eye!
Waves upon waves hit the Light Attendant, making its figure more and more illusionary.
A moment later, this Light Attendant stopped in its tracks.
Then it turned into a rain of light and dissipated into the air.
This Four-star Lord equivalent to a ’Fear Wanderer’ was easily taken down by everyone.
On the ground.
However, two pages of yellowed paper were left, along with a few glowing stones.
Those stones, everyone had seen them before.
Called Light Divine Stones, they can be used as a substitute for the Philosopher’s Stone.
A quick glance showed there were as many as eight, which was a pretty good gain.
As for the two pages of paper beside them, Han Xing had never encountered them before.
Han Xing walked over with a puzzled look and picked up these two pieces of paper.
The system prompt appeared.
"Obtained special item: Divine Oracle Scripture*2."
Han Xing’s eyes widened, and he exclaimed: "Whoa!"
Seeing the system prompt, Han Xing exclaimed out loud.
He looked at the yellowed paper in his hand in disbelief, his breath slightly quickened!
This thing happened to be the last material he urgently needed to craft the Divine Artifact: [Oracle Throne]!
Divine Oracle Scripture!
Han Xing quickly looked at the pale gold mask in his backpack.
He knew that it was this mask that helped him find this kind of material.
He had to admit, indeed worthy of the Wujin Goddess?
The second special effect ’Eye of Desire’ specifically indicated it could find the item he currently needed most.
Han Xing hadn’t expected this effect to be so precise!
Following the guidance, Han Xing instantly gained two Divine Oracle Scriptures!
At this moment, Han Xing couldn’t help but marvel again, these billions of Spirit Cores were absolutely worth it!
Then, with excitement in his eyes, Han Xing clicked on the item attributes of the Divine Oracle Scripture.
[Divine Oracle Scripture]: A scripture containing Divine Power, can be used in conjunction with Light Divine Stone and Divine Aurora to resummon the Light Attendant to assist in battle.
"This thing can also be used to summon the Light Attendant?"
Han Xing was a bit surprised.
After all, the Divine Hall Attendant may have lower combat power for them, but it’s still a Four-star Lord level creature.
If he could get more of them and place them in the territory, it would be a powerful force.
But clearly, Han Xing wouldn’t do that.
Not to mention that summoning Divine Hall Attendants still requires Light Divine Stones and Divine Aurora as materials.
Moreover, it also needs to add the Divine Oracle Scripture.
With these materials, why not craft more Oracle Thrones?
Han Xing directly put away these two pages of paper.
Looking at the materials in his backpack, Han Xing could not help but exclaim in excitement.
"Good, good, good! With just three more Divine Oracle Scriptures, I can craft my first Oracle Throne!"
"By then, my strength will double, truly reaching a qualitative change!"
Currently, it can be confirmed that within the Witch Race Territory, such materials as the Divine Oracle Scripture can be found.
Just use the ’Eye of Desire’ and follow the guidance.
However, now the special effect of the ’Eye of Desire’ has entered cooldown time.
Therefore, Han Xing can only do something else first and wait for the cooldown of the special effect.
Thus, Han Xing prepared to fuse this Sky Island first.
The system prompt appeared.

"Successfully fused the Sky Island: Lost Temple, your territory area has expanded, obtained Divine Hall of Light*1, obtained Light Divine Stone*27, obtained Light Attendant (damaged)*3, obtained Shimmering Terra Stone*64, obtained..."
After reading the system prompt, Han Xing was somewhat surprised.
Besides the Light Divine Stone, there were unexpected gains.
That was the Shimmering Terra Stone.
Although the quantity was not large, it was an unexpected fortune.

chapters.title: Chapter 334 - 261: The Final Material for Crafting the Divine Artifact
paragraphs: Then, Han Xing led everyone out of the Divine Hall.
Looking at the ancient and weathered building behind him, a subtle expression flashed in Han Xing’s eyes.
The God of Light, as an ancient divine spirit, seemed to be an adversary of the God of Radiance.
This time, he almost made a move against us.
Han Xing did not want anything related to the God of Light in his territory.
Thus, Han Xing opened the lord interface and summoned a group of minotaurs.
It wasn’t long.
A squad of minotaurs, numbering around a thousand, slowly approached from Ten Thousand Stars City.
This group of minotaurs, all at the Fourth Transformation level, stood over five or six meters tall.
Combined with their terrifying physiques, they resembled muscular monsters.
Upon seeing Han Xing, the minotaurs respectfully said, "Greetings, Lord!"
Han Xing nodded and said, "I have a task for you: demolish this Divine Hall for me."
At this moment, even Shen Yun and others were confused.
It seemed they didn’t understand the meaning of Han Xing’s actions.
Han Xing did not explain.
He simply felt displeased.
The God of Light almost acted against us before, which made Han Xing a bit angry.
Although he couldn’t afford to provoke him now, he could demolish his temple!
The minotaurs were puzzled upon hearing this.
However, they would comply with Han Xing’s orders one hundred percent.
Moreover, what Han Xing wanted them to do was what they were best at.
That is, causing destruction!
The next moment, the minotaurs hoisted the totems on their shoulders.
Like cannonballs, they leaped high into the air.
And then smashed down onto the Divine Hall.
Rumble!
A series of strong tremors ensued.
The temple began to collapse, as the minotaurs demolished it with the speed of excavators.
Soon, the outer walls of the temple were completely torn down.
Far from showing confusion over Han Xing’s actions, everyone felt a sense of exhilaration.
Cheng Jianyong excitedly said, "Good, well done tearing it down!"
"Let the God of Light target us!"
Smiles appeared on everyone’s faces.
It was as if a shadow that had enveloped their hearts was partially dispelled.
At this moment, Shen Yun asked from the side, "Brother Xing, what are we going to do now?"
Han Xing replied, "Of course, we continue exploring Sky Island."
Even without the guidance of the ’Eye of Treasure.’
Han Xing still remembered clearly the location of those tens of thousands of light points.
And which areas nearby had brighter light points on the Sky Islands.
So, Han Xing maneuvered Ten Thousand Stars City, moving toward those areas based on his memory.
The first destination.
Was one of the two massive light clusters he had discovered before.
It was located over a hundred thousand kilometers away from his current position.
It would take about three hours to reach there.
Ten Thousand Stars City continued moving, and the surrounding scenery began to recede rapidly.
Three hours later, a relatively small Sky Island appeared before them.
It was only about four or five square kilometers, similar in size to that Divine Hall.
It was vastly different from Han Xing’s expectations.
"Hmm? I remember the Eye of Treasure showed that this light cluster was quite large?"
"Why does this Sky Island look smaller than that Divine Hall?"
With a puzzled look, Han Xing began to approach.
This is when a system prompt appeared.
"This is a Sky Island drifting from a far place, containing a hint of the Power of Creation. Enter?"
Upon hearing the system prompt, everyone understood what resources were inside this Sky Island.
Terrastone!
Its hallmark was containing the Power of Creation.
Though it sounds mystical, it’s actually a highly stable form of spatial power.
Han Xing clicked to enter.
The clouds dissipated.
A mountain appeared before everyone.
However, the mountain seemed to have been hit by a giant rock.
Atop the mountain rested a milky white boulder, lying silently.
This boulder, with its surface smooth as freshly forged glass, was a milky white color.
This was Terrastone.
At this moment, a sense of surprise showed in their eyes.
For it was the first time they had found a Terrastone ore in the wilderness on a Sky Island.
Compared to the Shimmering Terra Stone, the difference in appearance was stark.
This Terrastone, although not on the level of the Black Iron Mine they discovered yesterday.
Nevertheless, Terrastone is a grade higher than Rhythm Black Iron and on par with the Philosopher’s Stone.
Hence, the size of the light point marked on the system was reasonable.
Cheng Jianyong mumbled at this moment, "This Terrastone looks about ten tons. I just wonder how much Shimmering Terra Stone can be refined from it."
Han Xing nodded, "No matter how much, it’s an unexpected bounty anyway."
With that, he was preparing to land on the Sky Island.
However, just before anyone stepped onto it.
A beast roar suddenly echoed from the mountaintop.
"Roar!!"
The roar was full of strength and resounded through the skies!
Everyone turned their gaze.
To see a ten-meter-tall creature covered in black fur leaping fiercely from the forest.
With everyone’s vision, they soon discerned the creature’s form.
It was a Long-armed Giant Ape, its expression ferocious, malevolence evident!
Upon seeing Han Xing and the others, the giant ape’s eyes immediately turned blood-red and charged at them!
A gust of wind swept past.
Yet, as the giant ape leapt into the air, it suddenly sensed the aura of these humans.
Hmm? Something’s wrong!
In the next instant.
The blood-red color vanished from the giant ape’s eyes, its ferocious and vicious expression frozen in mid-air.
After confirming the overwhelming aura exuding from these individuals was genuine, a hint of fear even flashed in the giant ape’s eyes!
It could assure itself that if it rushed forward as a newly Third Transformed leader monster, it could be slain in a second by these powerful beings!
However, now it was in a predicament of dilemma.
In that brief second, the giant ape contemplated a lot.
Suddenly, an idea sparked in the giant ape’s mind.
Amid the slightly surprised gazes from everyone.
It roared loudly, abruptly changing direction in mid-air.
The figure initially charging toward the group veered to a nearby large tree instead.
Then, acting as if nothing had happened, it began to trim the branches of the tree it held.
Occasionally scratching its ears, even casting a friendly smile at Han Xing.
Completely different from its initial ferocity when it appeared.
The current Long-armed Giant Ape was as docile as tigers in a park.
This amused even Su Xiaoyang and Zhang Lianmeng.
Cheng Jianyong couldn’t help but chuckle from the side, "Damn, I still prefer your rebellious look."
Shen Yun laughed, "This big gorilla has quite the insight."
For such a spiritually aware creature, Han Xing also found it intriguing.
Then, he stepped forward.
At that moment.
The giant ape noticed a human walking towards it, almost instinctively trying to flee.
Han Xing’s voice came from behind, "Stop."
The Long-armed Giant Ape froze its outstretched arm in mid-air.
Then, it slid down the tree, came near the group, displaying a shy smile.
Han Xing asked, "Do you want to live or die?"
He knew this big gorilla could understand him.
The Long-armed Giant Ape paused, then nodded repeatedly.
Obviously, no one wants to die if they can keep living.
So, Han Xing tossed a Lord Contract to the big gorilla, "Sign it."
The gorilla was stunned, seemingly recognizing what it was.
Signing the Lord Contract meant it must serve the human before it.
With no chance of rebellion for life.
Yet, the current situation wasn’t in its favor.
Moreover, these humans didn’t look like they had much patience.
It knew hesitating even for a second increased the danger of death.
Thus, the Long-armed Giant Ape swiftly pressed its handprint.
The system prompt appeared.
"Long-armed Fierce Ape has signed the Lord Contract with you, Lord member +1."
Upon hearing the prompt, Han Xing smiled.
Before him also appeared the loyalty of this Long-armed Giant Ape...

chapters.title: Chapter 335 - 262: Warg, Chimera, Wind Erosion Goddess!
paragraphs: In front of Han Xing, the loyalty interface of this giant ape appeared.
Long-armed Fierce Ape: Loyalty 46 (Subdued)
A loyalty of 46 points doesn’t even meet the passing level.
Han Xing’s mouth twitched.
In theory, as long as the Lord Contract is signed, loyalty should forcibly become over 80 points.
But this guy only has 46 points.
This indicates that deep down, this guy doesn’t actually submit to Han Xing; it’s only subdued due to strength.
However, Han Xing doesn’t mind. With a newly tamed monster like this, one shouldn’t expect loyalty to reach a high level.
Once it enters Ten Thousand Stars City, I’ll have plenty of ways to deal with it!
So, Han Xing directly said, "Alright, there’s nothing more for you here, go stay well in my territory, and if you’re bored, find a tree to play with."
The Long-armed Fierce Ape nodded repeatedly upon hearing this.
It quickly stood up from the ground, then leapt ten meters high, directly jumping towards Ten Thousand Stars City.
Watching the ape leave, there was a fleeting cunning glint in its eyes.
Han Xing’s mouth also curved into a smile.
Little thing, still wanting to fight me, let’s see how I deal with you!
At this time, a system prompt appeared.
[You have cleared all the monsters on this Sky Island, you can now proceed with merging.]
Han Xing directly clicked merge.
[Merge successful, your territory has expanded, you have obtained Terrastone Raw Ore*1, obtained Purple Fir Forest*1, obtained...]
The harvest from this Sky Island is not bad.
Next, as long as the Terrastone at the mountain top is mined, we can refine pieces of Shimmering Terra Stone.
The task of mining this Terrastone is naturally given to the goblins.
They are also adept at this.
Next, Han Xing found an empty space at the mountain’s foot.
Then, he opened the blueprint tab and crafted a Shimmering Terra Stone Refinement Device.
After finishing these, Han Xing looked at the sky.
It’s afternoon, he can explore for a bit longer.
The distance to the location of another large light sphere is hundreds of thousands of kilometers away.
It would be a bit late if traveling on foot.
Han Xing decided to first explore the nearby Sky Islands and tomorrow check out the other large light sphere.
Ten Thousand Stars City continues to move.
Relying on the memories in his mind, he dashed rapidly towards those Sky Island locations in his head.
At this moment, Han Xing once again marveled, ’Mask of the Golden Goddess’ is truly a great thing.
Compared to before, when people could only wander aimlessly in the Witch Race Territory hoping to find those Sky Islands by luck.
Now, Han Xing clearly remembers the locations of those nearby Sky Islands in his mind.
With this, the expansion speed of Ten Thousand Stars City can increase several times.
Going forward, Han Xing maintained the same pace.
Exploring Sky Islands, eliminating the monsters inside, then annexing them.
A few hours later, everyone ended a day of battles.
Ten Thousand Stars City expanded by over three hundred square kilometers again.
At this moment, Han Xing stood at the pinnacle of Ten Thousand Stars City, satisfiedly looking at his territory.
There aren’t many buildings on Ten Thousand Stars City.
There are only Thunderbolt Towers, Spiritual Shock Towers, and four types of Arrow Towers scattered throughout the city.
Their combined numbers have already exceeded twenty thousand!
According to Han Xing’s estimates, just the firepower from these turrets alone can withstand a massive scale Blood Tide of ten million.
Note, this ten million is not those Second and Third Transformation monsters from the Blood Tide Period.
But a ten million level of creatures breaking through Level 40, completing Fourth Transformation!
If it’s a lower-level monster tide, increasing several times over is not a problem.
Moreover, this is not even the strongest firepower of Ten Thousand Stars City.
His trump cards are the Hellfire Missile Silos and the Ancient Weapon Demon Elephant War Chariot.
Currently, the number of Hellfire Missile Silos has directly broken through 500 units.
After obtaining a large number of resources from the goblin treasure trove, Han Xing also raised a batch of Demon Elephant War Chariots.
The quantity directly surpasses 50 units.
Han Xing was thrilled in his heart: "Very good, with the current firepower on Ten Thousand Stars City, we should be able to barely contend with ordinary Legends."
He refers to Legendary Powerhouses like Feienna.
Even though it’s just barely contending, it’s a huge step forward for Han Xing.
Moreover, next, as long as he gathers five ’Divine Oracle Scriptures,’ to craft the Oracle Throne.
Han Xing even has the confidence, relying on himself, to deal serious blows to Legendary Powerhouses, perhaps even slay them!
Wu Ling’Er said, Fourth Transformation can’t possibly be a match for Legends.
But that’s for the creatures of this world.
But I am a Survivor with a system!
By then, with the strength of Fourth Transformation, I’ll slay challengers beyond my level, giving a little shock to the Legends of my own world!
To use a phrase to describe me, it would be that this child is terrifying as such, and must not be spared!
Hahahahaha!
Han Xing laughed arrogantly!
Apart from these defense towers and silos.
There is also a very large force within Ten Thousand Stars City.
That is the melee army composed of over 3 million Wolf Cavalry and 1.3 million Minotaurs.
Specifically for defending against monsters breaking into Ten Thousand Stars City.
Besides these.
In a nearby mountain range, forty thousand Big-beaked Birds live.
Now, Ten Thousand Stars City can really be called a robust military might.
Just then, Han Xing received a private message from Lanlan.
He opened the private chat window and immediately saw the voice message Lanlan sent.
"Lord, some of the blueprints you asked me to gather recently, I’ve already found a portion, sending them to you now."

sentences.text: In front of Han Xing, the loyalty interface of this giant ape appeared.
Long-armed Fierce Ape: Loyalty 46 (Subdued)
A loyalty of 46 points doesn’t even meet the passing level.
Han Xing’s mouth twitched.
In theory, as long as the Lord Contract is signed, loyalty should forcibly become over 80 points.
But this guy only has 46 points.
This indicates that deep down, this guy doesn’t actually submit to Han Xing; it’s only subdued due to strength.
However, Han Xing doesn’t mind.
With a newly tamed monster like this, one shouldn’t expect loyalty to reach a high level.
Once it enters Ten Thousand Stars City, I’ll have plenty of ways to deal with it!
So, Han Xing directly said, "Alright, there’s nothing more for you here, go stay well in my territory, and if you’re bored, find a tree to play with."
The Long-armed Fierce Ape nodded repeatedly upon hearing this.
It quickly stood up from the ground, then leapt ten meters high, directly jumping towards Ten Thousand Stars City.
Watching the ape leave, there was a fleeting cunning glint in its eyes.
Han Xing’s mouth also curved into a smile.
Little thing, still wanting to fight me, let’s see how I deal with you!
At this time, a system prompt appeared.
[You have cleared all the monsters on this Sky Island, you can now proceed with merging.]
Han Xing directly clicked merge.
[Merge successful, your territory has expanded, you have obtained Terrastone Raw Ore*1, obtained Purple Fir Forest*1, obtained...]
The harvest from this Sky Island is not bad.
Next, as long as the Terrastone at the mountain top is mined, we can refine pieces of Shimmering Terra Stone.
The task of mining this Terrastone is naturally given to the goblins.
They are also adept at this.

Then, he opened the blueprint tab and crafted a Shimmering Terra Stone Refinement Device.
After finishing these, Han Xing looked at the sky.
It’s afternoon, he can explore for a bit longer.
The distance to the location of another large light sphere is hundreds of thousands of kilometers away.
It would be a bit late if traveling on foot.
Han Xing decided to first explore the nearby Sky Islands and tomorrow check out the other large light sphere.
Ten Thousand Stars City continues to move.
Relying on the memories in his mind, he dashed rapidly towards those Sky Island locations in his head.
At this moment, Han Xing once again marveled, ’Mask of the Golden Goddess’ is truly a great thing.
Compared to before, when people could only wander aimlessly in the Witch Race Territory hoping to find those Sky Islands by luck.
Now, Han Xing clearly remembers the locations of those nearby Sky Islands in his mind.
With this, the expansion speed of Ten Thousand Stars City can increase several times.
Going forward, Han Xing maintained the same pace.
Exploring Sky Islands, eliminating the monsters inside, then annexing them.

Ten Thousand Stars City expanded by over three hundred square kilometers again.

chapters.title: Chapter 336 - 262: Warg, Chimera, Wind Erosion Goddess!
paragraphs: These days, Han Xing had Lanlan help keep an eye out for any blueprints in the trading channel.
Han Xing wasn’t short of Defense Tower blueprints.
At this stage, other Survivors couldn’t produce more advanced Defense Tower blueprints than what he had.
So, Han Xing had Lanlan focus on those powerful Soldier Camp blueprints and some statue blueprints.
When he saw Lanlan’s voice message, Han Xing’s heart was filled with joy.
"What blueprints? Send them to me so I can see."
Lanlan, upon hearing this, immediately initiated a trade request with him.
Then, she placed three types of blueprints in succession.
They were: [Warg Camp Map Blueprint], [Chimera Camp Map Blueprint (High Tier Soldiers)], and [Wind Erosion Goddess Statue Blueprint].
Seeing these three blueprints, Han Xing caught his breath momentarily, a hint of shock evident in his eyes.
"Wargs, Chimeras, Wind Erosion Goddess Statue!"
"You actually managed to acquire them!"
Half a month ago, when Xingyu City had just fully opened, Han Xing had mentioned it casually.
He had asked Lanlan to keep an eye on those Soldier Camp blueprints in the trading market.
Currently, he only had three types of soldier species in his territory, and although numerous, they were all melee units with obvious shortcomings.
Therefore, Han Xing wanted to recruit other soldier types to perfect the system.
Han Xing specifically instructed Lanlan to pay attention to species like Wargs and Horned Bulls that could be used as mounts.
However, the survivors knew the preciousness of such camp blueprints, so they seldom put them up for trading.
The ones circulating in the market were all low-level soldier species like Skeleton Soldiers and Earthworms, used just to make up numbers.
Yet, through Lanlan’s relentless efforts, she not only found the Warg Camp Map Blueprint for Han Xing but also found a high-tier species, the Chimera!
Both these soldier types were urgently needed by Han Xing at the moment.
Hearing the astonishment in Han Xing’s voice, Lanlan felt a small sense of pride.
"Yes, Lord, I find it quite incredible too."
"Previously, I offered an astronomical price of ten million Spirit Cores for this, kept it on the trading channel for more than ten days, and found no blueprint."
"In the past few days, our people gradually found these blueprints on some high-level Sky Islands."
"And upon hearing about my acquisition efforts, they sent them to me right away."
After listening to Lanlan’s explanation, Han Xing suddenly had a thought, as if he remembered something.
He took out the ’Mask of the Golden Goddess’ from his backpack.
Han Xing muttered quietly to himself, "Previously, Lanlan searched the trading channel for over ten days and found no Soldier Camp blueprints to purchase."
"But since I obtained this mask, in less than two days, three blueprints appeared in succession."
"Could it be due to the 10-point Luck Value bonus effect from binding with the Divine Artifact mask?"
Luck Value attributes are quite elusive, as they don’t appear on the system panel.
But now, it’s hard not to suspect that it’s related to this mask.
However, Han Xing didn’t overthink it and immediately clicked on the trade.
When the trade completion prompt appeared, Han Xing’s backpack now held three yellowed blueprints.
With a smile once again appearing at the corner of Han Xing’s mouth, he opened the private chat window and said.
"Thank you for your hard work, Lanlan."
Having communicated frequently with Han Xing lately, Lanlan no longer felt that initial shyness in front of him.
At this moment, Lanlan laughed softly, "Lord, no need to be so formal with me."
"As a member of your territory, serving you is my duty, and being able to help you is my delight."
Lanlan’s tone revealed genuine happiness from the heart.
Han Xing nodded and refrained from speaking further.
After terminating the private chat.
He immediately couldn’t wait to check the attributes of these three blueprints.
[Warg Camp Map Blueprint]: Use materials to build a camp in the territory where Wargs can be recruited. Wargs are melee creatures that can be used as mounts.
Upgrade camp technology to enhance the level of wargs and unlock new skills. Camp Defense Value is 200.
[Chimera Camp Map Blueprint (High Tier Soldiers)]: Use materials to build a camp in the territory where advanced creatures: Chimeras can be recruited.
Chimeras are dual-attribute magical creatures, at least Elite Level, with a low probability of appearing as Leader Level.
Upgrade camp technology to enhance the level of chimeras and unlock new skills. Camp Defense Value is 1000.
[Wind Erosion Goddess Statue Blueprint]: Build a Wind Erosion Goddess Statue in the territory.
[Statue Effect]: Reduces the Armor Value of all enemy creatures entering the territory by 33%. (Multiple statues do not stack.)
"Awesome!"
Upon viewing these three blueprints, Han Xing couldn’t help but exclaim in awe.
The first, Wargs, needs no further elaboration; as the exclusive mount for Wolf Cavalry, the combination of the two can rival even Elite Monsters of the same level, and even win in battle.
As the saying goes, a Wolf Cavalry without a Warg is just a Cavalry.
Now, they finally have a complete form.
Han Xing excitedly said, "The Wolf Cavalry are blessed."
As for the second camp blueprint, Chimera.
As a legendary creature from Ancient Greek mythology, it has a lion’s head, a goat’s body, and a snake’s tail.
When it attacks, its snake tail spews corrosive venom, and then the lion’s head spits destructive flames.
It’s a dual-attribute long-range creature.
Most importantly, these creatures have wings.
In other words, they have the ability to fly.
The impact they exert is far more terrifying than typical Elite Monsters of the same level.
Han Xing clenched his fist and said, "Great, now I have my first long-range attack troop—a substantial boost in power!
The effect of the third Goddess Statue is very clear, armor reduction, nothing more to say there.
With that thought in mind.
Han Xing directly clicked to learn all three blueprints.
Then, he came outside the Lord’s Mansion, chose a good spot, and clicked build.
"Would you like to use materials: Warg Totem*1, Refined Iron*100000... to build Warg Camp*1?"
Han Xing clicked yes to all.
With his current resource reserves, he didn’t need to check what materials were required for these constructions.
"Building Warg Camp, remaining time: 7 hours 43 minutes..."
"Building Chimera Camp, remaining time: 17 hours 23 minutes..."
"Building Wind Erosion Goddess Statue, remaining time: 8 hours 33 minutes..."
Having done these, Han Xing clapped his hands in satisfaction and went back to rest.
The next day...
As soon as Han Xing woke up from bed, he heard the system prompt.
"Your territory building, Warg Camp construction succeeded."
"Your territory building, Wind Erosion Goddess Statue construction succeeded."
Han Xing jumped up immediately and rushed outside the Lord’s Mansion.
At this moment.
On Ten Thousand Stars City’s Town Square, the fourth Goddess Statue had appeared.
The style of the Wind Erosion Goddess differed from the other three, appearing mysterious and profound.
Even as a statue, it was veiled, hiding its specific appearance.
However, from the statue’s appearance, the Goddess seemed to have a nice figure.
Han Xing nodded with satisfaction, "Great, I’m one step closer to achieving my goal of connecting the Goddesses."
Then, he headed outside the city of Ten Thousand Stars to the place where he built the Warg Camp.
Han Xing opened up attributes and checked directly.
[Warg Camp]: By consuming Spirit Cores, Wargs can be summoned to fight for you. By upgrading technology, the level of wargs can be increased.
[Technology]: Wolf Race Bloodline lv1 (Currently can summon lv1 Wargs, each level increase +1 Warg level)
Without even looking, Han Xing directly maxed out ’Wolf Race Bloodline’ technology to 45, the same as his level.
Then, Han Xing consumed a large number of Spirit Cores and in one go summoned 500,000 Wargs!
The system prompt appeared.
"Summoning Wargs, remaining time: 3 seconds..."
Summoning one Warg takes 3 seconds, which means nearly 29,000 a day.
This speed is slightly faster than summoning Wolf Cavalry.
But for Han Xing, it’s still a bit slow.
At this point, Han Xing pondered, "Looks like I need to find some items to shorten the summoning time and speed up my troop deployment."

chapters.title: Chapter 337 - 263: Forging Divine Artifacts and Anomalies...
paragraphs: During his moment of reflection.
The first warg had already been summoned.
A flash of white light appeared before him.
In front of Han Xing, a fierce beast appeared, covered in dark green fur, with a ghastly face and sharp fangs, looking ominously.
It was nearly five meters long and over two meters tall, though it was merely a fourth transformation creature, it exuded a powerful sense of oppression.
Appearing before Han Xing was this creature’s attributes.
[Warg: Four-star Creature]
[Level]: 45
[Attributes]: Power 2454, Agility 2748, Spirit 2158, Constitution 2072.
[Skills]: Rapid Assault (The warg charges forward in an instant, its claws turning into enormous spikes, dealing massive damage to the target and causing it to enter a bleeding state.)
Horror Scream (Let out a howl, intimidating surrounding enemies, causing them to fall into a fear state for a short period, reducing attack power and defense.)
Wolf Race Bloodline (Activate the wolf race bloodline, greatly increasing movement speed and reducing skill cooldown.)
After looking over the attributes of the warg, Han Xing’s gaze hardened.
"Damn, a single creature actually has three skills, and each skill effect is so impressive."
"Buddy, being a mount for the wolf cavalry is a bit beneath your talents."
Han Xing patted its shoulder, speechless, saying, "No wonder they say the wolf cavalry with wargs can single out elite monsters."
"With the attributes of this warg, even a random dog could single out an elite."
Speechless as he may be,
Han Xing still decided to hand over the summoned warg to the wolf cavalry.
After all, these creatures are loyally devoted to him and brave in battle.
Naturally, Han Xing won’t be stingy with them.
At that time, a group of wolf cavalry slowly walked over.
They hadn’t seen the warg in the camp, but simply sensed a familiar presence.
Seeing Han Xing, these wolves holding silver swords respectfully said, "Greetings, Lord."
Han Xing nodded, "You’re here, come take a look at your old friend."
This group of wolf cavalry had confusion in their eyes.
Then, when they saw, from behind Han Xing, that tall figure slowly stepping out.
Immediately, all the wolf cavalry’s pupils shrunk!
With disbelief in their eyes, they even spoke disjointedly.
"Lo... Lord, this... this..."
Han Xing nodded, "Mm, this is a warg."
"Next, I will summon more wargs to assist you in battle."
"Perform well, wolf cavalry."
Having said that, Han Xing left the place.
At this time, the group of wolf cavalry looked at Han Xing’s back with deep respect in their eyes.
They clenched their fists, exclaiming, "We shall not disappoint the Lord’s expectations!"
Walking off, Han Xing’s solemn face suddenly relaxed, revealing a smug smile.
"These wolf cavalry are really easy to please."
"Just summoning a few wargs for them gets them this excited."
Saying that, Han Xing suddenly shook his head, "No, it’s all thanks to my leadership skills."
"Lord Han Xing is exceptionally wise and mighty, undoubtedly worthy of this wolf cavalry’s loyalty, hahaha!"
Han Xing couldn’t help but laugh heartily then slowly walked back to the Lord’s mansion.
At this time, he suddenly saw four figures standing in front.
It was Zhang Lianmeng and Su Xiaoyang and the others.
The four of them were looking at the laughing Han Xing with strange expressions.
Han Xing’s facial expression instantly became restrained.
However, everyone maintained a mutual understanding, pretending not to see anything.
Han Xing coughed awkwardly twice, saying, "You guys are up?"
Everyone nodded.
Yet from their barely contained smiles, Han Xing knew these guys were trying not to laugh.
Han Xing pretended not to see, saying, "Alright, today we will continue exploring Sky Island."
"Got it, Brother Xing." Shen Yun responded promptly.
After the awkward atmosphere passed, Han Xing also quietly let out a sigh of relief.
Then he immediately took out the "Treasure Mask of the Wujin Goddess," activating the effects of "Treasure Hunting Eye" and "Eye of Desire."
Expending billions in resources.
In front of Han Xing, the scene from yesterday reappeared.
Within tens of thousands of kilometers, individual light clusters appeared, varying in size, numbering in the thousands.
Han Xing quickly committed them to memory.
At this time, Han Xing noticed a light point starting to flicker about fifty thousand kilometers away.
Its size was similar to the Divine Hall of Light they found yesterday.
Han Xing’s heart grew excited.
"This place, we might find a few more Divine Oracle Scriptures!"
After putting away the mask, Han Xing directly maneuvered Ten Thousand Stars City, impatiently heading towards the destination.
After an hour’s journey, Ten Thousand Stars City reached the target location once again.
As Han Xing had anticipated.
This time, they found another divine hall.
At this point, the system prompt appeared.
"This is an extremely ancient Sky Island, upon which is a Lost Temple once dedicated to an ancient and powerful divine spirit: Night Goddess, would you like to enter?"
Upon hearing the prompt, everyone was puzzled.
At this moment, Cheng Jianyong spoke, "Night Goddess? Isn’t there also a statue of the Night Goddess in Brother Xing’s Ten Thousand Stars City?"
Han Xing nodded.
Cheng Jianyong was right.
Currently, in Han Xing’s territory, there are statues of four goddesses.
Namely Night, Dawn, Nature, Wind Erosion.
Unexpectedly, here they encountered the sanctuary of one of the goddesses.
Upon hearing, Shen Yun sighed in relief, "It’s fortunate that it’s the Night Goddess’s divine hall, if it were another hall of the God of Light, I’d really hesitate to enter."
Cheng Jianyong also laughed, "Haha, since you’ve inherited the rival power of the God of Light, be careful when he descends to the Holy Spirit Realm, he might just come looking to trouble you."

[Skills]: Rapid Assault (The warg charges forward in an instant, its claws turning into enormous spikes, dealing massive damage to the target and causing it to enter a bleeding state.)
Horror Scream (Let out a howl, intimidating surrounding enemies, causing them to fall into a fear state for a short period, reducing attack power and defense.)
Wolf Race Bloodline (Activate the wolf race bloodline, greatly increasing movement speed and reducing skill cooldown.)
After looking over the attributes of the warg, Han Xing’s gaze hardened.
"Damn, a single creature actually has three skills, and each skill effect is so impressive."
"Buddy, being a mount for the wolf cavalry is a bit beneath your talents."
Han Xing patted its shoulder, speechless, saying, "No wonder they say the wolf cavalry with wargs can single out elite monsters."
"With the attributes of this warg, even a random dog could single out an elite."
Speechless as he may be,
Han Xing still decided to hand over the summoned warg to the wolf cavalry.
After all, these creatures are loyally devoted to him and brave in battle.
Naturally, Han Xing won’t be stingy with them.
At that time, a group of wolf cavalry slowly walked over.
They hadn’t seen the warg in the camp, but simply sensed a familiar presence.
Seeing Han Xing, these wolves holding silver swords respectfully said, "Greetings, Lord."
Han Xing nodded, "You’re here, come take a look at your old friend."
This group of wolf cavalry had confusion in their eyes.
Then, when they saw, from behind Han Xing, that tall figure slowly stepping out.
Immediately, all the wolf cavalry’s pupils shrunk!
With disbelief in their eyes, they even spoke disjointedly.
Lord, this... this..."
Han Xing nodded, "Mm, this is a warg."
"Next, I will summon more wargs to assist you in battle."
"Perform well, wolf cavalry."
Having said that, Han Xing left the place.
At this time, the group of wolf cavalry looked at Han Xing’s back with deep respect in their eyes.
They clenched their fists, exclaiming, "We shall not disappoint the Lord’s expectations!"
Walking off, Han Xing’s solemn face suddenly relaxed, revealing a smug smile.
"These wolf cavalry are really easy to please."
"Just summoning a few wargs for them gets them this excited."
Saying that, Han Xing suddenly shook his head, "No, it’s all thanks to my leadership skills."
"Lord Han Xing is exceptionally wise and mighty, undoubtedly worthy of this wolf cavalry’s loyalty, hahaha!"
Han Xing couldn’t help but laugh heartily then slowly walked back to the Lord’s mansion.
At this time, he suddenly saw four figures standing in front.
It was Zhang Lianmeng and Su Xiaoyang and the others.
The four of them were looking at the laughing Han Xing with strange expressions.
Han Xing’s facial expression instantly became restrained.
However, everyone maintained a mutual understanding, pretending not to see anything.
Han Xing coughed awkwardly twice, saying, "You guys are up?"
Everyone nodded.
Yet from their barely contained smiles, Han Xing knew these guys were trying not to laugh.
Han Xing pretended not to see, saying, "Alright, today we will continue exploring Sky Island."
"Got it, Brother Xing." Shen Yun responded promptly.
After the awkward atmosphere passed, Han Xing also quietly let out a sigh of relief.
Then he immediately took out the "Treasure Mask of the Wujin Goddess," activating the effects of "Treasure Hunting Eye" and "Eye of Desire."
Expending billions in resources.
In front of Han Xing, the scene from yesterday reappeared.
Within tens of thousands of kilometers, individual light clusters appeared, varying in size, numbering in the thousands.
Han Xing quickly committed them to memory.
At this time, Han Xing noticed a light point starting to flicker about fifty thousand kilometers away.
Its size was similar to the Divine Hall of Light they found yesterday.
Han Xing’s heart grew excited.
"This place, we might find a few more Divine Oracle Scriptures!"
After putting away the mask, Han Xing directly maneuvered Ten Thousand Stars City, impatiently heading towards the destination.
After an hour’s journey, Ten Thousand Stars City reached the target location once again.
As Han Xing had anticipated.
This time, they found another divine hall.
At this point, the system prompt appeared.
"This is an extremely ancient Sky Island, upon which is a Lost Temple once dedicated to an ancient and powerful divine spirit: Night Goddess, would you like to enter?"
Upon hearing the prompt, everyone was puzzled.
At this moment, Cheng Jianyong spoke, "Night Goddess?
Isn’t there also a statue of the Night Goddess in Brother Xing’s Ten Thousand Stars City?"
Han Xing nodded.
Cheng Jianyong was right.
Currently, in Han Xing’s territory, there are statues of four goddesses.
Namely Night, Dawn, Nature, Wind Erosion.
Unexpectedly, here they encountered the sanctuary of one of the goddesses.
Upon hearing, Shen Yun sighed in relief, "It’s fortunate that it’s the Night Goddess’s divine hall, if it were another hall of the God of Light, I’d really hesitate to enter."
Cheng Jianyong also laughed, "Haha, since you’ve inherited the rival power of the God of Light, be careful when he descends to the Holy Spirit Realm, he might just come looking to trouble you."

chapters.title: Chapter 338 - 263: Forging Divine Artifacts and Anomalies...
paragraphs: Shen Yun glanced at him and said, "It’s not that exaggerated, this guy is just a bit petty."
"But we noticed yesterday that these divine spirits can’t easily descend to the Holy Spirit Realm, and they will also be intercepted by some kind of power."
"This time, there shouldn’t be any unexpected incidents."
Han Xing nodded, "That’s right, last time was just an accident."
"We have no grudge against this Night Goddess; she shouldn’t be willing to pay the price to descend to the Holy Spirit Realm just to deal with us few ants."
Everyone agreed after listening.
Then, they followed Han Xing and entered the temple of the Night Goddess together.
The temple of the Night Goddess and the temple of the God of Light are quite similar in architectural style.
Copper pillars and stone walls, solemn and magnificent.
It seems they were all built by the same batch of creatures.
Inside the temple, they explored for a while and once again found the guardian monsters inside.
[Night Attendant: Four-star Lord-level creature.]
The attributes of this Night Attendant are similar to those of the Light Attendant.
At first, the Night Attendant seemed extremely valiant.
Facing the onslaught of five people, there was only one outcome awaiting this Night Attendant.
Which was to be taken down by them.
As everyone’s attacks fell on the Night Attendant one after another, its brilliance was directly dispelled.
The kill notification appeared.
On the ground, two yellowed sheets of paper and a few black stones fell.
[You have successfully cleared all hostile creatures on this Sky Island, it can now be merged with another island.]
Hearing the system prompt, everyone breathed a sigh of relief.
This time, indeed, there was no unexpected divine descent incident.
Looking at the yellowed sheets of paper on the ground.
Han Xing’s eyes immediately lit up, and he hurried to pick them up.
[Obtained Divine Oracle Scripture*2, obtained Night Divine Stone*9.]
"Great!" Han Xing clenched his fist.
"Now, we’re just missing the last Divine Oracle Scripture, and we can start crafting the Oracle Throne!"
"If nothing unexpected happens, we can gather it by tomorrow!"
After the excitement, Han Xing picked up the black stones on the ground and saw the item information.

[Night Divine Stone]: A stone containing a trace of the Night Goddess’s divine power. Once a hundred are collected, it can be used to upgrade the Night Goddess Statue, or it can be used as a Philosopher’s Stone.
"Oh? The Night Divine Stone can also upgrade the statue?"
Han Xing was momentarily stunned.
The Night Goddess Statue in his territory still had a very strong effect.
During the day it could provide them with a 10% Attack Power bonus, and at night it provided a 20% Attack Power bonus, which was quite beneficial.
However, what he didn’t expect was that the statue could actually be upgraded.
However, upgrading the statue requires a hundred Night Divine Stones, which is quite far from what he currently has.
Han Xing had to temporarily put this idea aside.
Next.
Han Xing continued to lead everyone, continuing the rhythm of yesterday.
Time flew by.
The next day...
Han Xing once again activated the special effect on the Mask of the Golden Goddess.
Following the guidance of the highlighted area.
He found the third temple.
[Temple of the Goddess of Mist]
As the name suggests.
After dealing with the Divine Attendant inside, Han Xing managed to get two Divine Oracle Scriptures as he wished.
Thus.
All the materials needed for crafting the Oracle Throne had been fully gathered by him.
At this moment.
Standing upon the Ten Thousand Stars, Han Xing was so excited he almost cried.
"Damn it, it wasn’t easy at all..."
To craft this Divine Artifact, it took an untold amount of his energy.
First, he followed Wu Ling’Er across the perilous Path of the Giant Dragon to the Witch Race Territory.
Then he went to the Abyssal Rift to grind for more than half a month, boosting everyone’s strength.
By chance, he obtained the Mask of the Golden Goddess.
Then, he even faced an existence beyond the rules and almost died there.
After many twists and turns, he finally gathered all the materials for the Oracle Throne!
Now, he just wanted to craft this Divine Artifact immediately without waiting another moment!
Han Xing clicked on the blueprint interface and directly clicked to construct!

[Would you like to consume materials: Philosopher’s Stone*1000, Shadow Divine Stone*500, Shimmering Terra Stone*500, Rhythm Black Iron*1000, Divine Oracle Scripture*5, to craft the Oracle Throne (Red)?]
Yes!
Han Xing instantly clicked OK.
In the warehouse, a large amount of materials disappeared.
At the same time.
A burst of soaring red light appeared.
This burst of red light was even more terrifying than when Han Xing opened the first ’Sun Treasure Chest’.
The entire sky seemed to be dyed a deep red.
Everyone felt an infinite Divine Power converging within.
[Currently crafting Oracle Throne (Red), remaining time 5 hours and 12 minutes...]
This was Han Xing’s first time crafting Divine Artifact Level special equipment, and he was shocked by the time it required.
It actually took a full five hours!
To know, even crafting Orange Equipment only took a few minutes.
And now, it has increased by dozens of times!
It seems, the attributes of this Oracle Throne are not generally terrifying!
Han Xing could only forcibly suppress the excitement in his heart, eagerly anticipating the effect after the Oracle Throne is completed.
Meanwhile...
At the Witch Race Border.
Tens of millions of Witch Race soldiers were stationed there.
The war equipment on each Sky Island was poised to activate at any moment.

Commander Korden sat at the table, listening to the reports of his subordinates, and with a strange look said, "You mean, since the day I reprimanded her, Feienna has been staying in her room without coming out?"
Beside him, the Witch Race soldier nodded lightly, "Yes, Commander Korden."
"Do you need me to go and call her out?
Korden thought for a moment, shook his head, and said, "Forget it, as a priest, I should give her some face."
"As long as she doesn’t cause trouble for me, I can’t be bothered to deal with her."
The Witch Race soldier respectfully agreed upon hearing this.
However, they didn’t know.
At this moment, Feienna was desperately hoping someone would rescue her.
She sat at the head of the bed, pale, clutching her head tightly, muttering to herself.
"No... I can’t do this! If the High Priest finds out, he will kill me!"
"Hehehe, he won’t find out, the High Priest is already in a dire situation. Soon, several Legends will deal with him, he won’t be able to interfere with you."
Upon hearing this, Feienna shook her head immediately, "No, still no, you can’t force me to do this!"
In the next moment, her expression changed again.
Her mouth carried a faint smile, and her eyes seemed to reveal endless allure.
"Feienna, I’m not forcing you, oh, this is a condition you agreed to yourself, if you refuse..."
Feienna’s body froze, the seductive look on her face disappeared, and she fell into extreme fear.
A moment later, Feienna suddenly raised her head, showing a determined expression.
"No, I can’t betray the Witch Race, you will not succeed!"
"Lord Saint Master is an existence of that level, he will definitely reverse the situation and completely defeat the Shadow Legion."
A light laughter sounded, "Feienna, the Lord Saint Master you rely on has been confronting the Shadow Monarch in the Void Turbulence for decades, unable to attend to anything else."
"Haven’t you noticed that the Witch Race’s Saint Master has seldom appeared in recent decades?"
Feienna’s face stiffened.
At this moment, the woman’s voice sounded again.
She laughed softly and said, "Moreover, do you think the Shadow Legion has been inactive for so many days for nothing?"
"We have long been infiltrating your Witch Race Territory, this time not only you but all Witch Clan Priests, those who don’t comply, will all die!"
"The Witch Race is destined to be defeated this time!"
Listening to the woman’s words, panic and bewilderment appeared in Feienna’s eyes.
"No! Don’t!"
"Hehehe... now, it’s not up to you, Feienna!"
A terrifying aura erupted from within her.
A faint tremor passed through the room.
A moment later, Feienna pushed open the door with a pale face.
After more than half a month, it was the first time she had walked out of her room.
However, those soldiers who saw her felt that today’s Thirteen Priests were somewhat different.
Compared to the previous Feienna, who had a touch of arrogance amidst her capriciousness.
Now she carried a few more traces of allure in her aura.
Feienna walked gracefully, her hips swaying, like a nimble black snake.
She began to stroll leisurely across the Sky Islands, walking casually as if taking a stroll.
However, what those Witch Race soldiers didn’t notice was.
Every time Feienna passed a Sky Island, she would discreetly drop a jet-black stone in an unnoticed place.
These stones would quickly vanish upon landing, as if they had never appeared.
After doing all this, Feienna returned to her residence once more.

chapters.title: Chapter 339 - 264: Dark Shadow Invasion, Total War!
paragraphs: At this moment.
Commander Korden listened to his subordinates report on Feienna’s whereabouts.
A hint of contemplation flashed across his face.
"What is this woman up to again?"
He couldn’t quite understand.
Just then, Korden suddenly smelled a strange scent.
This scent seemed familiar; his nose twitched a few times.
"This aura, why does it resemble the Shadow Mist somewhat..."
"But lately, there’s been no news of the Shadow Legion’s activity..."
Something unusual must be happening.
He suddenly realized something was amiss; as a veteran rival of the Shadow Legion for dozens of years, he was very familiar with this aura.
The next moment, Korden’s face instantly changed dramatically!
"Damn, it really is the Shadow Legion!"
Korden shouted loudly to the soldiers below.
"Quick! Sound all alarms!"
"Tell them, the Shadow Legion is attacking!"
At the same time, in those Sky Islands outside, bursts of black smoke suddenly appeared and began to rapidly spread within seconds!
Commander Korden noticed something wrong at the first instance of the black mist’s appearance.
Yet despite this, he was completely unable to stop it.
Because the spreading speed of the Shadow Mist was simply too fast!
When the alarm sounded.
The entire Witch Race border defense line, thousands of Sky Islands, had already been completely covered by the black mist.
In the frightened gaze of the Witch Race soldiers.
They suddenly saw pairs of ghastly green eyes appearing in the mist!
And the number kept increasing.
Those eyes stared at the Witch Race soldiers, assessing them, mocking them, filled with murderous intent...
The Witch Race soldiers felt chills run through them the moment they met these eyes.
At this moment, the piercing alarm sounds echoed throughout the Witch Race border!
"Enemy attack! Enemy attack!"
"Shadow Legion invasion, all Witch Race soldiers, enter into war state now!"
Korden instantly rushed out of the command room.
By now, the Sky Island war outside had already begun.
Countless Witch Race soldiers reacted immediately, starting to clear out the monsters in the mist!
On the Sky Islands, those war machines were also unleashing terrifying firepower!
At this moment, at least thousands of attacks equalling the Demon Elephant War Chariot’s destructive power were launched simultaneously.
Boom boom boom!
Terrifying flames rose.
Millions of Shadow Fangs were burned to ashes by this wave of bombardment.
Even the thick Shadow Mist was dispelled considerably.
At this time, Korden frowned, holding a silver longsword, looking solemnly at the scene within the mist.
As he predicted.
After the first wave of Shadow Fangs was cleared, even more Shadow Monsters emerged from the mist.
Korden seriously said, "The Shadow Legion emerges from the mist, and wherever there’s Shadow Mist, more monsters will continue to appear inexhaustibly."
"Only by clearing all the monsters and exhausting the energy within the mist can the Shadow Legion be defeated."
As an experienced commander, he naturally had a deep understanding of the Shadow Legion.
He knew how to achieve the greatest victory with the least loss.
At this moment, Korden shouted loudly, "All Witch Race soldiers, withdraw from the range of the Shadow Mist."
"All war chariots and warships, bombard with all your might, keep sweeping the land!"
Upon receiving Korden’s orders, the entire Witch Race border began to operate.
However, halfway through Korden’s instructions.
He seemed to sense something, suddenly looked back.
Even facing Legendary Powerhouses, he remained unperturbed, yet at this moment a trace of fear appeared on his face.
"Damn it!
"Everyone pay attention! All Sky Islands enter level-one war state!"
"Notify the priests, the Saintess and them, the Shadow Army has fully invaded, this scale is unprecedented!"
Korden looked at the black mist gradually covering the sky behind him.
Even with his composure, he couldn’t help but feel his scalp go numb.
However, what he didn’t know.
Not only their defense line was impacted right now.
Throughout the Witch Race Territory, in every region, a large amount of black mist rose.
Countless Sky Islands were engulfed in flames of war.
Even Wu Ling’Er guarding the main city sensed the nearby appearance of enemy information.
The Shadow Legion launched the largest-scale assault in recent years!
On this day, dozens of Legendary Level auras soared into the sky, erupting terrifying battles across the entire Witch Race Territory.
At the moment.
Han Xing, who was waiting for the completion of the Oracle Throne, suddenly felt a slight tremble from his backpack.
Taking it out, he saw that it was the token Wu Ling’Er had given them last time.
On it, there was a message from Wu Ling’Er.
"Han Xing, the Shadow Legion has launched a full-scale war, the entire Witch Race Territory is engulfed in flames, please stay away as much as possible from the areas where war is breaking out!"
"If you encounter an emergency, please contact me as soon as possible, I will arrive at the first instance!"
Not only Han Xing, others also received Wu Ling’Er’s message.
At this moment, everyone once again felt the concern this woman had for them.
Cheng Jianyong exclaimed in surprise, "What the heck, the Shadow Legion launched a full-scale war?"
"Weren’t things fine before? Why did it suddenly escalate?"
Everyone was also having a bad premonition.
This time, the Shadow Legion’s actions were too swift.
It was as if they had been plotting for a long time, suddenly erupting at this moment, leaving everyone caught off guard.
Shen Yun frowned at this time, saying, "Wu Ling’Er advised us to stay away from the war zones and mentioned we could reach out to her if needed."
"But according to her, the whole Witch Race Territory is at war, there seems to be no safe place."

As an experienced commander, he naturally had a deep understanding of the Shadow Legion.
He knew how to achieve the greatest victory with the least loss.
At this moment, Korden shouted loudly, "All Witch Race soldiers, withdraw from the range of the Shadow Mist."
"All war chariots and warships, bombard with all your might, keep sweeping the land!"
Upon receiving Korden’s orders, the entire Witch Race border began to operate.
However, halfway through Korden’s instructions.
He seemed to sense something, suddenly looked back.
Even facing Legendary Powerhouses, he remained unperturbed, yet at this moment a trace of fear appeared on his face.
"Damn it!
"Everyone pay attention!
All Sky Islands enter level-one war state!"
"Notify the priests, the Saintess and them, the Shadow Army has fully invaded, this scale is unprecedented!"
Korden looked at the black mist gradually covering the sky behind him.
Even with his composure, he couldn’t help but feel his scalp go numb.
However, what he didn’t know.
Not only their defense line was impacted right now.
Throughout the Witch Race Territory, in every region, a large amount of black mist rose.
Countless Sky Islands were engulfed in flames of war.
Even Wu Ling’Er guarding the main city sensed the nearby appearance of enemy information.
The Shadow Legion launched the largest-scale assault in recent years!
On this day, dozens of Legendary Level auras soared into the sky, erupting terrifying battles across the entire Witch Race Territory.
At the moment.
Han Xing, who was waiting for the completion of the Oracle Throne, suddenly felt a slight tremble from his backpack.
Taking it out, he saw that it was the token Wu Ling’Er had given them last time.
On it, there was a message from Wu Ling’Er.
"Han Xing, the Shadow Legion has launched a full-scale war, the entire Witch Race Territory is engulfed in flames, please stay away as much as possible from the areas where war is breaking out!"
"If you encounter an emergency, please contact me as soon as possible, I will arrive at the first instance!"
Not only Han Xing, others also received Wu Ling’Er’s message.
At this moment, everyone once again felt the concern this woman had for them.
Cheng Jianyong exclaimed in surprise, "What the heck, the Shadow Legion launched a full-scale war?"
"Weren’t things fine before?
Why did it suddenly escalate?"
Everyone was also having a bad premonition.
This time, the Shadow Legion’s actions were too swift.
It was as if they had been plotting for a long time, suddenly erupting at this moment, leaving everyone caught off guard.
Shen Yun frowned at this time, saying, "Wu Ling’Er advised us to stay away from the war zones and mentioned we could reach out to her if needed."
"But according to her, the whole Witch Race Territory is at war, there seems to be no safe place."

chapters.title: Chapter 340 - 264: Dark Shadow Invasion, Total War!
paragraphs: "Staying with a legendary powerhouse should be the safest."
"Brother Xing, can we go find her now?"
Shen Yun’s words were not without reason.
However, after hearing this, Han Xing shook his head and said, "Don’t pin your hopes on Wu Ling’Er, from her words, we can tell that the situation is somewhat dire."
"The Witch Race has been fighting the Shadow Legion for many years, not only failing to defeat them completely but suffering heavy losses."
"This indicates that the overall strength of the Witch Race is actually inferior to the Shadow Legion."
Upon hearing this, everyone’s expressions turned solemn.
Han Xing furrowed his brows and continued analyzing: "Although Wu Ling’Er has told us to find her if we encounter danger."
"But clearly, she too is somewhat powerless now."
"Moreover, Wu Ling’Er also has a main city, with billions of Witch Race people needing her protection."
"So, it’s better if we don’t go over and disturb her now."
Upon hearing this, everyone nodded in agreement.
This time, Wu Ling’Er’s actions once again earned their goodwill.
At the outbreak of the war, she immediately sent them a message.
They were not the kind of people who didn’t know how to reciprocate.
Therefore, Han Xing’s suggestion was very much approved by everyone.
At the moment, Han Xing said: "Also, we shouldn’t be overly worried."
"Compared to over a month ago when we first arrived in the Witch Race Territory, our strength now has significantly transformed."
"With Ten Thousand Stars City’s firepower, we should be able to confront general legends without much problem."
Cheng Jianyong and Shen Yun’s eyes moved.
They knew that what Han Xing referred to was only the firepower of Ten Thousand Stars City, not including their quintet’s combat power.
Currently, with the combined power of five people, they can hold their ground against legendary powerhouses for a while.
If they went all out, they could even take a few bites off their opponents’ flesh.
Moreover, what they didn’t know was.
In a few hours’ time.
Once the [Oracle Throne] is completed.
Han Xing’s personal power will surge tremendously again!
By then, he will truly possess the power to pose a significant threat to legendary powerhouses!
Han Xing said: "Wu Ling’Er doesn’t know that within this month’s time, we’ve completed our strength transformation."
"So, as long as we’re not facing legends, the Shadow Legion may not be as dangerous as imagined for us."
"We can even support the Witch Race in reverse."
"My suggestion is that if we encounter battle zones between the Witch Race and the Shadow Legion next, we should try to lend a hand where possible."
"What do you all think?"
Upon hearing this, everyone broke into genuine smiles.
They knew Han Xing’s character.
Wu Ling’Er treated them as real friends, sincerely.
Even when her tribe was in danger, she was willing to spare extra strength to help everyone.
For true friends, Han Xing always offers help whenever possible, never stingy.
Cheng Jianyong eagerly said: "Brother Xing, let’s go!"
"Let’s see how powerful this so-called Shadow Legion truly is!
Everyone nodded simultaneously.
Holding onto their weapons, their war intent surged!
Ten Thousand Stars City began to move.
As Wu Ling’Er mentioned, the Shadow Legion has already invaded the Witch Race Territory comprehensively.
Not long after proceeding, they saw a huge Witch Race Sky Island ahead.
It was shrouded in black mist, with continuous sounds of slaughter.
Boom! Boom!
The roar of artillery, and gigantic war machines looming faintly in the mist.
Everyone frowned.
This was indeed the first time they saw the Shadow Legion invading in such a manner.
It must be said, their methods are certainly bizarre.
The entire Sky Island was covered by black mist, even with their perception, they couldn’t see what was happening inside.
Cheng Jianyong said beside them: "So this is the Shadow Legion? It’s indeed fitting; you can’t see anything, truly shadows."
Han Xing nodded: "Let’s go, get closer to take a look."
Ten Thousand Stars City continued to approach.
However, before they could get close to the Sky Island.
From the black mist, a massive Witch Race Battleship suddenly rushed out.
The battleship was nearly a hundred meters long, resembling a spindle-shaped spacecraft, charging out with billowing smoke.
However, before the battleship could escape far from the mist.
In the rear of the mist, some monsters appeared suddenly, all standing seven to eight meters tall, their whole bodies resembling black crystals, with prismatic spikes on their backs.
At this moment, these monsters, staring with pairs of ghastly green eyes, swiftly leapt onto the deck of the battleship.
Then began fiercely attacking the exterior of the battleship.
Crack! Crack!
The sound of metal tearing rang out.
This gigantic battleship made of advanced metal, with astonishing defense, was forcibly torn open with gashes on its top.
The cabin looked on the brink of being breached.
Suddenly, from either side of the battleship’s gun mounts, thick smoke puffed out.
Boom! Boom!
Dozens of shells carrying destructive power suddenly fired, then turned mid-air, aiming straight at these crystal monsters!
However.
Facing the bombardment, these monsters did not dodge.
They showed distorted grins on their faces.
Even with shells coming overhead, they continued fiercely attacking the hull.
In the second before the shells were about to explode, strong energy fluctuations emerged from these Shadow Monsters.
Then, they directly exploded!
Boom!
The shells fell, rising flames to the sky.
The battleship shook violently.
Once the flames subsided, those Shadow Monsters vanished without a trace.
However, due to unimaginable damage taken, the battleship also exploded.
In the sky.
The battleship became a ball of flames, along with the Witch Race soldiers inside, falling into the endless sky...
Everyone gasped.
This was indeed their first time seeing the Shadow Legion monsters, shocked by their brutally fierce tactics.
Compared to the Shadow Legion, the previous Blood Tide Monsters were simply too tame.
However, Han Xing and the others did not feel much fear.
Because, they had already realized.
Just now, although those Shadow Monsters were ferocious, their strength was only equivalent to fourth transformation level Elite Monsters.
With their current power, it was just a matter of an ordinary attack.
Cheng Jianyong said: "Brother Xing, this Sky Island looks pretty big, should we use Hellfire for a sweep first?"
Han Xing looked at the Witch Race Sky Island ahead, indeed it was large.
It covered hundreds of thousands of square kilometers, equivalent to a province’s area on Blue Star.
Five hundred Hellfire Missile Silos, one round of bombing could only cover part of the area.
Upon hearing this, Shen Yun immediately patted Cheng Jianyong’s head and said: "What are you thinking?"
"You’re here to rescue, not to kill."
"A sweep, aren’t you afraid it’ll wash off the Witch Race people too?"
Cheng Jianyong slapped his thigh, seemingly realizing this point too.
Knowing well, those Witch Race People don’t have ally damage immunity function.
Such blind bombing could possibly kill a lot of Shadow Monsters.
But similarly, many Witch Race People would also die in the artillery fire.
Then, that would be trouble.
Cheng Jianyong embarrassedly smiled.
Han Xing shook his head: "I don’t sense any legendary aura on this Sky Island."
"With our power, even if besieged by fourth-turn lords, we can calmly retreat."
"Let’s go in to see the situation first, then decide which method of attack to use."
Shen Yun nodded, agreeing readily: "Brother Xing’s advice is reliable, Xiaoyongzi, don’t go spouting ideas."
Upon hearing this, Cheng Jianyong also shrugged.
Then, they directly maneuvered Xingyu City into the Black Mist.
As they first entered the Black Mist, a system alert appeared.
[You have entered the Shadow Mist Area, vision reduced by 50%, perception reduced by 50%.]
Everyone’s expressions subtly shifted.
These two negative states, although slightly annoying, they were manageable given their power.
But for ordinary Witch Race soldiers, this effect would be quite uncomfortable.
Knowing strongly that in battles, vision and perception primarily guide evaluating opponents’ moves.
With these senses weakened, combat power would decrease significantly!
