chapters.title: Chapter 341 - 265: First Show of Strength, Crushing the Lords!
paragraphs: Moreover, these Witch Race soldiers can’t leave the battle area covered by shadows.
Because this is their Sky Island, their homeland.
Above lies a population of over a billion, along with numerous buildings.
At this moment, Ten Thousand Stars City, like a giant beast, barged into the mist.
As soon as they entered, they heard deafening battle cries rising from below.
Flames surged, artillery roared.
Han Xing and others fixed their gaze.
Below, there was a massive city, a group of Witch Race soldiers relying on the city’s firepower, standing firm on the plains below.
On the city wall, a Witch Race officer stood at a high vantage point, shouting loudly: "Ignite more Crow Divine Fire, illuminate the Shadow Mist!"
Below, upon hearing this, the soldiers all took out a bird-beak shaped cannon from their pockets and lit it.
Swoosh, swoosh, swoosh!
As streaks of red light shot into the sky.
The black mist was lit up in patches.
Providing these Witch Race soldiers a good view.
Han Xing, witnessing this scene, felt reassured.
It seemed that the Witch Race, after dealing with the Shadow Legion for so many years, made some progress.
At least, they found a way to counteract these negative effects of the black mist.
However, the Crow Divine Fire could only illuminate larger areas, unable to genuinely dispel it.
Shadow Fierce Beasts continued to gather from within the black mist.
They swarmed like a tide, launching suicide attacks on the Witch Race soldiers’ formations.
Apart from these Shadow Suicide Bombers.
Han Xing and others also saw.
Within the black mist, there were more Shadow Soldiers.
Shadow Beasts, Shadow Flying Dragons, Shadow Messengers, and so forth.
At this moment, a humanoid monster over twenty meters tall, clad in Shadow Armor, leapt high.
Its eyes, like other monsters, glowed with a ghastly green light.
Gazing at the Witch Race army below, it suddenly snorted coldly.
Then, with a surge, it jumped straight into the midst of the Witch Race army, crashing down!
Rumble!
Earth-shattering!
This impact crushed at least hundreds of Witch Race soldiers into meat paste on the spot.
More Witch Race soldiers were shattered internally by this horrific shock.
The defensive formation crafted by the Witch Race soldiers was torn open in an instant.
At the rear, the Witch Race officer, witnessing the devastation of the troops, was instantly filled with rage!
He forcibly held back his inner fury, angrily commanding: "Concentrate firepower, annihilate that Shadow General first!"
"Other soldiers, fill the gaps, prevent the enemy from advancing further!"
Hearing this, the Witch Race soldiers fearlessly rushed forward, attempting to block the Shadow General’s advance with their flesh bodies.
However.
The Shadow General seemed utterly disdainful of these soldiers’ interception.
With a casual wave of its Black Crystal Greatsword.
Dozens of Witch Race soldiers were sliced in half on the spot.
Splatter, splatter, splatter!
Blood stained the ground red.
The Witch Race soldiers suppressed their grief, stepping over their fallen comrades, charging the Shadow General once more.
However, the Shadow General was overwhelmingly powerful.
A level 48 lord, almost touching that threshold.
No matter how fearlessly the Witch Race soldiers fought, they fell in droves.
At this moment, from a distance on the city wall, a barrage of dense Holy Light Bombs exploded.
Such defense towers generally possess great destructive power.
Yet, the Shadow General wasn’t foolish, standing still to be attacked.
The Shadow General snorted coldly.
Its figure vanished instantly from its spot, its agility attribute of 4800 unleashing unimaginable extreme speed.
In the next moment, the Shadow General appeared amidst a group of Witch Race soldiers.
The soldiers felt a powerful aura suddenly descend, and turned their heads in bewilderment.
Then, they faced those scornful, ghastly green eyes.
At this moment, a Witch Race soldier was the first to react, stammering.
"Atta—"
Splurt!
The greatsword descended.
The Witch Race soldiers couldn’t even finish their words before being cleaved in half.
In the next moment, the Shadow General transformed into a human meat grinder.
Frantically wielding the greatsword, it rampaged through the Witch Race army.
"Ah!!! Stop him!"
"Damn it, I’ll kill you!"
"Help... help!"
Splurt! Splurt splurt splurt!
Amidst the chaos, screams and battle cries formed a battlefield cacophony.
More and more Witch Race soldiers perished under the Shadow General’s greatsword.
Moreover, to make matters worse.
As their defenses were breached, even more Shadow Monsters were surging in.
Numbers overwhelming.
Interspersed among them were some extremely terrifying beings.
Monsters with an aura akin to the Shadow General numbered at least two!
At this moment, the Witch Race officer standing at the vantage point felt waves of despair.
It must be understood, the Shadow General was already a Four-star Lord Level creature.
With his strength, dealing with one was already an immense struggle.
Let alone so many lords suddenly appearing, mixed with several Third and Fourth Transformation leaders and elites.
At this moment, the other Witch Race soldiers also saw this despair-inducing scene.
They exclaimed.
"It’s over, it’s over, two more lord creatures have appeared."
"If a few Demon Elephant War Chariots aren’t brought over, Anmo City will be conquered today!"
Beside him, a soldier asked with a face of fear: "Where are the Demon Elephant War Chariots, and the other ancient weapons?"
"Quick! We can’t hold on any longer!"
However, no one answered him.
A Witch Race soldier patted his shoulder, saying: "Forget it, all the Demon Elephant War Chariots and battleships are stationed in Warhawk City."

chapters.title: Chapter 342 - 265: First Display of Power, Crushing the Lords!
paragraphs: "There are over a billion Witch Race civilians there, making it the most important place on this Sky Island."
"Moreover, the pressure there is far more terrifying than on our side, with a massive number of Shadow Monsters besieging Warhawk City."
"Right now, they can barely hold on."
The soldier, upon hearing this, was instantly filled with despair.
Before he could continue speaking, he saw the distant Shadow Army, already braving the artillery fire of Anmo City, charging towards the Witch Race army.
The two sides began to engage directly.
That Witch Race officer was speaking into a green stone, seemingly communicating with someone.

He said urgently, "Report to the commander, the situation in Anmo City is extremely critical, three Lord-level creatures have emerged from the mist and are leading the Shadow Army against our formation!"
"With my strength, I can only handle one Lord at most, I need more support on this side!"
"Deploy two Demon Elephant War Chariots or bring over two Leader-level warriors!"
The officer quickly reported the situation here and then waited for a response.
A moment later, his expression suddenly changed, exclaiming in shock, "What? No support!?"
"Why!"
He looked very puzzled, with a trace of panic in his eyes.
After hearing the explanation from the other side, the officer said anxiously, "I know, the situation over at Warhawk City is very pressing."
"But I’m telling you, Anmo City is even more dangerous, it’s on the verge of being overrun!"
"Are you just going to leave this side to fend for itself?"
"There are also tens of millions of civilians in Anmo City..."
The person on the other end did not respond, as if interrupted by some unexpected situation.
Looking at the now dim and dull jade in his hand, the Witch Race officer fell into complete despair.
He clenched his fist tightly, his nails almost digging into his flesh.
"Damn! No support!"
"What to do! What to do! What to do!"
"Is praying for a miracle our only hope now?"
"Saint Master..."
However, his prayers would inevitably go unanswered.
Han Xing and the others exchanged a glance.
They had not acted immediately upon landing because they were assessing the strength of the Shadow Legion.
They were considering appropriate strategies.
Now it seemed, this wave of the Shadow Legion was indeed formidable.
But to them, it posed no real threat.
Cheng Jianyong then said, "Brother Xing, should we act?"
Han Xing nodded, looking at the endangered formation of the Witch Race soldiers, and said directly.
"Let’s move!"
With that, Han Xing leaped straight off of Ten Thousand Stars City.
Whoosh! Whoosh whoosh!
The others followed suit.
Several figures passed through the thick Shadow Mist, sweeping over the Witch Race army’s heads, heading directly towards those few Four-star Lords.
Due to the similar appearance of the Human Race and the Witch Race,
And with the mist obscuring their view, most Witch Race soldiers did not see Han Xing and the others’ identities.
They only felt several enigmatic auras swiftly passing over their heads.
The officer standing at the vantage point also noticed Han Xing and the others.
A hint of astonishment suddenly appeared in his eyes, previously filled with despair.
The next moment, he hurriedly shouted, "Which special ops team are those guys from, get back here now!"
"There are many leaders and elites in there, even Lord-level creatures, don’t go head-to-head with them!"
However, Han Xing and the others did not heed him.
Instead, they charged straight into the battlefield, heading toward the three most terrifying auras.
At this moment, the Witch Race soldiers, including that officer, looked at them in bewilderment, questioning their seemingly suicidal actions.
One of the Witch Race soldiers said blankly, "What are these people trying to do?"
"Not too sure, from their direction, looks like they are heading towards those few Shadow Lords."
"Are these people looking to trouble those Lords?"
When this person finished, the Witch Race army collectively drew a breath of cold air.
Even in the midst of a battlefield, more Witch Race soldiers couldn’t help but divert some attention to watch those five people.
Just as they predicted.
These peculiar individuals were actually confronting those three Lord-level creatures directly!
At this moment.
In the three battlefield areas.
Zhang Lianmeng and Su Xiaoyang teamed up, cutting through waves of Shadow Creatures, charging straight towards a towering Shadow Creature.
Level 48 Lord-level Creature: Shadow Crystal Python.
Shen Yun and Cheng Jianyong unleashed a Spear Qi, blasting directly at a gigantic beast, resembling a war tank.
Level 49 Lord Creature: Shadow Violent Bear!
Meanwhile, Han Xing together with Coal Ball, faced off against a Shadow General.
At this moment, these Shadow Lord Monsters also noticed Han Xing and the others, a bloodthirsty intent flickering in their eyes.
The next moment.
With a thunderous roar from the Shadow Violent Bear.
Three Lord Creatures lunged fiercely at them!
Shen Yun raised the Holy Hammer high, the glaring Holy Light dispelling the black mist.
Angel’s Blessing!
Blessing of Honor!
Two states instantly augmented.
Everyone’s attributes suddenly skyrocketed!
At this moment.
All the Witch Race soldiers, as well as the Shadow Creatures, turned to the place where the Holy Light appeared.
Their eyes were filled with confusion.
They seemed unaware of when such formidable presences emerged among the Witch Race.
Then, they witnessed the most shocking scene of their lives.
In three battle areas.
Those presences raised their weapons simultaneously, unleashing their attacks.
’Meteor Technique!’
Boom!
A massive meteor, engulfed in flames, plummeted from the sky, smashing the several tens of meters long Shadow Crystal Python to the ground.
’Long Spear Assault!’
Cheng Jianyong’s Spear Qi erupted, creating a terrifying force, forming a hundred-meter-long ravine in front of him!
The massive body of the Shadow Violent Bear, upon being hit by the Spear Qi, immediately showed a transparent hole through its chest!
Like a severed kite string, the Shadow Violent Bear collapsed heavily.
Compared to the astonishing momentum on the other battlefronts.
Han Xing’s side was unmatched in speed and precision.
When the bowstring was drawn.
The nearby Shadow Creatures felt waves of tearing on their surfaces.
It’s as if countless sharp blades in the air were slicing through their bodies.
In an instant, many Second and Third Transformations Shadow Creatures disintegrated!
The Shadow General sensed the terror of Han Xing’s arrow, the disdain in its eyes vanishing.
The next moment, its figure disappeared from the spot.
It seemed to be attempting to use its speed to get close to Han Xing and strike first.
However, it was fast, but Han Xing was faster!
When the arrow left the bow.
No one even saw its trajectory.
They only noticed the Shadow General’s figure suddenly appear high above.
At this moment.
A transparent hole was also present at its heart.
The Shadow General was severely injured, disbelief and a hint of fear in its eyes, and then it fell straight down.
Plop!
The speed of the arrow was too fast, sound only reached after it struck the target.
One strike!
Three Lord Creatures simultaneously collapsed.
This scene left the Witch Race soldiers utterly astonished.
Knowing that these Lords were not ordinary Fourth-Turned Creatures!
But formidable existences nearing a certain high level at Level 48!
Yet even so, they couldn’t withstand a single move from these individuals!
They were utterly shocked, murmuring to themselves.
"When did our Witch Race produce these mighty figures?"
"Which battalion are they from? Does anyone know?"
The soldiers shook their heads.
They had never seen Han Xing and the others before.
Just then, a bright orb soared past above Han Xing’s head, exploding in front.
He turned back.
Realizing it was support fired from the defense tower of the main city.
However, this turn let many Witch Race soldiers see his face clearly.
One of the Witch Race soldiers exclaimed, "Look, they have no Secret Patterns on their faces!"
"These people, they don’t seem to be from our Witch Race!"

chapters.title: Chapter 343 - 266: Taking Over the Battlefield, Reinforcements from the Heavens
paragraphs: "These few people don’t seem to be from our Witch Race!"
The other soldiers, upon hearing this, were equally taken aback.
"Not from the Witch Race? Then who are they?"
At this moment, a Witch Race soldier suddenly recalled something and exclaimed.
"Hold on! Do you remember a few humans the Saintess brought back a while ago? Could they be these people?"
"Humans?"
A group of Witch Race soldiers were astonished.
At this moment, the Witch Race officer also noticed the identity of Han Xing and others, muttering, "Humans, why are they helping us?"
"Moreover, to heavily wound a Four-star Lord with a single strike—this terrifying strength is far more formidable than even the leader of our Vanguard Corps!"
"Could it be that these people are legendary powerhouses?"
However, he quickly shook his head and said, "No, it’s unlikely they are legendary powerhouses."
"If they were legendary, they could directly annihilate these creatures in a single move!"
But regardless of this.
The officer knew that they were saved!
Han Xing and his team, after crushing those three Lords with a single strike.
In the next moment, those Lords furiously crawled up from the ground, seeming ready to attack once again.
Han Xing glanced at the nearby battlefield.
Defense Tower firepower was pouring out, cannon fire roaring.
In the mist, more shadow creatures continued to emerge.
A large number of Witch Race soldiers were dying in the assault of these shadow creatures.
Han Xing decisively said, "Quick battle!"
Everyone understood his intention upon hearing this.
Han Xing wanted to eliminate these Lords quickly to reduce unnecessary casualties.
The team no longer held back and unleashed their most formidable attacks!
Chain Fireball!
Soaring Hawk Strike!
Multi-Shot!
Each of their attacks could easily tear through the seemingly indestructible defenses of the Shadow Lords.
The shadow bear was knocked down by Cheng Jianyong’s spear and could no longer struggle to rise.
Under the torrential spear attacks, the shadow bear let out a series of roars.
"Roar! Roar!"
It kept swinging its huge bear paws, trying to charge at Cheng Jianyong.
Yet, its resistance was completely futile.
As Shen Yun suppressed it, Cheng Jianyong’s spear continuously inflicted severe wounds.
On the other side, the shadow crystal python kept making painful hisses!
"Hiss! Hiss, hiss, hiss!"
Zhang Lianmeng unleashed large fireballs.
Each fireball, like a missile, brought unimaginable devastation to it.
It had never felt such terrifying damage from a Fourth-Turned Mage.
The relentless firepower from this humanoid weapon drove the shadow crystal python to near desperation.
However, the easiest side was Han Xing’s.
After Coal Ball weakened the shadow general’s defense, each of Han Xing’s arrows became an armor-piercing attack.
Its body, like paper, was pierced by each arrow.
Fifteen seconds later.
The three Shadow Lords were dead, marking the end of the battle.
This scene directly stunned the entire battlefield and tens of thousands of Witch Race soldiers.
At this moment, they were muttering.
"My God... Fourth-turn Lord monsters were taken down so effortlessly by them."
"Such battle power is truly terrifying!"
"Yes, even among main city leader-level figures, we’ve never seen such power."
"Are these people really not legendary powerhouses?"
Beside them, a few Witch Race soldiers remarked.
"Alright, whether or not they are legendary powerhouses, we can see from their actions that they are here to help us."
"If it weren’t for them, those Lord-level creatures might have already broken into our formations and started a massacre."
"Indeed, I’m so grateful to these people for helping us deal with such dangerous opponents!
For a moment, a large number of Witch Race soldiers felt gratitude towards them in their hearts.
Han Xing and his team also received a system prompt.
"Thanks to your righteous assistance, you have gained the recognition of the Witch Race’s 37th Corps, Seventh Special Operations Team, Witch Race friendliness +174..."
Han Xing glanced at the system prompt and no longer paid it any mind.
Instead, he focused on the battlefield ahead.
Although they had already eliminated three Lords...
The shadow mist was still continuously gathering more creatures, attacking the Witch Race’s formations.
Luckily, no new Lord-level creatures emerged.
Observing the shadow mist, Han Xing pondered, "It seems that the number of Lords that can appear in the shadow mist is limited."
"Does this mean that other shadow creatures also have a certain limit in numbers?"
Han Xing believed that his speculation was likely correct.
Otherwise, if the mist could infinitely spawn shadow creatures.
It wouldn’t take long to directly occupy the entire Witch Race Territory.
At this moment.
Han Xing suddenly sensed a powerful aura bursting from the castle.
It was emitted by the Witch Race officer.
He unexpectedly had the strength of a Four-star Lord Level.
At this moment, the officer’s figure suddenly flashed, heading straight for Han Xing and his team.
In the next moment, he appeared right beside Han Xing and solemnly said, "Valiant human warriors! Thank you for your assistance!"
"Ausbu, the leader of the Witch Race’s 37th Corps, extends the highest respect to you!"
The officer apologized to Han Xing and his team with a deep bow.
He showed no air of superiority as an officer.
Despite both being fourth-turn, he knew.
The gap between himself and these humans was enormous!
Moreover, these people were their benefactors.
Han Xing and the others nodded.

chapters.title: Chapter 344 - 266: Taking Over the Battlefield, Reinforcements from the Heavens (Part 2)
paragraphs: It is not convenient to communicate much now while on the battlefield.
Han Xing watched the Witch Race soldiers fighting hard and frowned, asking, "Are you Witch Race running out of people?"
"It’s been so long, and no reinforcements have appeared. If this continues, you definitely won’t hold on, right?"
The officer’s face showed a look of shame, then nodded, "To be honest, the Witch Race’s combat power on this Sky Island is indeed severely lacking."
"The number of shadow monsters is very large and cunning."
"They know how to concentrate their power and attack the most important areas of our Witch Race."
"Currently, the main battlefield of this Sky Island is in Warhawk City, where hundreds of millions of civilians are located."
"Including many Witch Race soldiers, Demon Elephant War Chariots, and Witch Race Battleships, all fighting over there."
"So, there’s really no manpower available to support here."
Han Xing nodded.
"I understand, since your manpower is insufficient."
"We’ll take over this battlefield."
"You lead the Witch Race soldiers to support other areas."
The Witch Race officer was stunned upon hearing this.
He tentatively asked, "Brave Warrior of the Human Race, your suggestion is for us to leave with our troops, while you deal with so many shadow monsters by yourself?"
Han Xing nodded, "Yes."
"Isn’t the situation very critical in Warhawk City? If you go over now, you should be able to alleviate their pressure a little, right?"
The Witch Race officer’s pupils shrank upon hearing this.
"Are you serious?"
He said incredulously, "Based on our understanding of the Shadow Legion."
"Given the level of shadow mist in this area, at least 3 million shadow monsters are expected to arise!"
The Witch Race officer bowed slightly, "It’s not that we don’t believe you."
"But this matter is indeed of great importance!"
"We still have tens of millions of Witch Race civilians in Anmo City."
"The number of monsters is too many, and there are only five benefactors!"
"If problems arise, it will lead to the death of many civilians."
Upon hearing the monster numbers reported by this Witch Race officer, Han Xing’s heart also steadied slightly.
Because this coincided with his own speculation that each area has a limited number of shadow monsters appearing.
Just like in their area, only three to four million shadow monsters could appear at most.
It’s indeed hard for these Witch Race soldiers to resist.
But with Ten Thousand Stars City’s current battle strength, it poses no threat at all.
Han Xing nodded and said, "Got it, it’s just a few million shadow monsters, it doesn’t constitute any threat to us."
Officer named Ausbu froze.
However, what Han Xing said next plunged him into a state of bewilderment.
"Moreover, who told you we only have five people?"
In the dazed eyes of this Witch Race officer.
He saw a confident smile on this human’s face, who then waved with one hand.
This gesture seemed to summon some formidable beings.
Suddenly, sounds of something breaking through the air could be heard from the dark mist!
Like a thousand troops galloping through the sky.
In the next moment.
He then witnessed the most shocking scene of his life.
In the sky, a group of enormous birds over ten meters long, covered in deep blue feathers, with beaks three meters long, appeared magnificently!
The flock of birds filled the skies, numbering at least over two hundred thousand!
Moreover, on each giant bird’s back stood a wolf rider with green skin and a muscular physique!
They looked at the group of shadow monsters with powerful war intent in their eyes.
At this moment, that group of Witch Race soldiers also noticed the scene in the sky, exclaiming in surprise: "Look at the sky!"
"What kind of birds are those? My God, they’re so big, there are so many!"
In the next moment.
Covering the sky, the big-beaked bird legion suddenly swooped down towards the Shadow Legion.
Their target was precisely those shadow monsters with flying capabilities.
The big-beaked birds had an overall level of 45, in terms of quality, even surpassing the Shadow Legion by quite a margin!
Additionally, each big-beaked bird had a wolf rider proficient in riding skill controlling it.
In no time, the Shadow Legion’s monsters were wiped out as if a wild fire was suddenly extinguished by a torrential downpour.
With huge wings flapping, shadow monsters were swept into the air by the terrifying airflow.
More were torn apart on the spot.
Some were pecked by the terrifying bird beak of the big-beaked birds, bitten clean into two halves on the spot!
Even though there were shadow flying dragons and other long-range units in the sky, launching remote attacks on the big-beaked bird flock.
But this group of big-beaked birds, just before the attacks were about to hit, shrunk their wings suddenly to protect their bodies.
The formidable defense directly blocked all attacks, completely unharmed.
Less than a minute after two waves of flying forces started engaging.
At least forty to fifty thousand shadow monsters were immediately killed.
In terms of combat and coordination, the shadow monsters were completely inferior to the big-beaked bird legion.
The Witch Race soldiers, apart from having seen such strong coordination in the Elite Vanguard Corps, this was the first time they had seen some beasts being so agile.
How could their combat be so smooth?
At this moment, Han Xing couldn’t help but sigh.
Wolf riders, no wonder they are a race proficient in riding skill.
The big-beaked birds under their control unleashed combat prowess far beyond their own strength.
Even aerial combat was handled effortlessly.
Moreover, this was just the beginning.
Before these Witch Race soldiers could recover from their shock.
They saw an even more awe-inspiring scene.
In the sky, as if it started to rain, many black dots appeared.
The Witch Race soldiers concentrated their gaze, and suddenly gasped in shock.
"My God! What are those? Creatures with bull heads!?"
"There are so many of them, with green skin, their aura so strong, so terrifying!"
Yes, these black dots were an army consisting of hundreds of thousands of wolf riders and minotaurs.
Upon receiving Han Xing’s summon, they all jumped down from nearly a hundred meters high up in the sky!
Wolf riders and minotaurs descended like divine weapons, striking the ground heavily!
Boom boom boom!
The whole Anmo City shook violently, as if the earth was about to collapse.
On the plains below, cracks over a kilometer long appeared.
In the next moment.
Five hundred thousand wolf riders, along with two hundred thousand minotaurs, had already formed a battle formation.
Their eyes carried a surge of war intent and bloodthirsty madness!
Since the end of the Blood Tide, these minotaurs and wolf riders hadn’t had a chance to fight!
After so many days, their war-minded nature had nearly driven them crazy!
At this moment, upon seeing another battle to fight.
These fervent war enthusiasts’ hearts began boiling with adrenaline!
However, they restrained their inner impulses.
Because, before that man gave the order, they wouldn’t make any outrageous moves.
At this moment, Han Xing directly announced, "Go ahead, time for you to shine!"
Hundreds of thousands of wolf riders and minotaurs, upon hearing this, let out a tsunami-like cheer.
"Kill!"
"Roar!"
The army charged fiercely, directly replacing the Witch Race soldiers’ position.
The shadow monsters, upon clashing with the wolf rider and minotaur army, couldn’t even hold out for a second.
The formation immediately declared its collapse.
At that moment, leading the charge.
Was a squad of a thousand wolf riders.
Underneath them were large, burly wargs.
As the mounts of wolf riders, they shared a natural rapport with their wargs, requiring no slow bonding process.
With the assistance of the wargs, these wolf riders were desperate to showcase their robust combat power to Han Xing.
"Wolf riders! Charge! Charge! Charge!"
A thousand wolf riders raised their silver longswords, like peerless blades, thrust fiercely into the Shadow Legion’s formation.
Slashing sounds!
One after another, shadow monsters were massacred in waves.
Behind, more ground wolf riders maintained formation, advancing steadily and slowly.
Every second, numerous shadow monsters died under their silver swords!

sentences.text: It is not convenient to communicate much now while on the battlefield.
Han Xing watched the Witch Race soldiers fighting hard and frowned, asking, "Are you Witch Race running out of people?"
"It’s been so long, and no reinforcements have appeared.
If this continues, you definitely won’t hold on, right?"
The officer’s face showed a look of shame, then nodded, "To be honest, the Witch Race’s combat power on this Sky Island is indeed severely lacking."
"The number of shadow monsters is very large and cunning."
"They know how to concentrate their power and attack the most important areas of our Witch Race."
"Currently, the main battlefield of this Sky Island is in Warhawk City, where hundreds of millions of civilians are located."
"Including many Witch Race soldiers, Demon Elephant War Chariots, and Witch Race Battleships, all fighting over there."
"So, there’s really no manpower available to support here."
Han Xing nodded.
"I understand, since your manpower is insufficient."
"We’ll take over this battlefield."
"You lead the Witch Race soldiers to support other areas."
The Witch Race officer was stunned upon hearing this.
He tentatively asked, "Brave Warrior of the Human Race, your suggestion is for us to leave with our troops, while you deal with so many shadow monsters by yourself?"
Han Xing nodded, "Yes."
"Isn’t the situation very critical in Warhawk City?
If you go over now, you should be able to alleviate their pressure a little, right?"
The Witch Race officer’s pupils shrank upon hearing this.
"Are you serious?"
He said incredulously, "Based on our understanding of the Shadow Legion."
"Given the level of shadow mist in this area, at least 3 million shadow monsters are expected to arise!"
The Witch Race officer bowed slightly, "It’s not that we don’t believe you."
"But this matter is indeed of great importance!"
"We still have tens of millions of Witch Race civilians in Anmo City."
"The number of monsters is too many, and there are only five benefactors!"
"If problems arise, it will lead to the death of many civilians."
Upon hearing the monster numbers reported by this Witch Race officer, Han Xing’s heart also steadied slightly.
Because this coincided with his own speculation that each area has a limited number of shadow monsters appearing.
Just like in their area, only three to four million shadow monsters could appear at most.
It’s indeed hard for these Witch Race soldiers to resist.
But with Ten Thousand Stars City’s current battle strength, it poses no threat at all.
Han Xing nodded and said, "Got it, it’s just a few million shadow monsters, it doesn’t constitute any threat to us."
Officer named Ausbu froze.
However, what Han Xing said next plunged him into a state of bewilderment.
"Moreover, who told you we only have five people?"
In the dazed eyes of this Witch Race officer.
He saw a confident smile on this human’s face, who then waved with one hand.
This gesture seemed to summon some formidable beings.
Suddenly, sounds of something breaking through the air could be heard from the dark mist!
Like a thousand troops galloping through the sky.
In the next moment.
He then witnessed the most shocking scene of his life.
In the sky, a group of enormous birds over ten meters long, covered in deep blue feathers, with beaks three meters long, appeared magnificently!
The flock of birds filled the skies, numbering at least over two hundred thousand!
Moreover, on each giant bird’s back stood a wolf rider with green skin and a muscular physique!
They looked at the group of shadow monsters with powerful war intent in their eyes.
At this moment, that group of Witch Race soldiers also noticed the scene in the sky, exclaiming in surprise: "Look at the sky!"
"What kind of birds are those?
My God, they’re so big, there are so many!"
In the next moment.
Covering the sky, the big-beaked bird legion suddenly swooped down towards the Shadow Legion.
Their target was precisely those shadow monsters with flying capabilities.
The big-beaked birds had an overall level of 45, in terms of quality, even surpassing the Shadow Legion by quite a margin!
Additionally, each big-beaked bird had a wolf rider proficient in riding skill controlling it.
In no time, the Shadow Legion’s monsters were wiped out as if a wild fire was suddenly extinguished by a torrential downpour.
With huge wings flapping, shadow monsters were swept into the air by the terrifying airflow.
More were torn apart on the spot.
Some were pecked by the terrifying bird beak of the big-beaked birds, bitten clean into two halves on the spot!
Even though there were shadow flying dragons and other long-range units in the sky, launching remote attacks on the big-beaked bird flock.
But this group of big-beaked birds, just before the attacks were about to hit, shrunk their wings suddenly to protect their bodies.
The formidable defense directly blocked all attacks, completely unharmed.
Less than a minute after two waves of flying forces started engaging.
At least forty to fifty thousand shadow monsters were immediately killed.
In terms of combat and coordination, the shadow monsters were completely inferior to the big-beaked bird legion.
The Witch Race soldiers, apart from having seen such strong coordination in the Elite Vanguard Corps, this was the first time they had seen some beasts being so agile.
How could their combat be so smooth?
At this moment, Han Xing couldn’t help but sigh.
Wolf riders, no wonder they are a race proficient in riding skill.
The big-beaked birds under their control unleashed combat prowess far beyond their own strength.
Even aerial combat was handled effortlessly.
Moreover, this was just the beginning.
Before these Witch Race soldiers could recover from their shock.
They saw an even more awe-inspiring scene.
In the sky, as if it started to rain, many black dots appeared.
The Witch Race soldiers concentrated their gaze, and suddenly gasped in shock.
"My God!
What are those?
Creatures with bull heads!?"
"There are so many of them, with green skin, their aura so strong, so terrifying!"
Yes, these black dots were an army consisting of hundreds of thousands of wolf riders and minotaurs.
Upon receiving Han Xing’s summon, they all jumped down from nearly a hundred meters high up in the sky!
Wolf riders and minotaurs descended like divine weapons, striking the ground heavily!
Boom boom boom!
The whole Anmo City shook violently, as if the earth was about to collapse.

chapters.title: Chapter 345 - 267: [Spiritual Godslaying Cannon (Blueprint)]
paragraphs: Under the swing of the silver sword, black blood splattered.
This group of wolf cavalry resembled a squad of knights on an expedition.
Draw swords, sheathe swords, movements were neat and uniform.
It looked quite pleasing to the eye.
Compared to the elegance of the wolf cavalry in battle,
the nearby minotaurs were utterly wild and unrestrained!
Their attack method was singular, swinging giant totems like tree trunks to smash!
Smashed down hard!
Shadow monsters were sent flying by the totems, some even crushed on the spot!
Splatter! Splatter!
Crystals shattered, black liquid splashed like the blood of these shadow creatures.
The Shadow Legion began to collapse relentlessly!
Seeing the shocked expressions of the Witch Race soldiers, Han Xing said, "The Shadow Legion poses no real threat to us anymore. Lead your soldiers and go support the other battlefields."
At this moment, the Witch Race officer seemed to finally come to his senses.
He hurriedly replied, "Yes... Yes!"
At this moment, his gaze toward Han Xing was filled with respect, along with a trace of fear!
This human’s means were too powerful, too miraculous.
Just how did he manage to have hundreds of thousands of ferocious wolf cavalry and minotaurs obey his commands?
Despite his curiosity, he knew what was more important right now.
He once again cupped his hands respectfully to Han Xing and the others.
Then he approached the Witch Race soldiers and shouted loudly, "All Witch Race soldiers, heed the order. This battlefield has been taken over by these Human Race warriors!"
"Everyone, now follow me to support the other battlefields!"
"At once!"
The Witch Race soldiers, upon receiving the command, quickly snapped out of their confusion and began to move with their officer.
The grand withdrawal of the Witch Race soldiers commenced.
Leaving only a small part of the force to protect Anmo City.
Millions of civilians were settled in underground shelters, unaware of what was happening above.
Han Xing and the others were also observing the battlefield of the wolf cavalry.
As the wolf cavalry and minotaurs began to unleash their power,
the shadow monsters on the plain started to decrease significantly.
The mist in the vicinity, too, was visibly thinning.
Han Xing mused, "It seems these shadow fangs are indeed born from the mist."
"However, their numbers should be limited, and with the slaughter by the wolf cavalry army, the rate of monster emergence can’t keep up."
Han Xing felt a surge of confidence.
Previously, in their minds, the Shadow Legion was mysterious and powerful.
It even forced the mighty Witch Race to retract and consolidate their power just to defend against the Shadow Legion’s invasion.
However, the victory in this battle brought Han Xing some confidence.
The Shadow Legion wasn’t invincible.
Though Han Xing knew as well.
The shadow legion’s strength they encountered was merely the tip of the iceberg, hardly significant.
But winning the first battle hugely boosted his confidence.
At this moment.
Ahead on the battlefield, a large number of monsters were being cleared out.
At the same time, there were also some casualties among the wolf cavalry and minotaurs.
The number was roughly ten to twenty thousand.
Han Xing didn’t feel distressed.
After all, in such large-scale warfare, casualties were inevitable.
Han Xing invested countless resources and recruited a massive number of wolf cavalry and minotaurs for this very moment.
Moreover, these troops would view dying in battle as a glory.
Thus, they felt no fear over their companions’ deaths; on the contrary, they were even more fired up!
"Wolf cavalry, form up and let these crude minotaurs see what knightly demeanor is!"
"Roar! Minotaurs, let those self-important werewolves know what a true powerhouse is!
Both units began a silent contest, growing increasingly fierce.
As their attacks became more ferocious, more shadow fangs were slain.
The battlefield gradually became more vacant.
On the ground, many black crystals appeared, seemingly dropped from those monsters.
Initially, Han Xing hadn’t noticed.
But when he saw the growing number of black crystals on the ground, he had some doubts.
"Hmm? What are these crystals?"
Han Xing walked over, picked up a crystal casually, and saw the prompt on it.

[Shadow Crystal]: After the death of shadow monsters of the third transformation and above, there is a chance they drop these crystals, which can be used to craft Shadow Rune Series or exchanged for rewards at the Battle Merit Store upon collecting a certain quantity.
"Shadow Crystal? Shadow Rune Series?" Han Xing was puzzled.
This stuff sounded like a type of material, similar to Rune Crystals.
Only it could be used to make blueprints of a specific series.
And Han Xing had no blueprint of the Shadow Rune Series in hand.
So it was temporarily useless.
However, there was an additional note on the system.
That you could go to the Battle Merit Store to exchange for rewards.
Han Xing was taken aback.
"Battle Merit Store? Wasn’t it already ended?"
"I remember there wasn’t anything requiring a shadow crystal for an exchange up there?"
Han Xing found it strange.
At this moment, a system prompt appeared.
"The Shadow Legion and Witch Race, two great factions, have long been adversaries; you are now involved in the war between these two factions."
"Triggered faction task: Choice."
"Choose to join either the Shadow Legion faction or the Witch Race faction."
Han Xing exclaimed in surprise, "Faction choice?"
Yet, before he could ponder it further, a system prompt appeared.
"Based on the behavior of you and your squad, your faction has been automatically set to: Witch Race."

chapters.title: Chapter 346 - 267: [Spiritual Godslaying Cannon (Blueprint)]_2
paragraphs: "Witch Race Affinity +1000, current affinity: 1963 (Comrade)."
"Shadow Legion Affinity -1000, current affinity: -1000 (Hostile)"
"Witch Race Faction Exclusive Advanced Battle Merit Store is open, collect Shadow Crystals to exchange for high-level rewards!"
At this moment, Han Xing’s eyes revealed a look of realization.
So, Shadow Crystals are used here.
Advanced Battle Merit Store!
It wasn’t just Han Xing; at this moment, Cheng Jianyong and others also heard the system notification.
"Wow! Advanced Battle Merit Store, and it’s Witch Race exclusive?" Cheng Jianyong said in surprise.
"What’s inside?"
Han Xing spread his hands and said, "Just open it and see."
At this time, their system interface added an option for the Witch Race Advanced Shop.
Opening it, a dazzling array of goods immediately appeared.
First, there were five types of treasure chests.
Bronze, Silver, Gold, Bright Moon, Sun.
The first three types of chests, just like the previous Battle Merit Store, are unlimited in exchange.
The required Shadow Crystals are 100, 1000, and 10000 respectively.
Both the Bright Moon Chest and the Sun Chest have limited exchanges, as before.
The limits are 5 and 1 respectively.
The required Shadow Crystals remain unchanged at one million and one hundred million respectively.
Han Xing pondered, "Although it seems unchanged, the difficulty in obtaining items from this Battle Merit Store is much higher than last time."
"You must kill Third Transformation or higher-level monsters to have a chance of obtaining Shadow Crystals."
"And it’s not guaranteed."
"However, unlike the last Battle Merit Store, this time Shadow Crystals can be traded."
"In other words, I can collect Shadow Crystals from others to exchange for rewards at the Battle Merit Store."
Han Xing sighed at this time, "What a pity, if other Human Race survivors were here, it would be great."
"With their abilities, they could definitely help me collect a vast amount of Shadow Crystals."
"Then, with a little maneuvering, I could get all their Shadow Crystals into my hands."
Han Xing thought delightedly.
However, he could only think about it.
At the current stage, except for himself, those survivors can’t even set foot in the Land of the Abandoned Gods.
Even the Path of the Giant Dragon alone is enough to stop ninety-nine percent of the survivors.
Han Xing suddenly thought of something, "No, maybe it’s possible."
"As long as I can build a High-Level Array, I can let other Human Races directly teleport into Witch Race Territory, skipping the Path of the Giant Dragon!"
Of course, this requires Han Xing to find materials like Void Soul Stone first.
So, Han Xing’s idea can only be shelved for now.
At this time, Han Xing opened the Battle Merit Store to continue browsing.
Besides the five types of chests, there are also several blueprints in the store.
Namely: [Shadow Wizard Rune Blueprint (Golden)]: Spirit increases by 40~50 points.
[Shadow Frenzy Rune Blueprint (Golden)]: Power increases by 42~52 points.
[Shadow Speed Rune Blueprint (Golden)]: Agility increases by 40~50 points.
[Shadow Tower Rune Blueprint (Golden)]: Constitution increases by 42~52 points.
These four runes are golden runes comparable to the Destruction Rune!
However, compared to the dual attribute bonus of the Destruction Rune, the attributes added by the Shadow series runes are purer and stronger.
For survivors pursuing extreme output or extreme defense, it is a good choice.
But the number of Shadow Crystals required for these four rune blueprints is also astonishing.
Each requires 10 million Shadow Crystals, equivalent to 1 billion Battle Merits during the Blood Tide Period!
Besides the four blueprints, there are some brilliant crystal stones on top.
[Shadow Divine Stone]: Requires 10,000 Shadow Crystals for exchange.
Han Xing’s expression shifted slightly; 10,000 Shadow Crystals for one Shadow Divine Stone.
That’s quite worthwhile.
Moreover, the crucial point is that the Shadow Divine Stone in this store is not limited in quantity.
In other words, as long as enough Shadow Fangs are killed, Han Xing won’t have to worry about this High-Level Material!
The rewards appearing in the Battle Merit Store are already quite generous.
However, Han Xing noticed there was another reward at the bottom.
It was a blueprint.
As the store’s finale item, Han Xing looked at it with an expected expression.
But when he saw the blueprint’s attributes, his pupils suddenly constricted.
[High-tier Ancient Weapon Blueprint: Spiritual Godslaying Cannon]: Only 1 in the entire store.
Exchange required: 10 billion Shadow Crystals.
Note: This blueprint is a unique item, only one can be exchanged in the entire server.
At this moment.
The shock in Han Xing’s eyes could no longer be concealed.
Even Cheng Jianyong beside him and others also saw the reward in the Battle Merit Store.
"Damn! High-tier Ancient Weapon, what is a Spiritual Godslaying Cannon?"
"This name is too arrogant, isn’t it? Directly slaying gods!"
"Could this Godslaying Cannon really harm divine spirits?"
Everyone was also as shocked by the name and terrifying price of this high-tier ancient weapon blueprint as Cheng Jianyong.
Han Xing pondered, "I guess it’s not that exaggerated."
"We encountered the God of Light before, and that guy said he was just a trace of divine sense descending.
"But he felt more terrifying than those Giant Dragons."
"The true power of divine spirits should far surpass our imagination."
"However, it should be capable of dealing with demigod level creatures."
Upon hearing this, everyone’s pupils contracted.
So far, they haven’t encountered any true demigod level creatures yet.
If this high-tier ancient weapon really could harm demigod level creatures.
Then dealing with Legendary Level beings would be no problem at all.
At that time, if this blueprint is exchanged.
Creating several Godslaying Cannons would mean they could blast a whole slew of Legendary Level beings in one shot!
At this moment, Han Xing felt a strong desire for this high-tier ancient weapon blueprint!
Of course, the exaggerated 10 billion Shadow Crystals still made everyone feel it was hopeless.
Even for Han Xing, he wasn’t confident he could collect that many crystals.
Han Xing said, "Alright, since we have chosen a faction, we must strive to gain more benefits in this war."
"You’ve seen this advanced Battle Merit Store; the rewards are quite exaggerated."
"Each person is limited to purchasing five Bright Moon Chests and 1 Sun Chest."
"And Shadow Crystals can be traded."
"This means we can at least exchange for all those limited chests."
"Calculating it, that’s at least 25 Bright Moon Chests and 5 Sun Chests!"
Upon hearing Han Xing say this, everyone immediately understood the importance of this Battle Merit Store.
With the current firepower of Ten Thousand Stars City, they could slay many Shadow Monsters, obtaining a large amount of Shadow Crystals in the process.
Exchanging all these limited chests would be more than sufficient.
Bright Moon Chests would amount to at least a dozen pieces of Orange Equipment.
And there’s a chance of obtaining even more from the Sun Chest, which can yield Divine Artifact Level equipment.
If luck is on their side, they might even get two or three pieces of Divine Artifact Equipment!
Although the Red Equipment from the Sun Chest is somewhat weaker in attributes compared to certain special Divine Armors, such as the ’Oracle Throne’ and the ’Mask of the Golden Goddess,’
it’s still much stronger than ordinary Orange Armor.
Thinking of this made everyone excited!
At this moment, Cheng Jianyong excitedly said, "I must say, listening to Brother Xing, the rewards in the Battle Merit Store are indeed a bit outrageous."
"Even if we can’t exchange for that high-tier ancient weapon blueprint, getting other things can also greatly enhance our strength."
"I’m already eager to slay more Shadow Monsters!"
Cheng Jianyong clenched his fist, "Let’s grab battle merits and crush the Shadow Legion!"
"Brothers, let’s charge!"
Han Xing quickly pulled him back and said, "First, pick up the Shadow Crystals on the ground before you leave."
At this time, everyone also saw the floor full of crystals and their eyes lit up instantly.
With so many Shadow Crystals, they could probably exchange for quite a few rewards in the Battle Merit Store, right?

Namely: [Shadow Wizard Rune Blueprint (Golden)]: Spirit increases by 40~50 points.
[Shadow Frenzy Rune Blueprint (Golden)]: Power increases by 42~52 points.
[Shadow Speed Rune Blueprint (Golden)]: Agility increases by 40~50 points.
[Shadow Tower Rune Blueprint (Golden)]: Constitution increases by 42~52 points.
These four runes are golden runes comparable to the Destruction Rune!
However, compared to the dual attribute bonus of the Destruction Rune, the attributes added by the Shadow series runes are purer and stronger.
For survivors pursuing extreme output or extreme defense, it is a good choice.
But the number of Shadow Crystals required for these four rune blueprints is also astonishing.
Each requires 10 million Shadow Crystals, equivalent to 1 billion Battle Merits during the Blood Tide Period!
Besides the four blueprints, there are some brilliant crystal stones on top.
[Shadow Divine Stone]: Requires 10,000 Shadow Crystals for exchange.
Han Xing’s expression shifted slightly; 10,000 Shadow Crystals for one Shadow Divine Stone.
That’s quite worthwhile.
Moreover, the crucial point is that the Shadow Divine Stone in this store is not limited in quantity.
In other words, as long as enough Shadow Fangs are killed, Han Xing won’t have to worry about this High-Level Material!
The rewards appearing in the Battle Merit Store are already quite generous.
However, Han Xing noticed there was another reward at the bottom.
It was a blueprint.
As the store’s finale item, Han Xing looked at it with an expected expression.
But when he saw the blueprint’s attributes, his pupils suddenly constricted.
[High-tier Ancient Weapon Blueprint: Spiritual Godslaying Cannon]: Only 1 in the entire store.
Exchange required: 10 billion Shadow Crystals.
Note: This blueprint is a unique item, only one can be exchanged in the entire server.
At this moment.
The shock in Han Xing’s eyes could no longer be concealed.
Even Cheng Jianyong beside him and others also saw the reward in the Battle Merit Store.
"Damn!
High-tier Ancient Weapon, what is a Spiritual Godslaying Cannon?"
"This name is too arrogant, isn’t it?
Directly slaying gods!"
"Could this Godslaying Cannon really harm divine spirits?"
Everyone was also as shocked by the name and terrifying price of this high-tier ancient weapon blueprint as Cheng Jianyong.
Han Xing pondered, "I guess it’s not that exaggerated."
"We encountered the God of Light before, and that guy said he was just a trace of divine sense descending.
"But he felt more terrifying than those Giant Dragons."
"The true power of divine spirits should far surpass our imagination."
"However, it should be capable of dealing with demigod level creatures."
Upon hearing this, everyone’s pupils contracted.
So far, they haven’t encountered any true demigod level creatures yet.
If this high-tier ancient weapon really could harm demigod level creatures.
Then dealing with Legendary Level beings would be no problem at all.
At that time, if this blueprint is exchanged.
Creating several Godslaying Cannons would mean they could blast a whole slew of Legendary Level beings in one shot!
At this moment, Han Xing felt a strong desire for this high-tier ancient weapon blueprint!
Of course, the exaggerated 10 billion Shadow Crystals still made everyone feel it was hopeless.
Even for Han Xing, he wasn’t confident he could collect that many crystals.
Han Xing said, "Alright, since we have chosen a faction, we must strive to gain more benefits in this war."
"You’ve seen this advanced Battle Merit Store; the rewards are quite exaggerated."
"Each person is limited to purchasing five Bright Moon Chests and 1 Sun Chest."
"And Shadow Crystals can be traded."
"This means we can at least exchange for all those limited chests."
"Calculating it, that’s at least 25 Bright Moon Chests and 5 Sun Chests!"
Upon hearing Han Xing say this, everyone immediately understood the importance of this Battle Merit Store.
With the current firepower of Ten Thousand Stars City, they could slay many Shadow Monsters, obtaining a large amount of Shadow Crystals in the process.
Exchanging all these limited chests would be more than sufficient.
Bright Moon Chests would amount to at least a dozen pieces of Orange Equipment.
And there’s a chance of obtaining even more from the Sun Chest, which can yield Divine Artifact Level equipment.
If luck is on their side, they might even get two or three pieces of Divine Artifact Equipment!
Although the Red Equipment from the Sun Chest is somewhat weaker in attributes compared to certain special Divine Armors, such as the ’Oracle Throne’ and the ’Mask of the Golden Goddess,’
it’s still much stronger than ordinary Orange Armor.
Thinking of this made everyone excited!
At this moment, Cheng Jianyong excitedly said, "I must say, listening to Brother Xing, the rewards in the Battle Merit Store are indeed a bit outrageous."
"Even if we can’t exchange for that high-tier ancient weapon blueprint, getting other things can also greatly enhance our strength."
"I’m already eager to slay more Shadow Monsters!"
Cheng Jianyong clenched his fist, "Let’s grab battle merits and crush the Shadow Legion!"
"Brothers, let’s charge!"
Han Xing quickly pulled him back and said, "First, pick up the Shadow Crystals on the ground before you leave."
At this time, everyone also saw the floor full of crystals and their eyes lit up instantly.
With so many Shadow Crystals, they could probably exchange for quite a few rewards in the Battle Merit Store, right?

chapters.title: Chapter 347 - 268: Crisis and Reinforcements
paragraphs: This time, the way of acquiring battle merit.
Unlike the Blood Tide Monsters previously slain, which directly granted battle merit.
Now, it’s a type of material that needs to be collected by everyone.
Cleaning up such a large-scale battlefield is indeed a bit troublesome.
However, Han Xing doesn’t need to worry about this problem.
He directly ordered the Wolf Cavalry and Minotaurs to start clearing the battlefield.
Tens of thousands of troops mobilized, and the efficiency was extremely fast.
Within a little over two minutes, all the Shadow Crystals on the ground were collected.
A total of 270,000 Shadow Crystals were harvested.
Han Xing roughly calculated.
The Wolf Cavalry and Minotaurs just slaughtered at least three million Shadow Monsters.
But only such a few crystals dropped, the drop rate is indeed a bit low.
Approximately a one-tenth probability, maybe even lower.
But it’s still within Han Xing’s acceptable range.
What surprised Han Xing a bit was.
Besides the 270,000 Shadow Crystals, there were some unexpected gains.
That is, three pieces of Shadow Divine Stone.
This quantity just corresponds to the three Lords they eliminated.
Han Xing thought, "Interesting, a Fourth-turn Lord can drop a Shadow Divine Stone."
"In the Battle Merit Store, it takes ten thousand crystals to exchange for a Divine Stone, this is quite a significant harvest."
Han Xing contentedly put these three stones into his backpack.
At this time, he looked up at the sky again.
As the Shadow Monsters here were killed off, the mist overhead gradually dissipated.
Shen Yun beside him asked, "Brother Xing, where to next?"
Han Xing also showed a pondering look.
Due to the Witch Race Sky Island being extremely vast.
There are many cities like Anmo City.
They are all resisting the attacks from the Shadow Army, it’s safe to say that war is raging everywhere.
The current approach is to first go to those small cities to clear the Shadow Army, accumulating Shadow Crystals, which is the most prudent method.
However, the Witch Race officer said.
The largest population city on the Sky Island is in the very center.
Called Warhawk City, about a hundred kilometers away from them.
There are countless Shadow Monsters besieging Warhawk City, and it’s the largest battlefield on the entire Sky Island.
The larger the battlefield, the greater the number of Shadow Monsters, the more Shadow Crystals can be collected.
Similarly, the risk increases.
But in the previous battle, Ten Thousand Stars City didn’t even unleash its full strength.
Not even a tenth of its combat power was displayed.
According to Han Xing’s estimation.
Ten Thousand Stars City dealing with a Shadow Legion of ten million is not an issue at all.
So, Han Xing immediately decided, "Let’s go to Warhawk City!"
Everyone was first surprised for a moment, but then expressions of joy appeared on their faces.
Having been through the baptism of the Blood Tide, they did not feel afraid.
And they know, Han Xing won’t fight battles he isn’t confident in.
So, everyone also greatly supported Han Xing’s decision.
However, at present, there’s a problem in front of them.
Warhawk City is over a hundred kilometers away from them, to charge through all the way would take at least five to six minutes.
Moreover, on the way, they will encounter other Shadow Legions’ obstructions, which will take even more time.
Thus, Han Xing directly ordered, "Wolf Cavalry, Minotaurs, all return to Ten Thousand Stars City."
"Next, there will be more dangerous and stronger enemies awaiting you."
"Hope you can continue to persevere!"
Ahead, having just fought a hearty battle, the Wolf Cavalry and Minotaurs were all excited.
Hearing Han Xing mention an even more dangerous battlefield, instead of feeling afraid, they became even more thrilled!
They raised their arms and shouted.
"Following the Lord’s command!"
Ten Thousand Stars City began swiftly traversing the Shadow Mist.
Along the way, many flying monsters tried to intercept.
However, before those creatures came close.
Amidst the dark mist, bursts of electric light suddenly erupted.
Sizzle... Sizzle...
The terrifying firepower of the Thunderbolt Tower began to be unleashed.
Buzz!
The entire Mist Space was instantly illuminated.
Countless flying monsters were electrocuted into charred corpses.
Although the two thousand points of thunder attribute damage from the Thunderbolt Tower can no longer cause severe harm to Four-star creatures.
But, you can’t resist the sheer numbers.
If one Thunderbolt Tower isn’t enough, I’ll use ten, a hundred, even a thousand!
No matter if they’re Three-star or Four-star monsters, in a wave, they’re all instantly killed.
Taking one minute.
The massive Ten Thousand Stars City charged through a hundred kilometers, arriving directly at the center of this Witch Race Sky Island.
Looking at the dense mist below, and hearing the faint, towering cries and shouts!
Everyone knew, the battle below must be very intense.
Indeed, this was the case.
As Ten Thousand Stars City gradually approached.
They saw a huge city surrounded by high walls.
At the top of the city, there’s a pale blue Defense Shield propped up, strenuously blocking those flying creatures.
Currently, this city is being besieged by countless Shadow Creatures.
The situation is very bleak.
The formation of the millions of Witch Race Soldiers has been pressed to the bottom of the city wall, and if they retreat further, they would have to retreat into the city.
Given the Defense Value of this wall, it would almost instantly be destroyed by the Shadow Army.
Once the Shadow Army enters the city, it would be a one-sided massacre!
In this giant city, billions of civilians would be brutally killed under the Shadow Legion’s claws.
Currently, the Witch Race army is fiercely attempting to break out, trying to disrupt this stalemate!
"Charge with me! We must tear open a gap in the Shadow Legion’s formation to create opportunities for the brothers behind!"

chapters.title: Chapter 348 - 268: Crisis and Reinforcements
paragraphs: "Support! I need firepower support here!"
The defense towers in the city started to unleash a frenzy of firepower.
Rumble!
The area in front of the Witch Race soldiers was instantly cleared.
Before the shadow monsters could surge forward, a squad of Witch Race soldiers struggled to rush through.
However, they were pushed back in less than ten seconds.
In the original place, many Witch Race corpses were left behind.
At this moment, the group of Witch Race soldiers said angrily.
"Damn! How come there are so many elites and leaders hidden in there?"
"Our special task force isn’t strong enough to break through at all?"
"How are the brothers up there doing, is there any chance with the Demon Elephant War Chariots?"
Everyone listened and simultaneously looked into the sky.
Several Witch Race warriors were operating four menacing-looking Demon Elephant War Chariots, charging back and forth among the Shadow Legion!
However, despite the formidable power of these Demon Elephant War Chariots, causing extremely serious damage to the Shadow Legion with every attack,
the number of monsters was too many, too dense.
The Demon Elephant War Chariots launched a ’Flaming Strike’, just cleared an empty zone.
Before charging further, four Lord-level creatures rushed towards them.
Rumble!
These Lord creatures were unimaginably large, their advance caused an earth-shattering momentum!
Although the destructive power and defense of the Demon Elephant War Chariots could rival a Four-star Lord,
in a real fight, they definitely could not compare to a genuine Lord.
At least two Demon Elephant War Chariots were needed to match one Lord evenly.
Facing the raid of the Lord-level monsters, these Demon Elephant War Chariots felt the pressure surge rapidly.
At this time, inside one of the chariots, a rough-looking Witch Race warrior gritted his teeth.
"Get me a few more Demon Elephant War Chariots, I’ll lead my men to break out!"
"If we don’t break the deadlock now, we’ll have even less chance next time!"
Beside him, an operator inside another Demon Elephant War Chariot quickly said:
"No way, there are only ten Demon Elephant War Chariots in all of Warhawk City right now."
"The other Demon Elephant War Chariots are in the air, intercepting the shadow monsters trying to land here, they can’t support you!"
The warrior, upon hearing this, was instantly infuriated, "Then what about the Witch Pattern Battleships? Give me three! I’ll risk my life to tear a gap in the Shadow Legion’s formation!"
However, that person still denied: "It’s impossible, all the Witch Pattern Battleships are heading towards the west gate battlefield for support."
"There’s just too many monsters, they’ve completely surrounded Warhawk City, even in the air their figures are invading."
The Witch Race warrior felt even more frustrated.
"Damn! What’s going on now? No reinforcements, no backup plan!
"At this rate, Warhawk City will be overrun sooner or later!"
"I’d rather perish alongside these Lords now!"
The warrior again advised: "Gould! Don’t act impulsively!"
"Even if you charge out now, there are so many Lords outside!"
"Our current task is to desperately maintain the eastern gate battlefield, absolutely not letting the shadow monsters through!"
At this moment, above Warhawk City.
A massive Witch Pattern Battleship, protected by the defense shield, was pouring firepower onto the airborne monsters.
One by one, the shadow monsters were blasted into fragments, black crystals falling on the defense shield like black raindrops.
At this moment, a powerful Witch Race figure clad in Golden Battle Armor, with two Double-Bladed Axes on his back, was solemnly watching below.
From this position, he could survey the battlefield areas of Warhawk City’s four gates.
He could see that the current situation on the battlefield was very grim.
Beside him, a petite Witch Race female assassin, with a serious expression, holding two black daggers, asked.
"Commander Gus, has the main city replied to you?"
"We are within the Saintess’s jurisdiction, can she send forces to support us now?"
The powerful figure named Commander Gus shook his head, "No."
"This Shadow Legion invasion is far larger than before."
"Nearly seventy percent of the Witch Race Sky Islands are shrouded in the war fog of the Shadow Legion."
"Those Witch Race main cities are even their key areas of focus, the situation with the Saintess might be even more dangerous than ours."
"When I just sent a distress message to the Saintess, she hasn’t replied until now..."
Saying this, Gus stopped speaking.
However, upon hearing this, the female assassin’s heart skipped a beat.
As a subordinate legion of the Saintess, they all knew that given the Saintess’s personality, she wouldn’t ignore a subordinate’s distress message.
So now, it only meant one thing.
The Saintess might have encountered unimaginable peril.
Combined with her strength, it might have even erupted into a Legendary Battle!
At this moment, within the ship’s cabin, other Witch Race soldiers who heard the two talking suddenly had drastic changes in their expressions.
Gus sighed and said: "This time, the Shadow Legion is ferociously aiming to take over our Witch Race territory in one fell swoop."
"Now, we can only do our utmost to protect ourselves."
"We only need to endure the most dangerous early stages, waiting until soldiers from other cities finish their battles to reinforce Warhawk City."
However, everyone also knew that these were just words of comfort from Gus.
Even Warhawk City, with the strongest firepower and most powerful fighters, was on the brink, let alone other cities.
In this short half hour, Gus received thousands of distress messages.
All sent from other cities.
So, don’t even think about relying on them for rescue, it’s good enough if they aren’t taken down by the Shadow Legion.
And just then, Gus suddenly received a message.
Originally thinking it’s just another distress message from a main city, Gus wasn’t even planning to check it.
However, as the highest authority on this Sky Island and commander of the Seventh Legion,
Gus still had basic occupational discipline.
He casually picked up the Communication Jade, with a solemn expression, scanning the information on it.
Then, suddenly, a burst of radiant brilliance exploded on Gus’s stern face!
His body even started to tremble uncontrollably.
Beside him, the petite Witch Race female assassin asked, "Commander Gus, what happened?"
Gus’s eyes widened, glancing at the female assassin.
"Reinforcements have arrived!"
Upon hearing this, the female assassin’s body suddenly stiffened!
At this moment, she also understood why Gus was so excited.
At this critical moment, the news of reinforcements, regardless of their strength.
Was tantamount to administering a dose of strong encouragement to the desperate soldiers.
Gus also wanted to inform the other Witch Race warriors of this news as soon as possible.
So, he directly activated the citywide broadcast.
Above Warhawk City, Gus’s voice resonated.
"All Witch Race warriors, I have received good news."
"Warriors from other cities have already dealt with the Shadow Legion, a large force is now en route to Warhawk City!"
Upon hearing this, the Witch Race soldiers’ shock surpassed even Gus’s.
But, they’re not fools either.
They knew the current situation was still very grim.
"Reinforcements, where do they come from at this moment?"
Also aware of the soldiers’ questions, Gus explained: "It’s from Anmo City, they’ve concluded their battle."
"Commander Ausbu is leading the army to support Warhawk City, everyone must hold on!"
"We are not fighting alone! As long as we persevere, we can surely defeat these Dark Shadow minions."
"For the Witch God, for the Lord Saint Master!"
Hearing Gus’s resolute words, they knew this news was likely true!
The eyes of the Witch Race soldiers, once filled with despair, once again burst with dazzling light!
However, Witch Race leaders familiar with Anmo City questioned in confusion.
"Is it really Ausbu? I remember, wasn’t his strength not that remarkable?"
"Yes, Anmo City’s defenses are indeed weaker compared to other populous cities, lacking even a single ancient weapon."
"Only Ausbu himself is quite powerful, with Four-star Lord Level strength."
"It’s surprising that he’s been able to end the fight early over there, exceeding my expectations."

Was tantamount to administering a dose of strong encouragement to the desperate soldiers.
Gus also wanted to inform the other Witch Race warriors of this news as soon as possible.
So, he directly activated the citywide broadcast.
Above Warhawk City, Gus’s voice resonated.
"All Witch Race warriors, I have received good news."
"Warriors from other cities have already dealt with the Shadow Legion, a large force is now en route to Warhawk City!"
Upon hearing this, the Witch Race soldiers’ shock surpassed even Gus’s.
But, they’re not fools either.
They knew the current situation was still very grim.
"Reinforcements, where do they come from at this moment?"
Also aware of the soldiers’ questions, Gus explained: "It’s from Anmo City, they’ve concluded their battle."
"Commander Ausbu is leading the army to support Warhawk City, everyone must hold on!"
"We are not fighting alone!
As long as we persevere, we can surely defeat these Dark Shadow minions."
"For the Witch God, for the Lord Saint Master!"
Hearing Gus’s resolute words, they knew this news was likely true!
The eyes of the Witch Race soldiers, once filled with despair, once again burst with dazzling light!
However, Witch Race leaders familiar with Anmo City questioned in confusion.
"Is it really Ausbu?
I remember, wasn’t his strength not that remarkable?"
"Yes, Anmo City’s defenses are indeed weaker compared to other populous cities, lacking even a single ancient weapon."
"Only Ausbu himself is quite powerful, with Four-star Lord Level strength."
"It’s surprising that he’s been able to end the fight early over there, exceeding my expectations."

chapters.title: Chapter 349 - 269: Firepower Overwhelms, Bombarding the Shadow Lord
paragraphs: Not only these officers, but Han Xing and others were also quite surprised.
They were surprised because the movement over there was too slow.
Cheng Jianyong said on the side: "Wow, is this Ausbu’s efficiency so slow?"
"We’ve finished a battle, and he’s only just arrived."
Less than twenty minutes have passed since Ausbu led his army away.
Han Xing and the others not only resolved the battle but also arrived at Warhawk City ahead of them.
Indeed, they were much faster.
Han Xing’s Ten Thousand Stars City was hidden in the mist, observing the battlefield below.
This place is almost the same as Ausbu described.
The Shadow Legion besieging Warhawk City is at least ten times the scale of Anmo City!
Over tens of millions of Shadow Fangs launched attacks from four directions: southeast, northwest, and above, which makes five battlefields.
The greater number of Shadow Monsters represents the presence of more powerful creatures within.
They quickly scanned briefly.
They saw no less than ten Lord-level Monsters!
Cheng Jianyong said: "Brother Xing, are we now going to take out those Lord Monsters first?"
The last battle strategy was indeed pretty good.
Firstly, they and several high-level forces take out the Lords inside, then have the Wolf Cavalry and Minotaurs take over the battlefield.
This not only reduces casualties but also significantly increases battle efficiency.
However, looking at the shadow legion below swarming like tides.
Han Xing shook his head: "We won’t act yet."
"Currently, those Witch Race Soldiers are being suppressed, and the outside is full of Shadow Monsters."
"This actually offers me a good output space."
"Therefore, we can first bombard with the Hellfire Missile Silos and Demon Elephant War Chariots!"
Everyone’s eyes lit up.
Yes, the strongest on Ten Thousand Stars City is not that group of Wolf Cavalry and Minotaurs.
The strongest means are the tens of thousands of Advanced Defense Towers and hundreds of Hellfire Missile Silos that Han Xing created with countless resources!
After many days, they can finally see the sight of Hellfire in action again!
Thinking about this, everyone’s hearts began to stir!
On Han Xing’s side, he also aimed at the battlefield at the East Gate, just wanting to launch.
He suddenly saw, at the edge of the battlefield, a Witch Race army appeared.
They held their longswords high, with blood marks on their faces and bodies.
Looking at this appearance, they seem to have just experienced a battle.
Han Xing fixed his eyes and saw that it was indeed the Witch Race Legion led by Ausbu.
At that moment, not only did Han Xing and the others notice Ausbu’s presence.
Within Warhawk City, Commander Gus also saw that army emerging from afar.
His face showed an intense surprise, shouting loudly.
"Witch Race warriors! Officer Ausbu has arrived with the army, we are saved!"
The other soldiers were inspired, fighting even more desperately!
Ausbu was communicating with Gus.
Watching the East Gate battlefield, a shadow army numbering millions, covering the sky and earth, he also felt a pressure on his heart.
Ausbu asked: "Commander Gus, all Witch Race warriors from Anmo City are ready to impact the Shadow Legion’s front line."
"Please seize the opportunity to break the enemy’s encirclement!"
Gus immediately replied: "Commander Gus has received!"
"Leader Ausbu, all soldiers and Witch Race soldiers in Warhawk City, thank you for your rescue and support!"
The next moment, Gus’s tone changed suddenly.
He ordered those Witch Race officers in Warhawk City.
"Suspend the fire support in the northwest and south gate battlefields, and begin bombing the east gate battlefield fully."
"Move two more Demon Elephant War Chariots over, be sure to support General Ausbu!"
"Before that, all battlefield leaders must hold on!"
The group of officers immediately showed stern expressions!
Meanwhile, a large-scale fire bombardment hit the east gate battlefield.
Four Demon Elephant War Chariots, plus two newly deployed, making a total of six Demon Elephant War Chariots.
They charged with high morale, all rushing towards the east gate battlefield.
Watching the Witch Race army concentrating its forces on impacting the east gate battlefield.
At this time, Han Xing frowned in the air.
Because this somewhat disturbed his plan.
So, Han Xing directly pulled out the communication token from his backpack, sending a message to Ausbu.
"General Ausbu, speak to the soldiers of Warhawk City and tell them not to come out for now."
After receiving the short message, Ausbu’s eyes were a bit dazed, "Dear Human Race friends, what do you mean?"
Han Xing’s side said: "I have arrived at Warhawk City, next will implement fire strike on the east gate battlefield."
"To avoid accidental injuries, please lead your team and withdraw immediately."
After hearing, Ausbu was extremely surprised.
Already arrived at Warhawk City?
Could it be that the battle on Anmo City side is already over?
Isn’t that way too fast?
He asked puzzledly: "Benefactors, where are you now?"
"Look up," Han Xing said directly.
As Ausbu raised his head and looked at the sky covered by black mist.
A colossal giant Sky Island slowly emerged.
Ausbu’s expression changed instantly, showing an intense shock.
"Oh my..." he couldn’t help but exclaim.
The next moment, Ausbu seemed to recall Han Xing’s words.
Looking at the Witch Race army from Warhawk City that was heading towards him.
At this moment, Ausbu quickly said: "Go back, all of you go back!"
"Commander Gus, please immediately give the soldiers the order not to come over!"
Gus received Ausbu’s emergency call,
But he also knew Ausbu wouldn’t joke about such matters.
