chapters.title: Chapter 350 - 269: Firepower Overwhelms, Bombarding the Shadow Lord
paragraphs: At this moment, the Witch Race officer, ready to charge out and meet Ausbu, felt utterly confused.
The next moment, they saw Ausbu and his people crazily retreating.
"Damn, why is Ausbu retreating?"
"Damn it, could he have been frightened by the number of the Shadow Legion?"
"That’s impossible; fleeing during wartime is a capital offense, and Ausbu will be eternally nailed to the pillar of shame of the Witch Race!"
Ausbu ignored these guys.
Right now.
He only remembered Han Xing’s words.
Which were to run!
Run as far as possible!
On Gus’s side, he immediately issued orders to these Witch Race officers to hurry back to Warhawk City.
The ancient war chariots and Witch Race soldiers, ready to charge forward, began retreating toward Warhawk City.
The next moment, Han Xing pressed the button on the Hellfire Missile Silo.
Moreover, it was fired from five hundred silos simultaneously!
Boom! Boom boom boom!
As waves of ghastly green flames shot into the sky.
The sky over Warhawk City, originally shrouded in dark mist.
Was instantly illuminated at this moment.
The eyes of millions of Witch Race warriors instantly turned blank.
The next moment.
The hellfire, carrying ghastly green flames, descended from the sky, directly falling into the monster tide.
Rumble! Rumble rumble!
Mushroom clouds rose up.
The fierce impact caused the massive Warhawk City to tremble intensely!
At the scene, it was as if a hurricane had been unleashed.
Countless Witch Race soldiers were scattered, including those Shadow Legion monsters.
After the flames dissipated.
The bombarded areas were nearly emptied at this moment.
Among them, countless Three and Four-Star Shadow Monsters were blasted.
Even the elite monsters and leader monsters were severely hit!
The confusion in the eyes of this group of Witch Race soldiers vanished, replaced directly by shock.
"My God! What just happened?"
"What are those green flames, why are they so powerful?"
"Heavens, so terrifying!"
They had never seen a Hellfire Missile Silo before.
Its terrifying damage range could even rival the bombardment of the Demon Elephant War Chariots.
Moreover, it was five hundred firing simultaneously!
Almost half of the eastern gate battlefield was directly covered.
Millions of shadow monsters were directly obliterated.
However, this was only the first wave of damage from the Hellfire Missile Silo.
At this moment.
In the bombarded areas, towering fifty meters high, the Hellfire Giants appeared, their bodies burning with ghastly green flames!
Due to the limited damage of the Hellfire Launcher, it could directly take out Third and Fourth Transformation ordinary monsters.
But it couldn’t kill the elites and leaders instantly.
At this time, those elite and leader-level shadow monsters, suddenly severely hit, hadn’t reacted yet.
Then, they saw those dozens of Hellfires at the center of the battlefield.
They seemed to know it was precisely these Hellfire Giants that caused the current situation.
Immediately, strong killing intent appeared in their eyes.
Each of them charged at the Hellfire Giants.
However, as Four-Star Elites, being special creatures, the combat power of the Hellfire Giants was naturally formidable.
Facing attacks from monsters far exceeding their numbers, the Hellfire Giants showed no fear!
Bang! Bang bang!
Each punch landed with sparks flying!
With a towering fifty-meter physique, it exuded a tremendous sense of intimidation!
Additionally, this group of Hellfire Giants fought fiercely, not caring whether they would be injured or die.
Even the Shadow Legion, known for their ferocity, paled in comparison to the Hellfire Giants in terms of momentum.
Moreover, those Elite Monsters and Leader Monsters were already heavily injured.
Under these changing circumstances, each of these five hundred Hellfire Giants displayed strength akin to a Fourth-Turn Leader.
Boom! Boom boom!
A large number of elite monsters and leader monsters were blasted by the Hellfire Giants!
In the distance.
Seeing the powerful combat prowess of the Hellfire Giants, those lord-level creatures knew they could not let them continue slaughtering.
All of a sudden, at least five terrifying presences descended.
There is a huge gap between leaders and lords.
With only these five lords, it’s enough to slay five hundred hellfires!
However, Han Xing would never let them have their way.
The next moment.
From Ten Thousand Stars City, fifty golden silhouettes soared into the sky.
The dazzling golden light even brightened the sky.
At this moment, the Witch Race soldiers raised their heads one after another.
They also saw those familiar figures.
One of the Witch Race’s high-tier weapons, the Demon Elephant War Chariots!
And there was an alarming number of them, several times more than those in Warhawk City!
At this moment, the Witch Race warrior inside the Demon Elephant War Chariot exclaimed excitedly, "Holy crap! Fifty Demon Elephant War Chariots! Who are they?"
The other Witch Race warriors controlling the chariots also exclaimed, "This is too outrageous! The resources required to craft one Demon Elephant War Chariot are terrifying, yet here are fifty!"
"Give me fifty Demon Elephant War Chariots, and I’d dare charge straight ahead and battle the Shadow Lords head-on!"
The terrifying power of the Demon Elephant War Chariots needs no further explanation.
Their powerful attack power is four to five times that of the Hellfire Missile Silos, directly obliterating even fourth-turn elites and leaders!
In fact, that’s exactly what Han Xing is doing.
With fifty well-trained wolf cavalry controlling them, the Demon Elephant War Chariots soared directly into the air.
Then, all the Demon Elephant War Chariots raised their golden trunks simultaneously, brewing terrifying energy within.
All the Witch Race soldiers’ expressions turned solemn.
They were all too familiar with this action of the Demon Elephant War Chariots.
This was the preparation for unleashing an explosive skill, Flaming Strike!
And it was from fifty chariots.
Even the shadow monsters below realized how terrifying the concentrated fire from the Demon Elephant War Chariots would be!
In an instant, at least ten Shadow Lords on the East Gate battlefield all moved out.
They rushed upwards, seemingly trying to interrupt the attack of the Demon Elephant War Chariots.
But clearly, it was futile.
The attack of the Demon Elephant War Chariots was already fully charged.
Buzz!
The majestic golden trunks began to unleash their firepower.
No matter how fast the lord-level creatures were.
They couldn’t stop the launch.
Fifty shells, filled with terrifying flames, fell down.
Some hit the lords, while others landed on the battlefield below.
Then, a terrifying mushroom cloud rose.
The entire sky over Warhawk City was completely illuminated!
At least over two million shadow monsters were covered by the firepower of the Demon Elephant War Chariots.
Even these Witch Race soldiers had never witnessed such a scene where so many Demon Elephant War Chariots unleashed their might!
As the smoke and dust cleared, the scorching light faded away.
Gigantic craters, with diameters reaching thousands of meters, appeared on the ground!
In the pits, raging flames still burned.
And those shadow monsters, including lord-level creatures, had all vanished!
With one wave of bombing, at least two million shadow monsters were instantly killed.
This is the terror of ancient weaponry!
The Flaming Strike had a flame damage of twenty thousand points, and at this moment, quantity transformed into quality.
After two waves of bombing on the East Gate battlefield, it was instantly cleared.
Millions of shadow monsters, along with those leaders and lords, were all blown up!
This breathtaking scene made the Witch Race soldiers gasp in unison.
At this moment, Commander Gus trembled as he picked up the Communication Jade in his hand.
"Commander Ausbu, are these Demon Elephant War Chariots the reinforcements you mentioned?"
At this moment, Ausbu gave a bitter smile and shook his head, "Commander Gus, I’m not sure either."
Indeed, Ausbu was completely unaware.
Before this, he had only seen the formidable combat power of Han Xing and his group, as well as the prowess of the wolf cavalry and Minotaur army.
He never imagined.
That these few humans had even more terrifying, astonishing follow-up measures!
Fifty Demon Elephant War Chariots, something that could frighten anyone who heard about it.
Moreover, those masses of ghastly green flames.
At this moment, Ausbu couldn’t help but wonder how many more tricks these humans had yet to reveal?
Ignoring the shocked glances of the Witch Race soldiers.
Under Han Xing’s command, the fifty Demon Elephant War Chariots began heading to the other three battlefields.
With this one wave, he had at least eliminated five million shadow monsters.
Now on the battlefield, there were countless black crystals scattered everywhere.
A rough glance estimated their number in the hundreds of thousands!
This could be considered an enormous haul!
